n-m-h2-explog-07.title: Ukuba siyazi ixabiso lelogarithm e-1, singayifumana log₆12?
n-m-h2-explog-07.goal: Hlola ukuba loluphi ulwazi olufunekayo ukufumana ilogarithm ekujoliswe kuyo, uze ufumane ngokwakho ibinzana ngokwexabiso e-1 p.
n-m-h2-explog-07.material: UEunseo ufuna ukufumana log_6 12 ngaphandle kwekhalkyuleyitha. Ukuba uxelelwa nje elinye lamaxabiso angezantsi, ufuna ukuhlola ukuba angayibonisa na i-log_6 12 ngokwelo xabiso usebenzisa kuphela iimpawu zeelogarithm nemisebenzi emine yezibalo. (log_6 12 yilogarithm ye-12 enesiseko 6.)
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.prompt: Khetha onke amaxabiso apho ukwazi elo xabiso e-1 kuphela likuvumela ukuba ubonise i-log_6 12 ngokwalo usebenzisa kuphela iimpawu zeelogarithm nemisebenzi emine yezibalo.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.hint.0: Zama ukutshintsha isiseko se-log_6 12 sibe ngu-2 okanye 3, okanye ubhale 12 no-6 njengemveliso ka-2 no-3, ubone ukuba yeyiphi ilogarithm e-1 enokuyibonisa.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola omnye ngomnye ukuba ukhetho ngalunye luphethe ulwazi olufanayo nelogarithm leyo e-1 (ukuba lunokuguqulwa lube yiyo ngefomula).
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.a: Nge-log_10 2 yodwa, awukwazi ukwazi i-log_10 3, ngoko awukwazi ukubonisa zombini 12 no-6.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.b: Ushiye ulwazi oluguqulela kwilogarithm e-1, njenge-log_2 6=1+log_2 3.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.c: Ushiye ukuba ukusebenzisa log_6 3=1−log_6 2 kukuvumela ukuba ubonise i-log_6 12.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.f: Ushiye ukuba ukutshintsha i-log_6 12 ukuya kwisiseko 2 kushiya kuphela i-log_2 3.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.explain: log_6 12=log_2 12/log_2 6=(2+log_2 3)/(1+log_2 3), ngoko p=log_2 3 yodwa yanele. log_2 6=1+p, log_3 2=1/p, kwaye log_6 2=1/(1+p) zinokuguqulwa ziye kwaye zivele ku-p nazo. log_10 2 ayisebenzi ngaphandle kokuba uyazi log_10 3, kwaye log_5 7 ayinabudlelwane no-2 no-3.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.hint.0: Tshintsha iseko libe ngu-2 ubhale inani elingasentla nelingaphantsi njengamaxabiso e-log_2.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala log_2 12 kunye ne-log_2 6 njengemveliso ye-2 ne-3, uze usebenzise iipropati zeelogarithm ukuzibonisa ngo-p.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Kwikhweshini yakho ene-p, ngaba ubeke inani elingasentla nelingaphantsi ngendlela echanekileyo?
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ngaba ufake p=1.585 uhlole ukuba log_6 12≈1.387?
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.model.1: Ukutshintsha iseko libe ngu-2 kunika log_2 12 / log_2 6 = (2+p)/(1+p).

n-m-h2-explog-09.title: Ukugweba ukulingana phakathi kweegrafu zemisebenzi ye-exponential neye-logarithmic
n-m-h2-explog-09.goal: Hlola izibakala zokulingana phakathi kweegrafu ezininzi usebenzisa iifomyula ukugqiba ukuba zeziphi ezinyaniso nezibhuqayo, uze ubonise isizathu sesibakala esinye ngefomyula enye.
n-m-h2-explog-09.material: U-Seungwoo wafingqa ubudlelwane bokulingana phakathi kweegrafu zemisebenzi ye-exponential neye-logarithmic ezineesiseko 2 no-1/2. Ilogarithm enesiseko 1/2 ibhalwa njenge-log_{1/2}x.
n-m-h2-explog-09.thinking.1: Ukuguqula ubudlelwane phakathi kweegrafu bube ziifomyula
n-m-h2-explog-09.prereq.1: Imisebenzi echasayo nokulingana malunga nomgca y=x
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke izibakala ezichanekileyo phakathi kwezo zishwankathelwe nguSeungwoo.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.hint.0: Kwibini ngalinye leegrafu, khetha ichaphaza elinye ufumane amakhowudinethi alo, uze uhlole ukuba eli chaphaza kufuneka lihanjiswe njani ukuze lifike kwigrafu enye.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.hint.1: Kuqala bhala indlela ukulingana malunga ne-eksisi ye-y nokulingana malunga nomgca y=x ngamnye atshintsha ngayo amakhowudinethi echaphaza.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.o.a: Iigrafu ze-y=2^x kunye ne-y=(1/2)^x ziyalingana malunga ne-eksisi ye-y
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.r.a: Kuba (1/2)^x=2^(−x), yigrafu enophawu lwe-x lutshintshiwe. Uphosise isibakala esichanekileyo.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.o.b: Iigrafu ze-y=log_2 x kunye ne-y=log_{1/2} x ziyalingana malunga ne-eksisi ye-y
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.r.b: Imisebenzi yelogarithm ichazwa kuphela kwa-x>0, ngoko ayinakulingana malunga ne-eksisi ye-y.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.o.c: Iigrafu ze-y=2^x kunye ne-y=log_2 x ziyalingana malunga nomgca y=x
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.r.c: Ngemisebenzi echasayo omnye nomnye, ngoko ziyalingana malunga ne-y=x. Uphosise isibakala esichanekileyo.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.o.d: Iigrafu ze-y=2^x kunye ne-y=log_{1/2} x ziyalingana malunga nomgca y=x
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.r.d: Umsebenzi ochasayo we-2^x yi-log_2 x, hayi i-log_{1/2} x.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.explain: Kuba (1/2)^x=2^(−x), y=2^x no-y=(1/2)^x ziyalingana malunga ne-eksisi ye-y. y=2^x no-y=log_2 x yimisebenzi echasayo omnye nomnye, ngoko ziyalingana malunga ne-y=x. log_{1/2} x inomhlaba x>0, ngoko ayinakulingana malunga ne-eksisi ye-y, kwaye ayingomsebenzi ochasayo we-2^x nayo.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.prompt: Bhala umgca apho iigrafu ze-y=log_2 x kunye ne-y=log_{1/2} x ziyalingana malunga nawo, uze ubonise isizathu ngefomyula.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.hint.0: Phinda ubhale log_{1/2} x njengelogarithm enesiseko 2. Thelekisa amaxabiso e-y eefomyula ezimbini kwa-x ofanayo.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.hint.1: Jonga indlela amaxabiso e-y anxulumene ngayo, uze uthi olo budlelwane buhambisa ichaphaza ngasiphi icala le-eksisi.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ufumene log_{1/2} x=−log_2 x ngokutshintsha iseko?
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Usebenzisa amakhowudinethi echaphaza, ngaba uthe kwa-x ofanayo amaxabiso amabini e-y ahluke kuphela ngophawu?
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ngaba uthe ukulingana malunga ne-eksisi ye-x kuhambisa ichaphaza njani?
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.model.0: log_{1/2} x=log_2 x / log_2(1/2)=−log_2 x. Kwa-x ofanayo amaxabiso e-y ahluke kuphela ngophawu, ngoko iigrafu ziyalingana malunga ne-eksisi ye-x.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.model.1: Iyalingana malunga ne-eksisi ye-x. Ukutshintsha iseko kuguqula log_{1/2} x ibe yi-−log_2 x, ngoko yigrafu apho ichaphaza (x, y) lihanjiswe laya kwi-(x, −y).
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.model.2: Ziyalingana malunga ne-eksisi ye-x. y=log_{1/2} x ifana no-y=−log_2 x, ngoko amaxabiso e-y eegrafu zombini anezimpawu eziphikisanayo.

n-m-h2-explog-05.title: Ukuchazela umhlobo ukuba kutheni silahla t=−1
n-m-h2-explog-05.goal: Xa usombulula ulingano lwe-exponential ngokufaka, sebenzisa uluhlu lonobumba ofakiweyo ukubeka isizathu sokulahla isisombululo kumagama anokuqondwa ngumhlobo.
n-m-h2-explog-05.material: Nazi iinqaku zikaJiho zokusombulula 4^x−3·2^x−4=0. "Vumela 2^x=t. Emva koko t²−3t−4=0, (t−4)(t+1)=0, ngoko t=4 okanye t=−1. t=−1 ayisebenzi, ngoko siyilahla, kwaye ukusuka kwi-2^x=4, x=2." USora wabona ezi nqaku wabuza, "Kutheni ulahla nje t=−1? Ndicinga ukuba kusenokubakho x ene-2^x=−1."
n-m-h2-explog-05.thinking.1: Ukuguqula isivakalisi sesisombululo esinzima sibe ngamagama alula
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.prompt: Xa uvumela 2^x=t, khetha uluhlu oluchanekileyo lwamaxabiso anokuthathwa ngu-t.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.hint.0: Faka amanani apheleleyo, amanani anegethivu, no-0 kwi-x ubhale amaxabiso ambalwa athathwa ngu-2^x.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.hint.1: Jonga ukuba amaxabiso owabhalileyo awela kuluhlu luni, uze ucinge ukuba ikho x enika u-0.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.r.a: Ucinge ukuba u-0 uyakwazeka nawo. Cinga ukuba ikho x ene-2^x=0.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.r.b: Wazi ukuba 2^x ithatha kuphela amaxabiso amakhulu kune-0.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.r.c: Ushiye iimeko apho 2^x incinci kune-1 xa x inegethivu.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.r.d: Ushiye ukuba umsebenzi we-exponential awukwazi ukuthatha amaxabiso anegethivu.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.explain: Kuyo nayiphi na inani leneneni x, 2^x ithatha kuphela amaxabiso amakhulu kune-0. Xa x iba ncinci kakhulu, 2^x isondela kwi-0 kodwa ayilokothi ibe ngu-0. Ngoko uluhlu lwe-t=2^x yi-t>0.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.prompt: Bhala impendulo kuSora. Chaza ngokutsha "t=−1 ayisebenzi, ngoko siyilahla" ukuze uSora aqonde, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni kungekho x ene-2^x=−1. (Malunga nezivakalisi ezi-3)
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngamagama awaziwa nguSora. Kuthekani ngokunika imizekelo yamaxabiso owafumanayo xa ufaka amaxabiso ambalwa e-x kwi-2^x?
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.hint.1: Endaweni yegama elithi "ayisebenzi," beka isivakalisini sakho ukuba luluphi uluhlu lwamaxabiso anokuthathwa ngu-2^x.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingaba usebenzise amagama awaziwa nguSora (umzekelo, amaxabiso owafumanayo ngokufaka amaxabiso ambalwa e-x kwi-2^x)?
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba unike isizathu esithile endaweni yegama elithi "ayisebenzi"?
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingaba ucacisile nokuba kutheni t=4 inokusetyenziswa?
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.model.0: Sora, ukuba ufaka x=1, 0, −3 kwi-2^x, ufumana 2, 1, 1/8, kwaye onke makhulu kune-0. Nokuba utshintsha x kanjani, 2^x ayilokothi ibe negethivu, ngoko akukho x ene-2^x=−1. Ngoko silahla t=−1 sisebenzise t=4 kuphela.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.model.1: Nokuba uphindaphinda okanye wahlula u-2 amaxesha amaninzi kangakanani, ufumana inani lepozithivu rhoqo. 2^x ithatha kuphela amaxabiso amakhulu kune-0, ngoko 2^x=−1 ayinakwenzeka. t=4 ipozithivu, ngoko inika x=2.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.model.2: t=2^x ihlala ipozithivu. Ngoko ukuba ufumana inani elinegethivu njenge-t=−1, akukho x enjalo. Oko akuyompazamo ekusombululeni, kungenxa yohlobo lwe-2^x.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.hint.0: Vumela 3^x=t, sombulula ulingano lwe-t, uze ufumane onke amaxabiso e-t.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.hint.1: Kwixabiso ngalinye le-t olifumeneyo, hlola ukuba ikho x enelisa i-3^x=t.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.r.a: Uqhagamshele onke amaxabiso omabini e-t no-x.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.r.b: Ushiye imeko apho t ipozithivu. Hlola amaxabiso e-t owafumeneyo omnye ngomnye.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.r.c: Uqaphele ukuba t=−1 ayinikeli sisombululo kwaye t=3 kuphela esetyenziswayo.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.r.d: Bala kwakhona unxulumano phakathi kwenani lezisombululo ze-t nenani lezisombululo ze-x.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.explain: Ukuba sivumela 3^x=t, ngoko t²−2t−3=(t−3)(t+1)=0. t=3 inika x=1 kwi-3^x=3, kwaye t=−1 ayinikeli sisombululo kuba 3^x>0. Ngoko kukho isisombululo esi-1 seneneni kuphela, x=1.

n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.prompt: Ulwazi luvezwa isiqwenga esinye ngexesha. Kwinyathelo ngalinye, khetha isigwebo ngokusekelwe kuphela koko uyaziyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku.
n-m-h2-diff-04.title: Inani leengcambu zeneneni limiselwa njani?
n-m-h2-diff-04.topic: Imo yegrafu yomsebenzi we-cubic neengcambu zeneneni zolingano
n-m-h2-diff-04.goal: Ngalo lonke ixesha ulwazi lwongezwa, hlaziya igwebo lakho malunga nenani leengcambu zeneneni ezahlukileyo zolingano lwe-cubic, uze uchaze umda apho iimpawu nenani leendawo ezigqithisileyo zitshintsha khona.
n-m-h2-diff-04.material: Qwalasela inani leengcambu zeneneni ezahlukileyo zolingano lwe-cubic x³−3x²+k=0 (k ngumthamo ongatshintshiyo). Vumela f(x)=x³−3x²+k, uze wenze igwebo ngalo lonke ixesha ulwazi luvezwa.
n-m-h2-diff-04.thinking.1: Ukufunda inani leengcambu zeneneni kwimo yegrafu
n-m-h2-diff-04.thinking.2: Ukuhlola ngokwahlukileyo amaxabiso omda apho inani litshintsha khona
n-m-h2-diff-04.prereq.0: Ubuninzi nobuncinane belokishi bomsebenzi we-cubic nemo yegrafu yawo
n-m-h2-diff-04.prereq.1: Iingcambu zeneneni zolingano neendawo apho igrafu idibana khona ne-eksisi ye-x
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.hint.0: Ngalo lonke ixesha ulwazi olutsha luvela, cinga ukuba igwebo lakho kufuneka litshintshe na.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuba igrafu idlula ngamaxesha amangaphi kwi-eksisi ye-x ngokwezimpawu zobuninzi belokishi nobuncinane belokishi.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.info: f(x)=x³−3x²+k ngumsebenzi we-cubic ene-coefficient engasentla epozithivu, kwaye ixabiso lika-k alikaziwa.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ulingano f(x)=0 lunaziphi iingcambu zeneneni ezahlukileyo?
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Iziphelo ezimbini zegrafu ye-cubic zimisiwe, enye iya ngaphezulu nenye iya ezantsi, ngoko idibana ne-eksisi ye-x kanye ubuncinane. Kodwa ukuba idibana kangaphi kuxhomekeke apho ubuninzi belokishi nobuncinane belokishi bukhona khona.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ixubile inyaniso ye-algebra yokuba ulingano lwe-cubic lunengcambu ezi-3 nenani leengcambu zeneneni ezahlukileyo.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ibonile ukuba inani lamaxesha igrafu edibana ngawo ne-eksisi ye-x linokwahluka ngo-k.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Yaqinisekisa ukuba igrafu inqumla i-eksisi ye-x kanye kuphela.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ayizange ibe nokuchaza uluhlu olunokwenzeka lwenani. Kukho into enokwaziwa kwimilo yomsebenzi wekyubhiki.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.info: f'(x)=3x(x−2), ngoko kukho ubuninzi belokishi kwi-x=0 nobuncinane belokishi kwi-x=2. Ixabiso lobuninzi belokishi yi-f(0)=k kwaye ixabiso lobuncinane belokishi yi-f(2)=k−4.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Xa k=1, zingaphi iingcambu zokwenyani ezahlukeneyo?
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Ukuba k=1, ixabiso lobuninzi belokishi li-1 (lipositivu) kwaye ixabiso lobuncinane belokishi li−3 (linegethivu). Igrafu inyuka ukusuka ekupheleni kwasekhohlo, inqumla i-eksisi ye-x, ifikelela kubuninzi belokishi, yehle, inqumle i-eksisi ye-x, ifikelele kubuncinane belokishi, iphinde inyuke inqumle i-eksisi ye-x, ngoko zikho iingcambu zokwenyani ezi-3 ezahlukeneyo.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Yabona kuphela ukuba ixabiso lobuninzi belokishi 1 lipositivu yacinga ukuba igrafu idibana ne-eksisi kanye.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Yayicinga ngemeko apho igrafu ithinta i-eksisi ye-x. Oko kusebenza kuphela xa ixabiso eliphakamileyo lingu-0 kanye.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Yabona ukuba ubuninzi belokishi bupositivu kwaye ubuncinane belokishi bunegethivu, ngoko igrafu inqumla i-eksisi ye-x kathathu.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Xa k=1, onke amaxabiso obuninzi belokishi nobuncinane belokishi amiselwe.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Ukutshintsha k kuhambisa igrafu phezulu okanye ezantsi, ngoko iimpawu zexabiso lobuninzi belokishi k nelobuncinane belokishi k−4 zixhomekeke ku-k, kwaye kukho amaxesha apho elinye lazo liba ngu-0.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kwiliphi ixabiso lika-k kukho iingcambu zokwenyani ezi-2 kanye ezahlukeneyo?
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Ukuba k=0, f(x)=x²(x−3), ngoko iingcambu zi-x=0 (ichaphaza lokuthinteleka) no-x=3; ukuba k=4, f(x)=(x+1)(x−2)², ngoko iingcambu zi-x=−1 no-x=2 (ichaphaza lokuthinteleka). Kuzo zombini iimeko zikho iingcambu zokwenyani ezi-2 ezahlukeneyo. Igrafu ithinta i-eksisi ye-x kanye xa ixabiso eliphakamileyo lingu-0.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ijonge kuphela imeko apho ixabiso lobuninzi belokishi lingu-0. Kukho neemeko apho ixabiso lobuncinane belokishi lingu-0.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ijonge kuphela imeko apho ixabiso lobuncinane belokishi lingu-0. Kukho neemeko apho ixabiso lobuninzi belokishi lingu-0.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Olu luhlu apho amaxabiso aphakamileyo enamathuba achasayo, ngoko zikho iingcambu zokwenyani ezi-3.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni, kuba singayazi k, sasisazi kuphela ukuba inani leengcambu zokwenyani linokwahluka. Kwakufunyenwe amaxabiso aphakamileyo, sazi ukumisela inani kwi-k=1, sabona umda apho inani litshintsha ukusuka kwi-3 liye kwi-2 ngexesha apho ixabiso eliphakamileyo liba ngu-0. Inani leengcambu zokwenyani zolingano linokumiselwa yigrafu neempawu zamaxabiso aphakamileyo.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.prompt: Bhala ukuba k kufuneka ibe kuluhlu luni ukuze zibekho iingcambu ezintathu ezahlukeneyo, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni amaxabiso omda k=0 no-k=4 engabandakanywanga.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ukuba ixabiso lobuninzi belokishi nelobuncinane belokishi kufuneka ngalinye libe nawuphi uphawu ukuze igrafu inqumle i-eksisi ye-x kathathu.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.hint.1: Hlahla f(x) xa k=0 nalapho k=4, ufumane iingcambu ngqo.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ubhale imeko yophawu lwexabiso lobuninzi belokishi nelobuncinane belokishi?
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ukhangele ngqo ukuba zingaphi iingcambu ngokwenene kumaxabiso omda?
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.model.0: Ixabiso lobuninzi belokishi k kufuneka lipositivu kwaye ixabiso lobuncinane belokishi k−4 kufuneka linegethivu, ngoko 0<k<4. Ukuba k=0 okanye k=4, ixabiso eliphakamileyo lingu-0, ngoko igrafu ithinta i-eksisi ye-x kwaye zikho iingcambu ezi-2 kuphela ezahlukeneyo.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.model.1: 0<k<4. Ubuninzi belokishi kufuneka bube ngaphezu kwe-eksisi ye-x nobuncinane belokishi bube ngaphantsi kwayo ukuze igrafu inqumle kathathu. Kumaxabiso asekupheleni 0 no-4, kuvela ingcambu ephindiweyo kwaye zikho iingcambu ezimbini kuphela ezahlukeneyo, ngoko zishiyiwe.

n-m-h2-limit-03.title: Ubudlelwane phakathi kweempawu zamaxabiso eziphelo kunye nengcambu ngaphakathi kwesithuba
n-m-h2-limit-03.topic: Imida nokuqhubeka kwemisebenzi: okuchasayo komgaqo wexabiso eliphakathi
n-m-h2-limit-03.goal: Wahlula oko umgaqo wexabiso eliphakathi ukunika kona (imeko eyanelisayo) kunoko ungakunikiyo, uze wakhe uhlole umzekelo apho okuchasayo komgaqo kungasebenzi.
n-m-h2-limit-03.material: Kumsebenzi oqhubekayo f, umgaqo wexabiso eliphakathi uthi, "Ukuba f(0)f(4)<0, ngoko kukho x kwisithuba (0, 4) ene-f(x)=0." U-Doyun uthi, "Ngoko xa f(0)f(4)>0, akuyi kubakho ngcambu kwi-(0, 4)."
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.prompt: Ukubonisa ukuba isibakala sika-Doyun siphosisile, kufuneka ukhangele umsebenzi oqhubekayo onjani?
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuba ingcamango nesigqibo kufuneka zibe yintoni nganye ukuze isibakala siphosise.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.o.a: Umsebenzi oqhubekayo one-f(0)f(4)<0 kwaye ongenangcambu kwi-(0, 4)
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.r.a: Ngenxa yomgaqo wexabiso eliphakathi, umsebenzi onjalo awukwazi ukubakho. Ukuba umgaqo uchanekile, awukwazi ukufumana omnye.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.o.b: Umsebenzi oqhubekayo one-f(0)f(4)>0 kwaye ongenangcambu kwi-(0, 4)
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.r.b: Lo mzekelo uvumelana nesibakala sika-Doyun, ngoko awuluphuli isibakala.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.o.c: Umsebenzi oqhubekayo one-f(0)f(4)<0 kwaye onengcambu kwi-(0, 4)
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.r.c: Le yimeko eqinisekiswa ngumgaqo, ngoko ayinanto yakwenza nesibakala.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.o.d: Umsebenzi oqhubekayo one-f(0)f(4)>0 kwaye onengcambu kwi-(0, 4)
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.explain: Ukubonisa ukuba isibakala sefom "ukuba ..., ngoko ..." siphosisile, udinga umzekelo oyanelisayo ingcamango kodwa ungayaneliseki isigqibo, oko kukuthi, umzekelo onengcambu kwi-(0, 4) nangona f(0)f(4)>0.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.prompt: Vumela f(x)=(x−a)(x−b). Ngenisa iibini ezimbini ezahlukeneyo (a, b) ukuze f(0)f(4)>0 kwaye f(x)=0 ibe neengcambu eziyinyani ezimbini ezahlukileyo kwisithuba (0, 4). (a<b)
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala f(0) no-f(4) ngo-a no-b, uze usebenze ukuba iingcambu kufuneka zibe phi ukuze amaxabiso amabini abe nophawu olufanayo.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha ingcambu enye kwisithuba (0, 4), inani eliphelele okanye idesimali, emva koko ukhethe enye ingcambu phakathi kwaloo ngcambu nomphetho wesithuba, uze uyihlole ngokubala ngqo.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.explain: f(0)=ab kwaye f(4)=(4−a)(4−b), kwaye ukuba zombini iingcambu zilele phakathi kwe-0 ne-4, zombini zibonakalisa ngokongeza. Ngoko nangona f(0)f(4)>0, kukho iingcambu ezimbini kwi-(0, 4). Igrafu iya ngaphantsi kwe-eksisi ye-x emva koko ibuyele phezulu.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Nangomzekelo onjalo, umgaqo wexabiso eliphakathi awuphosisi. Chaza ukuba kutheni kwisivakalisi esinye okanye ezimbini.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Phinda ubhale ukuba umgaqo uchaza liphi icala: yintoni ethetha yintoni.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Cinga ukuba isivakalisi esinecala elijikiweyo sithetha okufanayo na.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ngaba uchaze icala lomgaqo ngokuchanekileyo ngamagama?
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ubonise ukuba umzekelo awuphikisani nomgaqo?
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.model.0: Umgaqo wexabiso eliphakathi uthi kuphela ukuba ukuba iimpawu ziyahluka, kukho ingcambu. Awuthi akukho ngcambu xa iimpawu zifana, ngoko igrafu enqumla i-eksisi ye-x kabini ayiphikisani nomgaqo.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.model.1: Okuchasayo komgaqo akuqinisekiswanga. Nokuba amaxabiso eziphelo anophawu olufanayo, igrafu inokunqumla i-eksisi ye-x embindini ibuye, ngoko ingcambu inokubakho.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.model.2: Umgaqo uthi kuphela "ukuba iimpawu ziyahluka, kukho ingcambu." Awuthi "ukuba kukho ingcambu, iimpawu ziyahluka."
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.model.3: Oko umgaqo ukuthethayo kuya kuphela kwi-"ukuba iimpawu ziyahluka, kukho ingcambu." Akuthethi ukuba le yeyona meko kuphela apho ingcambu ikho.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s3.prompt: Khetha yonke imisebenzi engezantsi apho umgaqo wexabiso eliphakathi wodwa ukuvumela ukuba uqukumbele ngokuqinisekileyo ukuba kukho x kwisithuba (0, 4) ene-f(x)=0.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s3.hint.0: Kumsebenzi ngamnye, hlola iimpawu zombini f(0) no-f(4) nokuba likho na ukwaphuka kwi-[0, 4].
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala phantsi ukuba ngowuphi umbini umgaqo ofuna ukuba wanelisiwe ukuze uqinisekise ingcambu, uze uthelekise inketho nganye nazo.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s3.r.a: f(0)=4 no-f(4)=4 banophawu olufanayo, ngoko ingcamango yomgaqo ayanelisiwe. Nokuba x=2 yingcambu, lo mgaqo awuqinisekisanga.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s3.r.c: Iimpawu zika-f(0) no-f(4) ziyahluka, kodwa f ayiqhubekanga kwa-x=2, ngoko umgaqo awunakusetyenziswa. Ngokwenene, akukho ngcambu nayo.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s3.explain: Kwi-b, f(0)=−1 no-f(4)=3, kwaye ngumsebenzi wepolynomial, ngoko uqhubekile, ngoko umgaqo uqinisekisa ingcambu. Kuyafana kwi-d, apho f(0)=−3 no-f(4)=5 kwaye f iqhubekile. Kwi-a, f(0)=4 no-f(4)=4 banophawu olufanayo, ngoko umgaqo awunakusetyenziswa (ingcambu x=2 ikho, kodwa umgaqo awuyiqinisekisi). Kwi-c, iimpawu ziyahluka, kodwa f iyaphuka kwa-x=2 kwaye ayiqhubekanga, ngoko umgaqo awunakusetyenziswa.

n-m-h2-trig-10.title: Ubungakanani beengile nobungakanani bemilinganiselo yetrigonometri kunxantathu
n-m-h2-trig-10.goal: Phantsi kwemeko yokuba A, B, C ziingile ezingaphakathi zonxantathu, gweba ukuba ukuthelekisa ubungakanani beengile kuthwala kwicala eliphi ekuthelekiseni amaxabiso e-sin, cos, tan, uze unike izizathu usebenzisa umthetho wesayini neengile engqukuva.
n-m-h2-trig-10.material: Abafundi abane benze izibakala ezilandelayo malunga neengile ezintathu ezingaphakathi A, B, C zonxantathu ABC. Cinga kuphela iimeko apho amaxabiso emilinganiselo yetrigonometri echaziweyo.
n-m-h2-trig-10.thinking.0: Gweba ukuba isibakala siyinyani okanye siphosisile ngaphakathi kweemeko zaso
n-m-h2-trig-10.prereq.1: Ipropati yokuba icala elichasene neengile enkulu lelona cala lide
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke izibakala ezihlala zichanekile kunxantathu ABC.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.hint.0: Faka iingile ezithile (30°, 100°, njalonjalo) endaweni ka-A no-B kwisibakala ngasinye.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.hint.1: Sebenzisa umthetho wesayini ukuguqula sinA kunye sinB zibe bubude bamacala, ubhale ukuba ukuthelekisa ubungakanani kuphuma njani.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.r.a: Esi sisigwebo sokuba iingile enkulu inexabiso lesayini elikhulu. Unokuyihlola ngokuthelekisa ubude bamacala achasene neengile ezimbini usebenzisa umthetho wesayini.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.r.b: Esi sisigwebo sokuba ikhosayini enkulu ithetha iingile enkulu. Jonga indlela ixabiso lekhosayini elitshintsha ngayo njengoko iingile ikhula ukusuka kwi-0° ukuya kwi-180°.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.r.c: Uguqule ubungakanani bamaxabiso esayini baba bubude bamacala ukuze uthelekise waza wasebenzisa into yokuba icala elikhulu lilele ngokuchasene neengile enkulu.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.r.d: Uphosise ukuba iingile kunxantathu inokuba ngqukuva. Thelekisa amaxabiso amabini e-tan xa A=30° no-B=100°.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.explain: Ngomthetho wesayini, a=2R·sinA no-b=2R·sinB, ngoko sinA>sinB iyalingana no-a>b, kwaye kuba icala elikhulu lichasene neengile enkulu, iyalingana no-A>B nayo. Ngoko a no-c zombini zichanekile. Ukuba cosA>cosB, ngoko A<B, ngoko b iphambukile, kwaye tan ithabatha kwiingile engqukuva, ngoko xa A=30° no-B=100°, tanA>tanB kodwa A<B, nto leyo eyenza d iphosise.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.prompt: Chaza ukuba kutheni "ukuba sinA>sinB, ngoko A>B" isebenza kunxantathu (c), uze unike umzekelo omnye ochasayo obonisa ukuba (d) ayisebenzi.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.hint.0: Phinda ubhale sinA kunye ne-sinB njengobude bamacala usebenzisa umthetho wesayini.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.hint.1: Thatha enye ka-A no-B ibe ngqukuva uze ucinge ngophawu lwexabiso le-tan.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.placeholder: umz. Ngomthetho wesayini ... Umzekelo ochasayo: A=..., B=...
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba uguqule ukuthelekisa amaxabiso esayini kwaba kukuthelekisa ubude bamacala?
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uthelekise ngokwenene amaxabiso e-tan A kunye ne-tan B?
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ngaba ubonise kumzekelo wakho ochasayo ukuba A<B kodwa tanA>tanB?
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.model.0: Ngomthetho wesayini, a=2R sinA no-b=2R sinB, ngoko ukuba sinA>sinB ngoko a>b. Icala elikhulu lichasene neengile enkulu, ngoko A>B. Umzekelo ochasayo: A=30°, B=100°. tan30° ibonakalisa ngokongeza kwaye tan100° ithabatha, ngoko tanA>tanB kodwa A<B.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.model.1: Ukuba sinA>sinB, ngoko ngomthetho wesayini icala a lide kuneecala b, emva koko A inkulu kuno-B. tan ithabatha kwiingile engqukuva, ngoko umzekelo ukuba A=45° no-B=120°, ngoko tanA=1>tanB=−√3 kodwa A<B.

n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca wokuqala ophosakeleyo kwisisombululo sikaJiho.
n-m-h2-diff-01.title: Ukuhlola isisombululo esifumana umgca othintelayo othe nkqo kumgca
n-m-h2-diff-01.topic: Ikhweshini yomgca othintelayo: ithambeka lomgca othe nkqo
n-m-h2-diff-01.goal: Kwisisombululo esifumana umgca othintelayo kwigophe othe nkqo kumgca onikiweyo, fumana umgca wokuqala ophosisayo, ulungise, uze uhlole usebenzisa imveliso yamathambeka.
n-m-h2-diff-01.material: Esi sisisombululo sika-Jiho sokufumana, phakathi kwemigca ethintelayo ezotywe kumachaphaza egophe y=x²−4x+5, lowo othe nkqo kumgca y=x/2+1. (x² ithetha x isikwere, kwaye x/2 ithetha x phezu kwezi-2.)
n-m-h2-diff-01.thinking.0: Ukulandela isisombululo umgca nomgca ukufumana umgca wokuqala ophosisayo
n-m-h2-diff-01.thinking.1: Ukuguqula imeko ethe nkqo ibe unxulumano phakathi kwamathambeka
n-m-h2-diff-01.prereq.1: Unxulumano phakathi kwamathambeka xa imigca emibini ithe nkqo
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola omnye ngomnye ukuba umgca ngamnye ufike njani kumgca ongaphambi kwawo kanye.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.hint.1: Fumana ukuba igama elithi "ethe nkqo" lalitshintshwa njani laba nxulumano kulingano.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.line.1: Ekubeni ithe nkqo kumgca y=x/2+1, ithambeka lethanjenti li-−1/2.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.line.3: Indawo yokuthinta yi-(7/4, 17/16), kwaye ithanjenti yi-y=−(1/2)(x−7/4)+17/16.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.explain: Umgca wesi-2 owokuqala ophosakeleyo. Xa imigca emibini ithe nkqo, imveliso yamathambeka ayo yi-−1. Ithambeka lomgca othe nkqo kumgca onethambeka eli-1/2 alilo i-−1/2, elitshintsha uphawu kuphela, kodwa linani elimveliso yalo ne-1/2 yi-−1. Ubalo kwimigca yesi-3 nesi-4 lulandela umgca wesi-2, ngoko ubalo ngokwalo lulungile, kodwa isiphumo siyatshintsha.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.prompt: Lungisa umgca ophosakeleyo ufumane ikhowudinethi ye-x yendawo yokuthinta nolingano lwethanjenti.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.hint.0: Zoba umgca othe nkqo kumgca onethambeka eli-1/2, uze ukhethe amanani ambalwa anokuba lelo thambeka uwavavanye ngokubala nge-1/2.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.hint.1: Misela ithambeka elitsha lilingane ne-f'(x) ufumane x, uze ufumane ikhowudinethi ye-y yeloo ndawo kwi-f(x).
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ubhale imeko ethe nkqo njengemveliso yamathambeka?
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ufumene ikhowudinethi ye-y yendawo yokuthinta kulingano lwejika?
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingaba ubeke ulingano lwethanjenti ngefom y=…?
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.model.0: Ukuba imigca ithe nkqo, imveliso yamathambeka yi-−1, ngoko (1/2)×m=−1 kwaye m=−2. Ukusuka kwi-2x−4=−2, x=1, kwaye f(1)=2, ngoko indawo yokuthinta yi-(1, 2) kwaye ithanjenti yi-y=−2x+4.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.model.1: Umgca othe nkqo kumgca onethambeka eli-1/2 unethambeka le-−2. I-x ene-f'(x)=−2 yi-1, kwaye indawo yokuthinta yi-(1,2). Ukwenza lula y−2=−2(x−1) kunika y=−2x+4.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.prompt: Kwisisombululo sikaJiho, luluphi uhlolo olwaluya kuyibamba le mpazamo ngokukhawuleza?
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.hint.0: Kuqala khumbula ulingano olubambe phakathi kwamathambeka emigca emibini ethe nkqo.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.hint.1: Faka ukhetho ngalunye ngqo kumathambeka amabini kaJiho, i-1/2 ne-−1/2.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.o.a: Yongeza amathambeka amabini uhlole ukuba enza u-0
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.r.a: Ukongeza ku-0 yinxulumano apho amathambeka anemiqondiso ephambeneyo kuphela. Isondele ekuntshantshisweni ngaphesheya kwe-eksisi ye-x kunokuba ibe ethe nkqo.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.o.b: Hlola kuphela ukuba amathambeka amabini anemiqondiso ephambeneyo
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.r.b: Imiqondiso ephambeneyo iyimfuneko kodwa ayanelanga. Ubungakanani bamathambeka kufuneka buhambelane nabo ukuze imigca ithe nkqo.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.o.c: Phindaphinda amathambeka amabini uhlole ukuba enza i-−1
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.r.c: Oku kuvavanya ngqo intsingiselo ye-ethe nkqo usebenzisa ukuphindaphinda.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.o.d: Hlola ukuba ikhowudinethi ye-y yendawo yokuthinta ilele kwijika
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.r.d: Nokuba indawo yokuthinta ikwijika, olu hlolo alunakuxela ukuba ithambeka linelisa imeko ethe nkqo.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.explain: (1/2)×(−1/2)=−1/4, engeyiyo i-−1. Ukuhlola ukuba imveliso yi-−1 kuvumbulula impazamo yomgca wesi-2 kwangoko.

n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.r.d: Izinga eliqhelekileyo loutshintsho alipozithivu, ngoko aliyanelisi ihayipothesisi yebango.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.explain: Ukubonisa ukuba ibango lefom "ukuba ~, ngoko ~" asiyiyo inyani, udinga umzekelo onelisa ihayipothesisi (izinga eliqhelekileyo loutshintsho lipozithivu) kodwa usilela kwisigqibo (ukunyuka kwixesha).
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.prompt: Kwi-f(x)=x²−bx, fakela b no-p ezinjalo ukuba izinga eliqhelekileyo loutshintsho kwi-[0, 4] lipozithivu, kwaye kwindawo ethile p ngaphakathi kwe-(0, 4) f'(p)<0 (f iyehla kufutshane nele ndawo). Yenza imizekelo emi-3 enamaxabiso ahlukileyo e-b.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.hint.0: Kuqala bonisa f(0) no-f(4) ngokwe-b, uze ufumane uluhlu lwe-b apho izinga eliqhelekileyo loutshintsho lipozithivu.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha ixabiso e-1 le-b uze ufumane ukuba f'(x)=2x−b inegethivu phi ngaphakathi kwexesha.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.fail.c2: p kufuneka ibe nkulu kune-0 kwaye ibe ncinci kune-4.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.ok.c3: f'(p)=2p−b inegethivu, ngoko f iyehla kufutshane no-p.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.explain: f(4)−f(0)=16−4b, ngoko izinga eliqhelekileyo loutshintsho li-4−b. Ukuze lipozithivu, b<4, kwaye ukuze f'(x)=2x−b ibe negethivu kwindawo ethile ngaphakathi kwexesha, b>0 iyafuneka. Ngoko yonke b kunye no-0<b<4 inika umzekelo ochasayo. Umzekelo, ukuba b=2, ngoko f(x)=x²−2x iyehla kwi-[0, 1] kwaye inyuka kwi-[1, 4].
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Nangona imizekelo enjalo ikho, into yokuba izinga eliqhelekileyo loutshintsho lipozithivu asilulwazi lobuxoki. Chaza kwisivakalisi esi-1 okanye ezi-2 oko ungakwazi nokungakwazi ukukuxela ngezinga eliqhelekileyo loutshintsho elipozithivu.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Hlola kwakhona ukuba ngawaphi amaxabiso eendawo zexesha asetyenziswa xa kubalwa izinga eliqhelekileyo loutshintsho.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Thelekisa amaxabiso e-f(1), f(0), no-f(4), uze uzobe ukuba igrafu yahamba njani.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingaba uthe amaxabiso kuphela asetyenziswa lizinga eliqhelekileyo loutshintsho ngamaxabiso ezi ziphelo zimbini?
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingaba wahlule utshintsho ngaphakathi kwexesha kuthelekiso lweziphelo?
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Izinga eliqhelekileyo loutshintsho lisuka ekuthelekiseni amaxabiso ezi ziphelo zimbini kuphela, ngoko likuxelela kuphela ukuba f(4)>f(0). Nokuba igrafu iyehla naphi ukuya embindini, ipozithivu ukuba inyuka ngakumbi ngasekupheleni.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Ukuba izinga eliqhelekileyo loutshintsho lipozithivu, unokuxela ukuba ixabiso esiphelweni likhulu kunexabiso lokuqala, kodwa awukwazi ukuxela ukuba liyehla okwexeshana ngaphakathi kwexesha.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.prompt: Ukuba konke oukwaziyo kukuba izinga eliqhelekileyo loutshintsho lwe-f kwi-[0, 4] lipozithivu, yintoni enokuthiwa iyinyani ngokuqinisekileyo?
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ifomula yezinga eliqhelekileyo loutshintsho uze ucinge ngophawu lwenani elingaphantsi.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.hint.1: Vavanya ukuba ukhetho ngalunye luyinyani okanye asiyiyo ngokufaka kwimizekelo owayenzileyo kwi-s2.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.o.a: f'(x)>0 kuyo yonke i-x ngaphakathi kwexesha
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.r.a: Nokuba izinga eliqhelekileyo loutshintsho lipozithivu, f' inokuba negethivu kwindawo ethile ngaphakathi kwexesha.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.r.b: Kunokubakho inxalenye ehlayo, njengakumzekelo owenzileyo kwi-s2.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.o.c: f(x)>0 kuyo yonke i-x ngaphakathi kwexesha
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.r.c: Izinga eliqhelekileyo loutshintsho libonisa isixa sotshintsho, hayi uphawu lwamaxabiso omsebenzi.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.explain: Ukuba izinga eliqhelekileyo loutshintsho (f(4)−f(0))/(4−0) lipozithivu, inani elingaphantsi lipozithivu, ngoko f(4)−f(0) ipozithivu. Konke ongakwazi kukuthelekisa iziphelo.

n-m-h2-diff-03.title: Oko kuthetha ukuba iijika ezimbini zithintela kwindawo
n-m-h2-diff-03.goal: Fumana ukuba mangaphi amalingano anikwa yimeko "iijika ezimbini zithintela kwindawo," uze wahlule xa iimeko zingonelanga nalapho zonele.
n-m-h2-diff-03.material: Ijika y=f(x)=x³ nejika y=g(x)=x²+ax+b (a no-b ziimithamo ezingatshintshiyo) zithintela kwindawo (1, 1). (Oku kuthetha ukuba iijika ezimbini zidlula kwindawo e-1 kwaye zinethanjenti efanayo apho.) Ufuna ukufumana a no-b.
n-m-h2-diff-03.thinking.2: Ukuthelekisa inani leengxaki ezingaziwayo nenani lamalingano
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.prompt: Ngawaphi amalingano e-g ekufuneka uwamisele ukumisela a no-b?
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala njengamalingano iinyaniso ezimbini (indawo, ithambeka) ezifunekayo ukuze iijika ezimbini zithintele kwindawo.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.hint.1: Faka x=1 kwi-f(x)=x³ ukufumana ikhowudinethi ye-y yeendawo nethambeka lethanjenti.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.r.a: Imeko yokudlula kwindawo (1, 1) ilungile, kodwa g(0)=0 yimeko engekho engxakini.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.r.b: Imeko yokudlula kwi-(1, 1) ilungile, kodwa ithambeka kufuneka lijongwe kwindawo yokuthinta x=1, hayi x=0.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.r.d: Itshintshisile amaxabiso e-f(1) ne-f'(1). Kufuneka wahlule ikhowudinethi ye-y yendawo nethambeka lethanjenti.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.explain: Ijika g kufuneka lidlule kwindawo (1, 1), ngoko g(1)=1, kwaye ukuze amathanjenti afane, amathambeka kwi-x=1 kufuneka alingane nawo, ngoko g'(1)=f'(1)=3.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.prompt: Fumana amaxabiso e-a no-b, uze ubhale emgceni omnye ukuba uhlole njani ukuba amaxabiso owafumeneyo ayanelisa amalingano amabini amiswe kwi-s1.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.hint.0: Kuqala fumana g'(x), uze umisele ixabiso layo kwi-x=1 lilingane no-3.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.hint.1: Faka u-a owafumeneyo kulingano lokudlula kwindawo ufumane b.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ubhale imeko yethambeka nemeko yendawo nganye njengolingano?
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ufake u-a no-b owafumeneyo kumalingano omabini?
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.model.0: g'(x)=2x+a, ngoko g'(1)=2+a=3 inika a=1. Ukufaka a=1 kwi-g(1)=1+a+b=1 kunika b=−1. Ukuhlola, g(1)=1 kwaye g'(1)=3, ngoko kuchanekile.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.model.1: Ukusuka kwimeko yethambeka 2+a=3, a=1, kwaye ukusuka kwimeko yokudlula kwindawo, 1+1+b=1, ngoko b=−1. Ndihlolile ngokufaka umva kumalingano omabini.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.prompt: Ngeli xesha awuyazi indawo yokuthinta, kwaye uyazi kuphela ukuba iijika ezimbini y=x³ ne-y=x²+ax+b "zithintela kwindawo ethile." Kule meko, ingaba a no-b bamiselwe?
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.hint.0: Vumela t ibe yikhowudinethi ye-x yendawo yokuthinta uze ubhale amalingano amabini okuthinta.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.hint.1: Bala inani leengxaki ezingaziwayo nenani lamalingano uze uzithelekise.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.o.a: Akumiselwanga. Ikhowudinethi ye-x t yendawo yokuthinta nayo ayaziwa, ngoko kukho iingxaki ezi-3 ezingaziwayo kwaye ama-2 kuphela amalingano
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.o.b: Kumiselwe. Imeko yokuthinta inika amalingano amabini, ngoko a no-b banokufunyanwa
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.r.b: Ushiye ukuba, ekubeni indawo yokuthinta ayaziwa, ikhowudinethi yayo ye-x iba yingxaki entsha engaziwayo.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.o.c: Akumiselwanga. Imeko yokuthinta inika ulingano olunye kuphela
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.r.c: Imeko yokuthinta inika indawo nethambeka, oko kukuthi amalingano amabini. Ubale amalingano gwenxa.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.o.d: Kumiselwe. Ukuze kuthintelane b kufuneka ibe ngu-0, kwaye emva koko a nayo imiselwe ngokukodwa
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.r.d: Akukho sizathu engxakini sokuba b kufuneka ibe ngu-0. Ukuba indawo yokuthinta ayaziwa, b nayo inokwahluka.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.explain: Ukuba ikhowudinethi ye-x yendawo yokuthinta yi-t, ngoko t³=t²+at+b kwaye 3t²=2t+a, ngoko zikho amalingano amabini neengxaki ezingaziwayo ezintathu, a, b, no-t. Umzekelo, t=1 inika (a, b)=(1, −1) kwaye t=2 inika (a, b)=(8, −12); ngalo lonke ixesha t itshintsha, kuphuma (a, b) eyahlukileyo.

n-m-h2-diff-05.title: Ngaba umgca othinteleyo udibana nejika kuphela kwichaphaza lokuthinteleka?
n-m-h2-diff-05.goal: Vavanya ibango elithi "Umgca othinteleyo udibana nejika kuphela kwichaphaza lokuthinteleka" ngejika y=x³, uze ulungise intsingiselo yomgca othinteleyo njengomgca onethambeka eliyixabiso le-derivative.
n-m-h2-diff-05.material: UHajun uthi, "Umgca othinteleyo ngumgca odibana nejika kuphela kwichaphaza lokuthinteleka. Ukuba uzoba umgca othinteleyo kwaye udibana nejika kwakhona kwelinye ichaphaza, uzobe ithanjenti ngokungachanekanga." Ufuna ukuvavanya eli bango ngejika y=x³. (x³ ithetha u-x ikyubhu.)
n-m-h2-diff-05.thinking.1: Ukufumana amachaphaza okudibana omgca othinteleyo nejika kumachaphaza amaninzi okuthinteleka
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.prompt: Yeyiphi eyona ndlela ifanelekileyo yokuvavanya ibango likaHajun?
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.hint.0: Chaza ngamazwi ukuba umzekelo ophula ibango wawubonakala njani.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ukuba uthatha ichaphaza lokuthinteleka libe (a, a³), ungabhala ulingano lomgca othinteleyo ngokwe-a.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.o.a: Zoba umgca othinteleyo kwimvelaphi (0, 0) kuphela uze ukhangele apho udibana khona nejika
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.r.a: Ukukhangela ichaphaza elinye kuphela kusenokubonisa imizekelo ehambelana nebango kuphela. Uvavanyo kufuneka lujonge imizekelo apho ibango linokophuka.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.o.b: Phanda umgca othinteleyo kuphela kwindawo apho ithambeka lawo lingu-0
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.r.b: Ichaphaza elinethambeka u-0 liyichaphaza elikhethekileyo elinye, ngoko alimelanga ichaphaza lokuthinteleka eliqhelekileyo.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.o.c: Zoba umfanekiso ukhangele ngeliso ukuba umgca othinteleyo nejika kubonakala kunamathele na
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.r.c: Imilo ebonwa ngeliso kuphela ayinakuxela ukuba ayidibani kwakhona kude.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.o.d: Fumana imigca ethinteleyo kumachaphaza amaninzi okuthinteleka (a, a³) uze uphande amanye amachaphaza okudibana
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.explain: Ukuba ibango alichanekanga, kufuneka kubekho umgca othinteleyo odibana nejika nakwichaphaza elingelilo lokuthinteleka. Ukufumana omnye, kufuneka usete ulingano lomgca othinteleyo kumachaphaza amaninzi okuthinteleka, hayi amnye okanye amabini, uze ulisombulule kunye nejika.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.prompt: Fumana uze ufake izibini ezi-3 zamanani aphelele (a, b), namaxabiso ahlukeneyo ka-a, ukuze umgca othinteleyo kwichaphaza lokuthinteleka (a, a³) udibane nejika y=x³ kwakhona kwichaphaza (b, b³) elingelilo lokuthinteleka. (a ukusuka kwi-−5 ukuya kwi-5)
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ithambeka nolingano lomgca othinteleyo kwichaphaza lokuthinteleka (a, a³) ngokwe-a.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala ukuba luluphi ulingano lwe-b olufuneka lubambe ukuze ichaphaza (b, b³) lilale kulo mgca othinteleyo.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.hint.2: Faka ixabiso elinye elipheleleyo lika-a ngexesha ufumane u-b, uza kubona ipatheni ka-b.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.var.b: ikhowudinethi ye-x b yelinye ichaphaza lokudibana
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.ok.c1: a no-b ngamanani aphelele aphakathi koluhlu.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.fail.c1: a kufuneka libe linani elipheleleyo ukusuka kwi-−5 ukuya kwi-5, kwaye b kufuneka libe linani elipheleleyo nalo.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Ukuba b ilingana no-a, lichaphaza lokuthinteleka ngokwalo.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Ichaphaza (b, b³) alikho kumgca othinteleyo y=3a²x−2a³.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.explain: Umgca othinteleyo kwichaphaza lokuthinteleka (a, a³) yi-y=3a²x−2a³. Ukuwusombulula kunye nejika kunika x³−3a²x+2a³=(x−a)²(x+2a)=0, ngoko x=a (ichaphaza lokuthinteleka, ingcambu ephindiweyo) no-x=−2a. Ukuba a≠0, ngoko −2a yahlukile ku-a, ngoko umgca othinteleyo udibana nejika kwakhona kwichaphaza elingelilo lokuthinteleka.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.prompt: Phendula uHajun. Ngaba ibango likaHajun lichanekile? Chaza usebenzisa umzekelo ongentla njengobungqina, uze uthi ngokuchanekileyo umgca othinteleyo yintoni.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.hint.0: Khetha omnye wemizekelo oyenzileyo kwi-s2 uze ubhale onke amachaphaza apho umgca othinteleyo udibana khona nejika.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.hint.1: Yithi "ithanjenti" ngokwethambeka, hayi ngokwenani lamachaphaza okudibana.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba unike umzekelo othile (ichaphaza lokuthinteleka nelinye ichaphaza lokudibana elahlukileyo)?
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba ukhuphe ukungaqondi oku njengento eyenzeka kuphela kweli jika?
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.model.0: Akulunganga. Umzekelo, kwi-y=x³, umgca othinteleyo y=3x−2 kwi-(1, 1) udibana nejika nakwi-x=−2. Umgca othinteleyo ngumgca onethambeka eliyixabiso le-derivative kwichaphaza lokuthinteleka, kwaye usengumgca othinteleyo nokuba udibana nejika kwakhona kwelinye ichaphaza.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.model.1: Hayi. Umgca othinteleyo ngumgca othinta ijika ecaleni kwechaphaza lokuthinteleka (ithambeka lawo yi-derivative kuloo chaphaza), ngoko unokunqumla ijika kwakhona kude. Umzekelo, umgca othinteleyo kwi-(1, 1) udlula nakwichaphaza (−2, −8).

n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.ok.c1: a no-b ngamanani aphelele aphakathi koluhlu.
n-m-h2-diff-06.title: Ukwakha umsebenzi wekyubhiki onamaxabiso awo amabini aphakamileyo zombini zenzeka kwi-x>0
n-m-h2-diff-06.topic: Amaxabiso aphakamileyo omsebenzi wekyubhiki neengcambu ze-derivative yawo
n-m-h2-diff-06.goal: Guqula imeko yeendawo zamaxabiso aphakamileyo ibe yimeko yeengcambu ze-derivative, uze wakhe wedwa imisebenzi emininzi yekyubhiki enelisa zonke iimeko.
n-m-h2-diff-06.material: Ufuna ukwakha umsebenzi f(x)=x³+ax²+bx (a no-b ngamanani aphelele) onobuninzi belokishi nobuncinane belokishi, apho amaxabiso ka-x anika ezo zinto ziphakamileyo zombini epositivu. (ax² ithetha u-a ixesha u-x isikwere.)
n-m-h2-diff-06.thinking.0: Ukuguqulela imeko yegrafu ibe yimeko yeengcambu ze-derivative
n-m-h2-diff-06.thinking.1: Ukufumana isizathu sokuba imeko enye kuphela ayonelanga
n-m-h2-diff-06.prereq.1: I-discriminant yolingano lwesikwere neempawu zeengcambu zalo
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.prompt: Le meko iba yintoni xa ichazwa njengemeko kwi-derivative f'(x)=3x²+2ax+b?
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala ukuba i-derivative ithatha lixabiso lini kwi-x apho ixabiso eliphakamileyo lenzeka, nokuba uphawu lwayo luziphatha njani ngaphambi nasemva.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.hint.1: Bala ukuba zingaphi ezo x ezifunekayo ukuze kubekho ubuninzi belokishi nobuncinane belokishi.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.o.a: Ulingano f'(x)=0 lunezingcambu zokwenyani ezimbini ezahlukeneyo ezipositivu
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.o.b: Ulingano f'(x)=0 lunengcambu enye yokwenyani epositivu ubuncinane
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.r.b: Ukuba kukho ingcambu enye kuphela yokwenyani epositivu, kukho ixabiso elinye kuphela eliphakamileyo, okanye enye ingcambu isenokungabi pozitivu.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.r.c: Ngoko f iqhubeka inyuka kwisithuba esipositivu kwaye ayinamaxabiso aphakamileyo.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.r.d: Ngengcambu ephindiweyo, uphawu lwe-derivative aluguquki, ngoko akukho xabiso liphakamileyo lenzekayo.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.explain: I-x enika ixabiso eliphakamileyo yingcambu ye-f'(x)=0 apho uphawu lwe-f' luguquka ngaphambi nasemva. Ukuze kubekho ubuninzi belokishi nobuncinane belokishi, kufuneka iingcambu zokwenyani ezimbini ezahlukeneyo, kwaye zozibini ezo ngcambu kufuneka zibe pozitivu.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.prompt: Faka izibini ezi-3 ezahlukeneyo zamanani aphelele (a, b) ezinje ngokuba kwi-f(x)=x³+ax²+bx, f'(x)=0 inezingcambu zokwenyani ezimbini ezahlukeneyo ezipositivu. (Amaxabiso epheleleyo ka-a no-b angaphantsi okanye alingana no-20.)
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala isixa kunye nemveliso yeengcambu ezimbini zolingano lwesikwere 3x²+2ax+b=0 ngokwe-a ne-b.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.hint.1: Cinga ukuba iimpawu zesixa nemveliso kuphela zanele ukuthi iingcambu ziyinyani.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.hint.2: Khetha a inegethivu kuqala, uze utshintshe b ukhangele ngqo ukuba zikhona iingcambu.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.fail.c1: a no-b kufuneka babe ngamanani aphelele anexabiso epheleleyo elingadluli ku-20.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.ok.c2: Iingcambu ezimbini ze-3x²+2ax+b=0 ngamanani okwenyani ahlukeneyo.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.ok.c3: Isixa nemveliso yeengcambu ezimbini zombini zipositivu.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Isixa (−2a/3) nemveliso (b/3) yeengcambu ezimbini azipositivu zombini.
