n-m-h2-diff-07.title: Umthamo webhokisi eyenziwe ngokunqumla iikona
n-m-h2-diff-07.topic: Ukukhetha okona kulungileyo: uluhlu oluvunyelweyo ne-derivative
n-m-h2-diff-07.goal: Kwisisombululo esifumana ichaphaza apho i-derivative ingu-0, fumana umgca ongakhange ucinge ngoluhlu oluvunyelweyo olumiselwe yingxaki, uze ufumane ixabiso eliphakamileyo kwakhona phakathi koko luhlu.
n-m-h2-diff-07.material: Kwikona nganye kwezine zephepha elisikwere elineecm ezili-12 ecaleni, nqumla isikwere esincinane esine-x cm ecaleni, ulisonge wenze ibhokisi engenasigqubuthelo. Iphepha lijiliyo, ngoko isikwere esincinane sinokunqunyulwa kuphela xa icala laso lingaphezulu kuno-1.5 cm. Esi sisisombululo sikaEunseo sokufumana ukuba umthamo webhokisi mkhulu xa nini.
n-m-h2-diff-07.thinking.0: Ukuthelekisa iimeko zengxaki noluhlu olusetyenzisiweyo kwisisombululo
n-m-h2-diff-07.thinking.2: Ukuchaza ukuba ixabiso eliphakamileyo lenzeka nini esiphelweni
n-m-h2-diff-07.prereq.1: Ubuninzi nobuncinane kwisithuba esivaliweyo (okanye esivaliwe ngandlelanye)
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca wokuqala ophosakeleyo kwisisombululo sikaEunseo.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.hint.0: Phawula zonke iimeko kumbhalo wengxaki uze ukhangele ukuba umgca ngamnye wesisombululo uzisebenzisile na.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.hint.1: Fumana umgca apho uluhlu lwe-x luvela kuqala uze uluthelekise nemeko yengxaki.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.line.0: Isiseko sisikwere esinecala 12−2x kwaye ubude bungu-x, ngoko umthamo yi-V(x)=x(12−2x)².
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.line.3: Ukuze isiseko sibekho, 12−2x>0, ngoko 0<x<6, kwaye koluhlu olu kuphela ugqatso lungu-x=2.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.line.4: Kuba uphawu lwe-V'(x) luguquka lusuka kupositivu lusiya kunegethivu malunga ne-x=2, V(2) lixabiso eliphakamileyo.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.explain: Umgca wesi-4 ngowokuqala ophosakeleyo. Ingxaki yathi isikwere sinokunqunyulwa kuphela xa u-x ungaphezulu kuno-1.5, kodwa isisombululo sathatha uluhlu 0<x<6 kwimeko yobukho besiseko kuphela. Imigca yesi-5 neyesi-6 ilandela uluhlu lomgca wesi-4, ngoko isiphumo siyatshintsha. Amagama nokubala kwemigca eyi-1 ukuya kwesi-3 kuchanekile.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s2.prompt: Kuluhlu olulungileyo lwe-x, leliphi ixabiso lika-x elenza u-V(x) abe mkhulu kakhulu?
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala uluhlu olulungileyo lwe-x uze ucinge ngophawu lwe-V'(x) koluhlu olo.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s2.hint.1: Ukuba u-V uyanyuka, cinga ukuba elona xabiso likhulu koluhlu liza kwenzeka phi.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s2.r.a: Likhona ichaphaza apho i-derivative yi-0, kodwa lingaphandle kobubanzi bengxaki, ngoko alinakwenziwa ngokwenene.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s2.r.b: Ichaphaza elikwiphakathi lobubanzi, kodwa asilo apho ubuninzi benzeka khona.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s2.r.d: Ikhethe ixabiso eliphakathi lobubanzi. Kufuneka uphonononge ukonyuka/ukwehla ukuze wazi apho ubuninzi benzeka khona.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s2.explain: Kwi-0<x≤1.5, V'(x)=12(x−2)(x−6)>0, ngoko V iqhubeka ikonyuka. Ngoko ubuninzi bukwindawo yokuphela esekunene yobubanzi, x=1.5.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s3.prompt: Fumana umthamo omkhulu ngesisombululo esichanekileyo, uze ubhale kwizivakalisi ezinye okanye ezibini isizathu sokuba ubuninzi benzeke kwichaphaza elingelilo apho V'(x)=0.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s3.hint.0: Beka x=1.5 kwifomula uze ubale umthamo.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s3.hint.1: Khangela ukuba i-x enoV'(x)=0 ikwiphakathi kobubanzi obuvumelekileyo na.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ubhale kwakhona ububanzi obuvumelekileyo njenge-0<x≤1.5?
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ukhangele ukuba i-V iyonyuka okanye iyehla ngaphakathi kobubanzi?
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s3.model.0: Kwi-0<x≤1.5, V'(x)>0, ngoko V iqhubeka ikonyuka, yaye ubuninzi bukwindawo yokuphela esekunene x=1.5. V(1.5)=1.5×81=121.5 cm³. x=2 ingaphandle kobubanzi.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s3.model.1: Xa x=3/2, umthamo (3/2)×9²=243/2=121.5 cm³ bubona buninzi. Kobu bubanzi V iqhubeka ikonyuka, ngoko ichaphaza apho V'(x)=0 alikho kubo bubanzi.

n-m-h2-diff-08.title: Ngexesha apho ukukhawuleza kuyi-0, ngaba ichaphaza litshintsha icala?
n-m-h2-diff-08.topic: Isantya kunye nelicala lokushukuma: utshintsho lwendawo kunye nomgama ohanjiweyo
n-m-h2-diff-08.goal: Hlula amaxesha apho icala lokushukuma kwechaphaza elishukuma emgceni wamanani litshintsha kumaxesha apho ukukhawuleza kuyi-0, uze uthathe isigqibo usebenzisa utshintsho lwempawu yesantya.
n-m-h2-diff-08.material: Indawo yechaphaza P elishukuma emgceni wamanani ngexesha t (0≤t≤4) yi-x(t)=t³−6t²+9t. Isantya yi-x'(t) yaye ukukhawuleza yi-x''(t). U-Jimin uthi, "Ku-t=2 ukukhawuleza kuyi-0. Ngexesha apho ukukhawuleza kuyi-0, P itshintsha icala." (t³ kuthetha t ikyubhu.)
n-m-h2-diff-08.thinking.1: Ukwahlula ixesha apho ukukhawuleza kuyi-0 kwixesha apho icala litshintsha khona
n-m-h2-diff-08.prereq.0: Ubudlelwane phakathi kwendawo, isantya, nokukhawuleza (i-derivative yendawo, i-derivative yesantya)
n-m-h2-diff-08.prereq.1: Ukwahlula intetho yekyubhu ibe zizinto ezibalayo
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.prompt: Ukuvavanya ukuba isibakala sika-Jimin silungile na, yintoni omawuyiphonononge kuqala?
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.hint.0: Cinga ngendlela impawu yesantya eyahluka ngayo xa ichaphaza lisiya ekunene nxa lisiya ekhohlo.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.hint.1: Yahlula x(t) ukuze ufumane isantya, uze ufake amaxabiso ngaphambi nje kwe-t=2 nasemva nje kwayo.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.o.a: Khangela ukuba izinga eliphakathi lotshintsho kwixesha [0, 4] lilungile na
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.r.a: Izinga eliphakathi lotshintsho nalo lithelekisa kuphela iindawo ezimbini zokuphela, ngoko alisixeleli ngokushukuma okuphakathi.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.o.b: Fumana ukuba yeyiphi indawo x(2) ku-t=2
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.r.b: Ukwazi ixabiso lendawo akusixeleli ukuba icala lokushukuma litshintsha ngaphambi nasemva kwayo.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.o.c: Jonga ukuba iimpawu zesantya v(t)=x'(t) ngaphambi nje nasemva nje kwe-t=2 ziyahluka na
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.o.d: Phinda ubale ukuba ukukhawuleza x''(2)=0 kuchanekile ngokwenene
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.r.d: Ukuba ukukhawuleza kuyi-0 sele kunikiwe. Okufuna ukuvavanywa kukuba oko kuthetha utshintsho lwecala na.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.explain: Icala lapho ichaphaza lishukuma khona likhethwa yimpawu yesantya. Ukuze icala litshintshe, impawu yesantya kufuneka yahluke ngaphambi nasemva, yaye inyani yokuba ukukhawuleza kuyi-0 yodwa ayisixeleli oko.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s2.prompt: Khetha onke amaxesha kwi-0≤t≤4 apho icala lokushukuma kwechaphaza P litshintsha khona.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s2.hint.0: Fumana ngokwakho isantya v(t)=x'(t) uze ubale impawu yaso ku-t=0, 2, kunye no-4.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s2.hint.1: Khangela ukuba impawu iyatshintsha ngaphambi nje nasemva nje kwamaxesha apho isantya siyi-0.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s2.r.b: Ku-t=2 ukukhawuleza kuyi-0, kodwa isantya sisi-−3, ngoko ichaphaza liqhubeka lishukuma ekhohlo. Icala alitshintshi.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s2.r.d: Lixesha lokuphela kobubanzi, yaye isantya ngelo xesha sisi-9, esiyipositivu. Alilo ixesha apho icala litshintsha khona.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s2.explain: x'(t)=3t²−12t+9=3(t−1)(t−3), ngoko isantya siyi-0 ku-t=1 nango-3, yaye impawu iyatshintsha ngaphambi nasemva kwala maxesha (positivu ukuya kunegetivu ukuya kupositivu). t=2 lixesha nje apho ukukhawuleza x''(t)=6t−12 kulingana ne-0.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.prompt: Phendula u-Jimin. Chaza, usebenzisa ixabiso lesantya, isizathu sokuba P ingatshintshi icala nangona ukukhawuleza kuyi-0 ku-t=2, uze uxele ukuba icala litshintsha nini.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.hint.0: Bala ngokwakho ixabiso lesantya v(2) ku-t=2.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.hint.1: Fumana amaxesha apho isantya siyi-0 uze uthelekise indlela impawu yesantya eyahluka ngayo ngaphambi nje nasemva nje kwawo.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ubale isantya ku-t=2 ngokwakho waza wahlola impawu yaso?
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uhlule amaxesha apho impawu yesantya itshintsha khona kumaxesha apho ukukhawuleza kuyi-0?
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba uchaze ngamaxabiso ukuba isibakala silahlekile kutheni?
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.model.0: Kuyinyani ukuba ukukhawuleza kuyi-0 ku-t=2, kodwa isantya v(2)=3·4−12·2+9=−3 singunegetivu, ngoko P iqhubeka ishukuma ekhohlo. Icala litshintsha xa impawu yesantya itshintsha, yaye ekubeni v(t)=3(t−1)(t−3), litshintsha ku-t=1 nango-t=3.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.model.1: Xa ukukhawuleza kuyi-0, lixesha nje apho isantya singehli okanye sonyuke. Ku-t=2 isantya sisi-−3, ngoko icala alitshintshi, yaye icala litshintsha ku-t=1 nango-t=3, apho isantya siba yi-0 yaye impawu yaso itshintsha.

n-m-h2-diff-09.title: Ububanzi bakwa-a obuthi umsebenzi uhlale uyonyuka
n-m-h2-diff-09.topic: Ii-derivative nokonyuka: umda apho ukulingana kufakwe khona
n-m-h2-diff-09.goal: Xa uguqulela imeko yokuba umsebenzi uyonyuka kuwo onke amanani aphelele aziwayo kwimeko yempawu ye-derivative, vavanya ngokwahlukileyo amaxabiso omda (apho i-derivative iyi-0 kwichaphaza elinye), uze ubhale isiphumo njengenqaku kumfundi omncinci.
n-m-h2-diff-09.material: Esi sisisombululo sika-Soeun, umfundi omncinci, ofumene ububanzi bomgangatho oqhelekileyo a apho umsebenzi f(x)=x³+ax²+3x uyonyuka kuwo onke amanani aziwayo. U-Soeun wasibonisa ngokuziqhayisa esi sisombululo. (x³ kuthetha x ikyubhu kwaye ax² kuthetha a ephindaphindwe nge-x isikwere.)
n-m-h2-diff-09.thinking.0: Ukufumana umgca apho imeko yasetyenziswa ngamandla ngokugqithisileyo kwisisombululo
n-m-h2-diff-09.thinking.2: Ukubhala kwakhona ukuze umfundi omncinci akwazi ukulandela
n-m-h2-diff-09.prereq.1: Imeko (i-discriminant) yokuba ukungalingani kwekhwadratiki kubambe kuwo onke amanani aziwayo
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca wokuqala ongalunganga kwisisombululo sika-Soeun.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.hint.0: Khangela ngamnye ukuba umgca ngamnye uvela kumgca osondele ngaphambi kwawo ngesiphi isizathu.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuba "iyonyuka" kunye ne "i-derivative ipositivu" zithetha into enye na.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.line.1: Ukuze f ionyuke kuwo onke amanani aziwayo, f'(x)>0 kufuneka ibambe kuwo onke ama-x aziwayo.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.line.2: Ukuba D yi-discriminant ye-f'(x)=0, kufuneka D/4=a²−9<0.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.explain: Umgca wesi-2 ngowokuqala ohamba gwenxa. Ukuze umsebenzi uonyuke, f'(x)≥0 iyaneleza; akufuneki ibe yi-f'(x)>0. Ukuba f'(x) iyi-0 kwichaphaza elinye kuphela yaye ipositivu kwenye indawo, umsebenzi usaqhubeka uyonyuka ngelo chaphaza. Imigca yesi-3 neyesi-4 ilandela umgca wesi-2, ngoko umda uphosakele kububanzi obuveliswayo.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.prompt: Ufuna ukuhlola ukuba f iyonyuka kuwo onke amanani aziwayo xa a=3, okukumda. Yeyiphi indlela efaneleke kakhulu?
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.hint.0: Beka a=3 kwi-f(x) uze uyahlule ibe zizinto ezibalayo, okanye uyibhale kwakhona kwifom yesikwere esipheleleyo okanye yekyubhu epheleleyo.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala ukuba impawu ye-f' yintoni ngaphambi nje nasemva nje kwechaphaza apho f'(x) iyi-0.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.o.a: Gweba ukuba ayonyuki, kuba ku-a=3 kukho x ene-f'(x)=0
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.r.a: Nokuba i-derivative iyi-0 kwichaphaza elinye, umsebenzi uyonyuka ukuba impawu yayo ayitshintshi ngaphambi nasemva. Kufuneka uhlole ngaphambi kokugweba.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.o.b: Cinga ukuba akukho khangelo lwahlukileyo lufunekayo, kuba lixabiso elingaphandle kwe-−3<a<3
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.r.b: Ukuba lixabiso lomda okanye hayi kuyo kanye imbuzo, ngoko ukuhlola kuyafuneka.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.r.c: Impawu yechaphaza elinye ayinakugqiba ukuba f iyonyuka na kuwo onke amanani aziwayo.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.o.d: Beka a=3, yenza f(x) ibe lula, uze ubuke imo yegrafu
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.explain: Ukuba a=3, ngoko f(x)=x³+3x²+3x=(x+1)³−1. Igrafu yefom (x+1)³ inethambeka le-0 ku-x=−1 kodwa iqhubeka ikonyuka. f'(x)=3(x+1)²≥0, yaye ichaphaza lodwa apho iyi-0 yi-x=−1.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.prompt: Bhala inqaku lokuthunyelwa ku-Soeun. Khankanya into enye elungileyo ngomsebenzi ka-Soeun, uze uchaze eyiphi inxalenye ekufuneka ilungiswe kunye nendlela, usebenzisa umzekelo a=3, ukuze unike ububanzi obulungileyo bukwa-a.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ufumane into enye u-Soeun ayenze kakuhle.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.hint.1: Ukuba ubhala kwinqaku ukuba f'(x) ithatha imo yantoni xa a=3, kuya kuba lula ku-Soeun ukuqonda.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba uchaze ngokucacileyo oko kwenziwe kakuhle?
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ubonise ukuba ngowuphi umgca owawungalunganga nokuba kutheni, usebenzisa umzekelo a=3?
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.model.0: Soeun, kwakulungile ukuba ubhale i-discriminant! Kodwa f'(x)≥0 iyaneleza, hayi f'(x)>0. Xa a=3, f(x)=(x+1)³−1, ngoko f'(x)=0 kwichaphaza elinye kuphela, x=−1, yaye umsebenzi uqhubeka ukonyuka. Ngoko −3≤a≤3.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.model.1: Ubhale impendulo njenge-−3<a<3, akunjalo? Khangela ukuba iindawo zokuphela a=±3 nazo zisebenza na. Ukuba ufaka a=3, f(x)=(x+1)³−1, ngumsebenzi onyukayo. Nokuba f' iyi-0 kwichaphaza elinye, umsebenzi usaqhubeka wonyuka okoko nje impawu ingatshintshi macala omabini alo, ngoko kufuneka ufake uphawu lokulingana ubhale −3≤a≤3.

n-m-h2-diff-10.title: Ngaba sinokufumana ixabiso lobuninzi belokishi ukuba siyayazi kuphela i-derivative?
n-m-h2-diff-10.topic: Esinokukufunda nesingakwazi ukukufunda kulwazi lwe-derivative: indima yelungu eliqhelekileyo
n-m-h2-diff-10.goal: Khangela ukuba ukwazi kuphela i-derivative kukwazisa imo yomsebenzi (apho yonyuka okanye yehla khona nalapho amaxabiso agqithisileyo enzeka khona) kodwa hayi indawo yawo emi nkqo (ubungakanani bamaxabiso agqithisileyo), uze ukhombe ulwazi olongezelelekileyo olufunekayo.
n-m-h2-diff-10.material: I-derivative yomsebenzi wekyubhu f(x) yaziwa ukuba yi-f'(x)=3x²−12. Sifuna ukufumana ixabiso lobuninzi belokishi lika-f, kodwa asiyazi i-f(x) ngokwayo. (3x² kuthetha 3 iphindaphindwe nge-x isikwere.)
n-m-h2-diff-10.thinking.0: Ukwahlula oko i-derivative isixelela kona nokuyingasixeleli
n-m-h2-diff-10.thinking.1: Ukugweba ukuba ulwazi olongezelelekileyo luluncedo kangakanani
n-m-h2-diff-10.thinking.2: Ukusebenzisa ulwazi ukufumana ixabiso lobuninzi belokishi
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke iziqwenga zolwazi apho, ukuba wawazi esinye sazo ngaphezulu, wawunokuchaza ixabiso lobuninzi belokishi lika-f.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.hint.0: Ukusuka kwi-f'(x), bhala ukuba i-f(x) ithatha imo yantoni. Ikhona inxalenye engachazwanga?
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.hint.1: Khangela, ukhetho olunye ngexesha, ukuba luyayichaza loo nxalenye ingachazwanga.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.r.a: Ukuba uyalazi ixabiso elinye lomsebenzi, ilungu eliqhelekileyo liyachazwa, ngoko yonke i-f iyachazwa.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.r.d: Ukuba uyalazi ixabiso elinye lomsebenzi, ilungu eliqhelekileyo liyachazwa, ngoko yonke i-f iyachazwa.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.r.b: Eli xabiso sele lifumaneka ngokufaka x=1 kwi-f'(x)=3x²−12, ngoko alulolwazi olutsha.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.r.c: Olu lwazi lunokufumaneka kwi-f'(x)=3x²−12 yodwa, ngoko alulolwazi olutsha.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.explain: Ukuba f'(x)=3x²−12, ngoko f(x)=x³−12x+C (C ngumgangatho oqhelekileyo). Iikhowudinethi ze-x zobuninzi nobuncinci belokishi (x=−2, 2) ziyachazwa, kodwa ixabiso lobuninzi belokishi f(−2)=16+C liyachazwa kuphela xa C ichaziwe. Ukuchaza u-C, ufuna ixabiso lika-f (ixabiso lomsebenzi). Ulwazi malunga ne-derivative lufana nolwazi esinalo sele.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.prompt: Unikwe ulwazi olongezelelekileyo lokuba ixabiso lobuncinci belokishi lika-f li-−10. Fumana ixabiso lobuninzi belokishi lika-f uze ubhale indlela oyifumene ngayo.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.hint.0: Sebenzisa impawu ye-derivative ukuthatha isigqibo sokuba ubuncinci belokishi benzeka kwiphi ixabiso lika-x.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.hint.1: Faka loo x kwifomula ye-f(x) uze useke ukulingana kumgangatho oqhelekileyo C.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba uqale wafumana amaxabiso ka-x apho ubuninzi nobuncinci belokishi benzeka khona?
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba usebenzise ixabiso lobuncinci belokishi ukuchaza ilungu eliqhelekileyo?
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.model.0: Singabhala f(x)=x³−12x+C (C ngumgangatho oqhelekileyo). Ubuncinci belokishi bukwi-x=2, yaye f(2)=C−16=−10, ngoko C=6. Ubuninzi belokishi bukwi-x=−2, yaye f(−2)=16+C=22.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.model.1: Ukwenza i-integral ye-f' akuchazi ilungu eliqhelekileyo, kodwa ukusebenzisa inyani yokuba ixabiso lobuncinci belokishi li-−10 kuchaza ilungu eliqhelekileyo njengo-6. Ubuninzi belokishi bukwi-x=−2, yaye f(−2)=−8+24+6=22.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.prompt: Imisebenzi emibini yekyubhu f no-g inee-derivative ezifanayo, yaye f(0)−g(0)=6. Liliphi ixabiso lobuninzi belokishi lika-f kuthabathwe ixabiso lobuninzi belokishi lika-g?
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.hint.0: Ukuba f'=g', bhala okwenzekayo xa uyahlula f(x)−g(x).
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.hint.1: Cinga ukuba loo mahluko utshintsha no-x okanye ngumgangatho oqhelekileyo.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.r.a: Uthathe ukuba ii-derivative ezilinganayo zithetha amaxabiso alinganayo obuninzi belokishi. Ukuba amalungu aqhelekileyo ahlukile, ubungakanani bamaxabiso agqithisileyo buyahluka nabo.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.r.c: Wongeze umahluko wamalungu aqhelekileyo kabini. Kubuninzi belokishi, umahluko usese-6.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.explain: Ukuba f'=g', ngoko f(x)−g(x) ngumgangatho oqhelekileyo, yaye ekubeni f(0)−g(0)=6, f(x)−g(x)=6 kuwo onke ama-x. Ubuninzi belokishi benzeka kwi-x efanayo kuzo zombini, ngoko umahluko wamaxabiso obuninzi belokishi nawo yi-6.

n-m-h2-diff-11.title: Ukwenza ukungalingani okubambe kwi-x>0
n-m-h2-diff-11.topic: Ukungqina ukungalingani: ukumisela ixesha kunye nemeko yokulingana
n-m-h2-diff-11.goal: Fumana ixabiso elincinci usebenzisa ukwahlula ukuze wakhe ngokwakho ukungalingani okuhlangabezana neemeko, uze uchaze isizathu sokuba ukumisela indawo yokusebenza kutshintsha isiphumo.
n-m-h2-diff-11.material: a linani eliphelele lepositivu yaye k linani eliphelele. Sifuna ukukhetha a no-k ukuze ukungalingani x³+k≥3a²x kuhlale kubambe kwi-x epositivu, yaye ukulingana kubambe kwezinye ii-x ezipositivu. (3a²x kuthetha 3 iphindaphindwe nge-a isikwere iphindaphindwe nge-x.)
n-m-h2-diff-11.thinking.0: Ukuguqula ukungalingani kube yimeko yexabiso elincinci lomsebenzi omnye
n-m-h2-diff-11.thinking.1: Ukwenza imeko apho ukulingana kubambe khona
n-m-h2-diff-11.prereq.0: Amaxabiso agqithisileyo kunye namaxabiso amancinci usebenzisa ii-derivative
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.prompt: Ukuba sivumela h(x)=x³−3a²x+k, le meko iba yiphi ipropathi ye-h(x) kwi-x>0?
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.hint.0: Phinda uchaze "ukungalingani kuhlala kubambe" njengesitatimenti ngexabiso elincinci lika-h(x).
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.hint.1: Ithini "kukho x apho ukulingana kubambe khona" ngelo xabiso lincinci?
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.r.a: Ukuba ixabiso elikhulu li-0, ngoko h(x)≤0, ngoko ukungalingani kuya kwelinye icala.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.r.b: Ngoko kukho x ene-h(x)<0, ngoko ukungalingani kuyasilela.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.r.c: Oko kujonga ipropathi ye-h', hayi ye-h. Ukungalingani kumalunga namaxabiso ka-h.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.explain: Ukuze h(x)≥0 ihlale ibambe kwi-x>0, ixabiso elincinci kufuneka libe li-0 okanye ngaphezulu, yaye ukuze kubekho x apho ukulingana kubambe khona, ixabiso elincinci kufuneka libe li-0 kanye.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.prompt: Faka izibini ezintathu (a, k) eziyanelisa iimeko, ezinamaxabiso amathathu ahlukeneyo ka-a. (a linani eliphelele ukusuka ku-1 ukuya ku-10.)
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.hint.0: Fumana x epositivu apho h'(x)=0, uze uhlole impawu ye-h' macala omabini alo.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala ixabiso lika-h kuloo x ngo-a no-k, uze ufumane k eyenza ibe li-0.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.ok.c1: a linani eliphelele elisuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-10, kwaye k linani eliphelele nalo.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.fail.c1: a kufuneka ibe linani eliphelele elisuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-10, kwaye k kufuneka ibe linani eliphelele nayo.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.ok.c2: Ixabiso eliphantsi lika-h kwa-x>0 li-0 ngqo.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.explain: h'(x)=3x²−3a²=3(x−a)(x+a), kwaye kwa-x>0, h itshintsha ukusuka kokuhla ukuya kokonyuka kwa-x=a, ngoko inexabiso eliphantsi h(a)=k−2a³. Ukuba eli xabiso ngu-0, ukungalingani kuhlala kusebenza kwaye ukulingana kusebenza kwa-x=a. Ngoko k=2a³.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.prompt: Chaza kwisivakalisi esinye nganye okwenzekayo xa k incinci kune-2a³ nalapho k inkulu kune-2a³.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.hint.0: Thelekisa indlela ixabiso lika-h kwa-x=a litshintsha ngayo ngo-k, usebenzisa k=2a³ njengesalathiso.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.hint.1: Ukungalingani kuhlala kusebenza nokulingana kusebenza zizinto ezahlukeneyo.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ngaba uchaze imeko encinci nenkulu ngokwahlukeneyo?
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.model.0: Ukuba k incinci kune-2a³, h ithabatha kwa-x=a, ngoko ukungalingani kuyaphosisa. Ukuba k inkulu kune-2a³, ixabiso eliphantsi likhulu kune-0, ngoko ukungalingani kuyasebenza, kodwa akukho x apho ukulingana kusebenza khona.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.model.1: Ukuba k<2a³, ixabiso eliphantsi lincinci kune-0, ngoko kukho x apho ukungalingani kungasebenzi. Ukuba k>2a³, kuhlala kusebenza, kodwa ixabiso eliphantsi likhulu kune-0, ngoko akukho x ebonakalisa ngokongeza apho ukulingana kusebenza khona.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.prompt: Ingaba ikho ibini (a, k) apho ukungalingani okufanayo x³+k≥3a²x kusebenza hayi kuphela kwa-x ebonakalisa ngokongeza kodwa kuzo zonke x eziyinyani?
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.hint.0: Qikelela uphawu lwe-h(x) xa x ilinani elincinci kakhulu elithabathayo, elifana ne-−10 okanye −100.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.hint.1: Cinga ukuba isiphumo esihlolwe kuphela kumanani abonakalisa ngokongeza siyandiswa ngokuzenzekelayo kumanani athabathayo na.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.o.a: Hayi. Xa x iba ncinci kakhulu (ithabatha), icala lasekhohlo liba lincinci kune-3a²x
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.o.b: Ewe. Ngo-k=2a³ efunyenwe ngentla, isebenza kuzo zonke x eziyinyani
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.r.b: Uhlole kuphela k=2a³ kwa-x>0 awuhlolanga ukuba isebenza kwa-x<0. Iyaphosisa xa x ilinani elincinci kakhulu elithabathayo.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.o.c: Ewe. Ukuba ukhetha k enkulu ngokwaneleyo, isebenza kuwo onke amanani eyinyani
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.r.c: Xa x iba ncinci kakhulu (ithabatha), x³ ehla ngokukhawuleza kakhulu kune-k, ngoko iyaphosisa nokuba wenza k ibe nkulu kangakanani.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.o.d: Hayi. Ukuba ufaka x=0, ukungalingani sele kuyaphosisa
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.r.d: Ukuba x=0, sidinga k≥0, kwaye kuba k=2a³>0, iyasebenza.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.explain: h(x)=x³−3a²x+k iya ku-−∞ njengoko x iba ithabatha ngakumbi nangakumbi. Ngoko nokuba ukhetha k njani, kukho x ene-h(x)<0. Kuba sinciphise kwa-x ebonakalisa ngokongeza, ibini (a, k) elanelisa imeko lalikho.

n-m-h2-explog-01.title: Ukuhlola isisombululo esibale ingcambu yesikwere sisebenzisa imithetho yezichazi
n-m-h2-explog-01.goal: Fumana umgca wokuqala ophosisayo kwisisombululo esisebenzisa imithetho yezichazi, uphonononge iimeko apho lo mthetho unokusetyenziswa khona ukufumana ixabiso elichanekileyo.
n-m-h2-explog-01.material: U-Hayun ufumene ixabiso le-√((−3)²) esebenzisa imithetho yezichazi. ((−3)² sisikwere se-−3, kwaye ukunyusa kumandla 1/2 kuthetha okufanayo nokuthatha ingcambu yesikwere. Masivumelane ukuba isichazi samaqhezu sichazwa kuphela xa iseko libonakalisa ngokongeza.)
n-m-h2-explog-01.thinking.0: Ukulandela isisombululo ukuya esiphelweni nokufumana umgca wokuqala ophosisayo
n-m-h2-explog-01.thinking.2: Ukuphonononga iimeko apho umthetho usebenza khona
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca wokuqala ongachanekanga kwisisombululo sika-Hayun.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ngaphakathi kweebhrakethi, bala ixabiso ngqo kuqala, uze uthelekise nesiphumo sokugqibela sika-Hayun.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s1.hint.1: Dlula kwimigca nomgca uhlole ukuba ixabiso lamabini liyahluka kuqala kumgca ophi.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s1.explain: Umgca 2 ngowokuqala ophosisayo. (a^m)^n=a^(mn) onesichazi samaqhezu ngumthetho weseko libonakalisa ngokongeza, kodwa iseko −3 lithabatha. Ngokwenene, ((−3)²)^(1/2)=9^(1/2)=3. Imigca 3 no-4 kukubala okulandela umgca 2.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.prompt: Bhala ixabiso elichanekileyo, uze usebenzise uphawu lweseko ukuchaza ukuba kutheni umgca apho u-Hayun asebenzise khona umthetho wezichazi ungenakusetyenziswa.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.hint.0: Bala (−3)² kuqala, emva koko unyuse elo xabiso kumandla 1/2.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.hint.1: Phinda ufunde isivumelwano malunga nokuba iseko kwakufuneka libe linani lini xa kusetyenziswa umthetho.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ufumene (−3)²=9 kuqala emva koko wafumana ixabiso 3?
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uthe umthetho wezichazi unokusetyenziswa kuphela xa iseko libonakalisa ngokongeza?
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ngaba unokuthi kutheni u-−3 ka-Hayun engenakwenzeka njengexabiso lengcambu yesikwere?
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.model.0: √((−3)²)=√9=3. (a^m)^n=a^(mn) kwizichazi zamaqhezu inokusetyenziswa kuphela xa iseko libonakalisa ngokongeza, kodwa apha iseko −3 lithabatha, ngoko ayinakusetyenziswa, kwaye ukuyisebenzisa nangoku kunika ixabiso elingalunganga −3.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.model.1: Kuqala, (−3)²=9, kwaye ingcambu yesikwere ebonakalisa ngokongeza ye-9 yi-3, ngoko ixabiso li-3. U-Hayun usebenzise umthetho nangona iseko lithabatha, ngoko uphawu lwaphuma lwahlukile.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.model.2: Impendulo: 3. Uphawu lwengcambu yesikwere lunika ixabiso eli-0 okanye ngaphezulu, ngoko alinakuba ngu-−3. Ingxaki kukuba umthetho wezichazi zamaqhezu usetyenziswe kwinani elineseko elithabathayo.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.prompt: Khetha zonke (a, m, n) apho omabini amacala e-(a^m)^n=a^(mn) achaziwe kwaye anexabiso elifanayo.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.hint.0: Kwinketho nganye, bala icala lasekhohlo nelasekunene ngokwahlukeneyo, uze uhlole kuqala ukuba zombini zinamaxabiso.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ukuba zombini zinamaxabiso, thelekisa ukuba ziyalingana na. Cinga ngokwahlukeneyo ngemeko apho isichazi sisisigxina nalapho siliqhezu.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.r.a: Icala lasekhohlo ((−3)²)^(1/2) li-3, kwaye lasekunene (−3)^1 li-−3. Kukho isichazi samaqhezu, ngoko umthetho awusebenzi.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.r.b: Uphosise ukuba ngezichazi eziphelele kumacala omabini umthetho uyasebenza nokuba iseko lithabatha. Omabini angama-729.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.r.c: Uphosise ukuba ukuba iseko libonakalisa ngokongeza, umthetho uyasebenza nangezichazi zamaqhezu. Omabini angama-25.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.r.d: Icala lasekhohlo (−4)^(1/2) alichazwanga. Kufuneka kuqala uhlole ukuba omabini amacala achaziwe.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.r.e: Uphosise ukuba isichazi sokuthabatha sisisichazi esiphelele nasona, ngoko umthetho uyasebenza. Omabini angama-1/64.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.explain: (−3, 2, 3) iyasebenza kuba 9³=729=(−3)⁶, (5, 1/2, 4) iyasebenza kuba (√5)⁴=25=5², kwaye (−2, 3, −2) iyasebenza kuba (−8)^(−2)=1/64=(−2)^(−6). Kwa-(−3, 2, 1/2), amaxabiso ayahluka, 3 no-−3, kwaye kwa-(−4, 1/2, 2), icala lasekhohlo alichazwanga. Umahluko olandelayo kukuba izichazi eziphelele zinokusetyenziswa xa iseko lingengo-0, kwaye izichazi zamaqhezu zinokusetyenziswa xa iseko libonakalisa ngokongeza.

n-m-h2-explog-02.title: Amaxabiso ka-x apho ilogarithm enoonobumba kwiseko nakwingxoxo ichazwa khona
n-m-h2-explog-02.goal: Fumana ngokwakho amaxabiso ka-x apho ilogarithm ene-x kwiseko nakwingxoxo yayo inengqiqo, uze uququzelele iimeko enye enye ukufumana uluhlu luka-x.
n-m-h2-explog-02.material: Ilogarithm log_a N inexabiso kuphela xa iseko a nengxoxo N zanelisa iimeko ezithile. Ngeli xesha, jonga ikhweshini log_{x−1}(5−x), enex kwiseko nakwingxoxo. (Iseko yi-x−1 kwaye ingxoxo yi-5−x.)
n-m-h2-explog-02.thinking.1: Ukuhlela ukuba kutheni amaxabiso asilele engavunyelwanga
n-m-h2-explog-02.thinking.2: Ukudibanisa iimeko ozifumeneyo zibe luhlu olunye
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.prompt: Fumana uze ungenise amaxabiso amathathu ahlukeneyo ka-x apho log_{x−1}(5−x) inexabiso. (Amadesimali ayavumelekile.)
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.hint.0: Faka ixabiso ka-x ubhale ukuba iseko x−1 nengxoxo 5−x ziba yintoni ngalinye.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ukuba iseko nengxoxo zombini ngamaxabiso avunyelwe yinkcazo yelogarithm. Ukuba ufumana ixabiso elingavunyelwanga, rekhoda ukuba yeyiphi eyenze oko.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.fail.c2: Iseko x−1 li-1. Iseko alinakuba ngu-1.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.explain: Umzekelo, x=3 inika log_2 2, x=4 inika log_3 1, kwaye x=1.5 inika log_{0.5} 3.5; kwinye nganye, iseko libonakalisa ngokongeza kwaye alingu-1, kwaye ingxoxo ibonakalisa ngokongeza. x=2 ayivumelekanga kuba iseko li-1, x=0 kuba iseko lithabatha, kwaye x=5 kuba ingxoxo ingu-0.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.prompt: Khetha isizathu esichanekileyo sokuba log_{x−1}(5−x) ingabi nexabiso xa x=2.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.hint.0: Faka x=2 kwiseko x−1 nengxoxo 5−x ubhale ixabiso ngalinye.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala ngokwahlukeneyo amaxabiso angenakuba lisekeo namaxabiso angenakuba yingxoxo, uze uwathelekise nala maxabiso.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.r.b: Xa x=2, x−1 ayithabathi. Faka ixabiso ubone.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.r.c: Xa x=2, 5−x ngu-3. Faka ixabiso ubone.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.r.d: Xa x=2, 5−x ayithabathi. Faka ixabiso ubone.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.explain: Xa x=2, iseko li-1 kwaye ingxoxo ngu-3. 1 inyuswe kuwo nawuphi na amandla yi-1, ngoko ayinakuze ibe ngu-3, nto leyo ethetha ukuba log_1 3 ayinaxabiso. Yiyo loo nto iseko lingafanele ukuba li-1.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.prompt: Bhala uluhlu luka-x apho log_{x−1}(5−x) inengqiqo khona.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala iimeko ezimbini zeseko nemeko enye yengxoxo ngokwahlukeneyo njengokungalingani.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.hint.1: Zoba iimeko ezintathu kumgca wamanani, ufumane apho zigqubana khona, uze ekugqibeleni uhlole ukuba akukho xabiso lishiyekileyo ekugqubaneni.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba ukhumbule ichaphaza elikhutshiweyo ekuvezeni uluhlu?
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.model.0: Ukusuka kwiimeko zeseko x−1>0 kunye ne-x−1≠1, x>1 kunye ne-x≠2. Ukusuka kwimeko yengxoxo 5−x>0, x<5. Ngoko 1<x<5 kunye ne-x≠2.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.model.1: x kufuneka ibe nkulu kune-1 kwaye incinci kune-5, kodwa u-2 kufuneka ashiywe. Oku kungenxa yokuba ukufaka u-2 kwenza iseko libe li-1.

n-m-h2-explog-03.title: Isibakala sokuba 'log x²=2 log x' sihlala sisebenza
n-m-h2-explog-03.goal: Phonononga uluhlu apho ipropati yeelogarithm isebenza khona, fumana umzekelo ochasayo wesibakala, uze ulungise ikhweshini okanye wongeze imeko.
n-m-h2-explog-03.material: U-Mina uthe oku: "log x²=2 log x yipropati yeelogarithm, ngoko isebenza kuyo nayiphi x." (log yilogarithm eqhelekileyo.)
n-m-h2-explog-03.thinking.1: Ukuthelekisa uluhlu apho omabini amacala achazwe khona
n-m-h2-explog-03.prereq.0: Ipropati yeelogarithm log a^n=n log a
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.prompt: Khetha x kwezi zilandelayo ebonisa ukuba isibakala sika-Mina asichanekanga.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.hint.0: Kwa-x nganye, bala icala lasekhohlo log x² nelasekunene 2 log x ngokwahlukeneyo, uze uhlole kuqala ukuba zombini zinamaxabiso.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.hint.1: Ukuba omabini amaxabiso akhona, thelekisa ukuba ayalingana na. Jonga nokuba lilo na icala elingenaxabiso.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.r.a: log 100²=4 kwaye 2 log 100=4, ezilinganayo, ngoko akungumzekelo ochasayo.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.r.b: Ufumene imeko apho icala lasekhohlo linexabiso kodwa lasekunene alichazwanga kuba ingxoxo yalo ithabatha.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.r.c: Nokuba x incinci kune-1, log 0.01=−2 kwaye 2 log 0.1=−2 ziyalingana. Ilogarithm ethabathayo yahlukile kwengachazwanga.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.r.d: Omabini amacala alingana no-0, ngoko akungumzekelo ochasayo.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.explain: Ukuba x=−10, icala lasekhohlo log (−10)²=log 100=2 linexabiso, kodwa icala lasekunene 2 log (−10) alichazwanga kuba ingxoxo yalo ithabatha. Ngoko asikwazi ukuthi ikhweshini ezimbini ziyalingana.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.prompt: Lungisa ikhweshini ka-Mina, okanye uyibhale ngemeko ku-x apho isebenza khona, uze ubhale isizathu sokuba uyilungise ngolo hlobo.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.hint.0: Thelekisa iimpawu zeengxoxo zamacala asekhohlo nasekunene xa x ibonakalisa ngokongeza nalapho x ithabatha.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuba yeyiphi ixabiso ingxoxo yasekhohlo x² ikuthathayo nokuba x ithabatha, ufumane inani elibonakalisa ngokongeza elinokusetyenziswa ekunene endaweni ka-x.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba uhlole ukuba icala lasekunene lichaziwe xa x ithabatha?
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uhlole ngexabiso elinye ukuba ikhweshini yakho elungisiweyo isebenza nalapho x ithabatha?
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.model.0: Kufuneka ilungiswe ibe yi-log x²=2 log|x| (x≠0). Xa x ithabatha, log x ayichazwanga, kodwa x² ibonakalisa ngokongeza, ngoko log x² ichaziwe.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.model.1: log x²=2 log x isebenza kuphela xa x>0. Xa x ithabatha, ingxoxo yasekunene ithabatha, ngoko ayinaxabiso.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.model.2: Xa x ingengo-0, log x² = 2 log|x|. Ukuba usebenzisa ixabiso elipheleleyo, ingxoxo ihlala ibonakalisa ngokongeza.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.prompt: Khetha uluhlu luka-x apho log (x−1)²=2 log (x−1) isebenza khona.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.hint.0: Fumana i-x apho icala lasekhohlo lichaziwe kunye ne-x apho icala lasekunene lichaziwe.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.hint.1: Phakathi kwe-x apho omabini achaziwe, fumana uluhlu apho ikhweshini zinika ngokwenene ixabiso elifanayo.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.r.a: Iquka nolu luhlu apho icala lasekunene lichaziwe.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.r.b: Icala lasekhohlo lichaziwe kwa-x≠1, kodwa icala lasekunene alichaziwe kwa-x<1.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.r.d: Ukuba x<1, ingxoxo x−1 yasekunene ithabatha, ngoko ayichaziwe.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.explain: Icala lasekunene 2 log (x−1) lichaziwe kuphela xa x−1>0, oko kukuthi, x>1, kwaye kuloo meko lilingana nelasekhohlo. Kwa-x<1 icala lasekunene alikho, ngoko asikwazi ukuthi ziyalingana.

n-m-h2-explog-04.title: Leliphi likhulu, log₂3 okanye log₃4?
n-m-h2-explog-04.goal: Lungisa isigwebo sakho ngobungakanani beelogarithm njengoko ufumana ulwazi olungakumbi, uze uthelekise iilogarithm ezimbini ngaphandle kwekhaltyuleyitha usebenzisa umgangatho ophakathi.
n-m-h2-explog-04.material: Ngaphandle kwekhaltyuleyitha, sifuna ukufumanisa ukuba leliphi likhulu, log_2 3 okanye log_3 4. Ulwazi luvezwa isiqwenga esinye ngexesha. (log_2 3 yilogarithm yesi-3 enesiseko 2.)
n-m-h2-explog-04.thinking.1: Ukutshintsha isigwebo sakho ngokwenza ulwazi olutsha
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.prompt: Kwinyathelo ngalinye, khetha igwebo elisekelwe kuphela koko usele ukwazi ngoku.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.hint.0: Ngalo lonke ixesha ulwazi olutsha luvela, cinga ukuba uyalugcina okanye uyalitshintsha igwebo lakho.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.hint.1: Xa zombini isiseko nengxoxo ziyahluka, cinga ukuba kulungile na ukugweba ngokujonga enye kuphela.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.info: log_2 3 yi-x enelisa i-2^x=3, kwaye log_3 4 yi-x enelisa i-3^x=4. Ekubeni 2<3<4, log_2 3 iphakathi kwe-1 ne-2, kwaye ekubeni 3<4<9, log_3 4 nayo iphakathi kwe-1 ne-2.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Ukwazi kuphela ukuba zombini ziphakathi kwe-1 ne-2 akusivumeli ukuba sigqibe ulandelelwano. Sidinga isalathiso esiphakathi esichane ngakumbi.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: log_2 3: isiseko sincinci, ngoko mhlawumbi kuya kufuneka isiphindaphindi samandla esikhulu ukufikelela kwi-3
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Usebenzise ingqiqo yokuba okukhona isiseko sincinci, kokukhona isiphindaphindi samandla kufuneka sibe sikhulu. Lunyathelo eliya phambili, kodwa alukaqinisekiswa.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: log_3 4: ingxoxo 4 inkulu kune-3, ngoko mhlawumbi ilogarithm iya kuba nkulu
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ujonge kuphela ingxoxo. Ushiye ukuba isiseko sitshintsha nasco.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Andiqinisekanga okwangoku: sazi kuphela ukuba zombini ziphakathi kwe-1 ne-2
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Eli ligwebo lokuba kudingeka isalathiso esichane ngakumbi.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Masilinganise ngesalathiso esiphakathi 3/2. 2^(3/2)=√8≈2.83 incinci kune-3, ngoko log_2 3 inkulu kune-3/2. 3^(3/2)=√27≈5.20 inkulu kune-4, ngoko log_3 4 incinci kune-3/2.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ugwebe ngokuchasene nolwazi olutsha. Jonga kwakhona ukuba leliphi likhulu kune-3/2.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wahlule amaxabiso amabini nge-3/2 phakathi kwawo.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Amaxabiso amabini asemacaleni ahlukileyo e-3/2, ngoko akanakulingana.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Ukuqikelela ngendlela efanayo, log_2 3≈1.585, log_3 4≈1.262, log_4 5≈1.161, kunye ne-log_5 6≈1.113.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: log_n(n+1) itshintsha njani xa n iba nkulu?
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Ekubeni n+1>n, log_n(n+1) ihlala inkulu kune-1, kwaye ixabiso layo liba lincinci lisondele kwi-1.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Liqhubeka likhula: kuba ingxoxo iba nkulu
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ujonge kuphela ingxoxo. Isiseko siba sikhulu nasco.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Liba lincinci, kodwa alihli ngaphantsi kwe-1
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ujonge ukuthambekela kwamaxabiso nento yokuba ingxoxo inkulu kunesiseko.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Liba lincinci kwaye ekugqibeleni lihla ngaphantsi kwe-1
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ukuba ingxoxo inkulu kunesiseko, ilogarithm ihlala inkulu kune-1.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni sasingakwazi ukugqiba kuba zombini ziphakathi kwe-1 ne-2, kodwa ukuba sifake isalathiso esiphakathi 3/2, ulandelelwano lwamiselwa. Xa amanani amabini ebonakala ehlukile, fumana inani lesalathiso onokulibeka phakathi kwawo uze uthelekise nganye nalo.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.prompt: Bonisa, usebenzisa 3/2 kwaye ngaphandle kwekhalkyuleyitha, ukuba log_2 3>log_3 4.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.hint.0: Unokugweba ubungakanani be-log_2 3 xa kuthelekiswa ne-3/2 ngokuthelekisa amandla amabini e-2. Beka 2^(3/2) kunye no-3 kwisiphindaphindi samandla esifanayo.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.hint.1: Ngendlela efanayo, thelekisa log_3 4 ne-3/2. Yenza isikwere macala omabini uze uthelekise amanani apheleleyo.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ubonise ukuba kutheni log_2 3 inkulu kune-3/2 ngokuthelekisa amanani apheleleyo?
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ubonise nokuba kutheni log_3 4 incinci kune-3/2?
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingaba udibanise iziphumo ezimbini wagqiba ukuba log_2 3>3/2>log_3 4?
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.model.0: 2^(3/2)=√8 incinci kune-3, ngoko log_2 3>3/2, kwaye 3^(3/2)=√27 inkulu kune-4, ngoko log_3 4<3/2. Ngoko log_2 3>3/2>log_3 4.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.model.1: Thelekisa ngokwenza isikwere macala omabini. Ekubeni 3^2=9>8=2^3, log_2 3>3/2, kwaye ekubeni 4^2=16<27=3^3, log_3 4<3/2. Ngoko log_2 3 likhulu.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.model.2: Ukuthelekisa log_2 3 ne-1.5: 2^3=8<9=3^2, ngoko inkulu kune-1.5. Kwi-log_3 4, 3^3=27>16=4^2, ngoko incinci kune-1.5. Ngoko eyokuqala inkulu.

n-m-h2-explog-06.title: Ukuyila umsebenzi we-exponential y=aˣ+b ukuze uhambelane neemeko ezinikiweyo
n-m-h2-explog-06.goal: Yila ngokwakho umsebenzi we-exponential ografu yawo idlula kwindawo kwaye idibana ne-eksisi ye-x, uze ugwebe iimeko usebenzisa indawo ye-asymptote nendawo yokunqumla i-x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.material: Masiyile igrafu ye-y=a^x+b (a linani lendalo elisuka kwi-2 ukuya kwi-10, kwaye b linani eliphelele). Sigweba sisebenzisa kuphela ifomula neemeko, ngaphandle kokuzoba umfanekiso.
n-m-h2-explog-06.thinking.1: Ukufumana umzekelo odlula kwindawo kodwa uphule enye imeko
n-m-h2-explog-06.thinking.2: Ukulungelelanisa unxulumano phakathi kwe-asymptote nendawo yokunqumla i-x
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.prompt: Faka izibini ezi-2 ezahlukileyo (a, b) ezinjalo ukuba igrafu ye-y=a^x+b idlula kwindawo (2, 7) kwaye idibana ne-eksisi ye-x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala imeko yokudlula kwindawo (2, 7) njengolingano ufumane unxulumano phakathi kwe-a ne-b.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.hint.1: Khetha a, ufumane b, uze uhlole ukuba leyo grafu idibana ne-eksisi ye-x na. Ukuba ayidibani, tshintsha a.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.ok.c1: a linani lendalo elisuka kwi-2 ukuya kwi-10.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.fail.c1: a kufuneka ibe linani lendalo elisuka kwi-2 ukuya kwi-10.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.ok.c4: I-asymptote y=b iphantsi kwe-eksisi ye-x, ngoko igrafu idibana ne-eksisi ye-x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.fail.c4: Igrafu ayidibani ne-eksisi ye-x. Hlola indawo ye-asymptote y=b negrafu.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.explain: Ukusuka kwi-a²+b=7, b=7−a². Umzekelo, a=3 inika b=−2 kwaye a=4 inika b=−9; xa b<0, i-asymptote y=b iphantsi kwe-eksisi ye-x, ngoko igrafu idibana ne-eksisi ye-x. Ngo-a=2, b=3, ngoko igrafu idlula kwindawo (2, 7) kodwa ilele ngaphezulu kwe-y=3 kuphela.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.prompt: Igrafu eyenziwe nge-a=2, b=3 idlula kwindawo (2, 7) kodwa ayihlangabezani neemeko. Bhala isizathu.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.hint.0: Jonga i-asymptote yale grafu nokuba igrafu ilele ngaphezulu okanye ngezantsi kwayo.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.hint.1: Fumana uluhlu lwamaxabiso anokuthathwa ngu-y=2^x+3, uqala kuluhlu lwe-2^x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.selfAssess.0: Ingaba uthe ixabiso le-y lihlala likhulu kune-3?
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.selfAssess.1: Ingaba uthe, ngoko, y ayinakuba ngu-0?
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.model.0: 2^x ihlala ipozithivu, ngoko 2^x+3 ihlala inkulu kune-3. Ngoko y ayinakuba ngu-0, kwaye igrafu ayidibani ne-eksisi ye-x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.model.1: I-asymptote yale grafu yi-y=3, kwaye igrafu ilele ngaphezulu kwayo kuphela. Ngoko ayidibani ne-eksisi ye-x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.model.2: y=2^x+3 ihlala ithatha amaxabiso amakhulu kune-3, ngoko ayilokothi ifikelele kwi-eksisi ye-x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.prompt: Kwi-a>1, khetha imeko ku-b ukuze igrafu ye-y=a^x+b idibane ne-eksisi ye-x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.hint.0: Kuqala bhala uluhlu lwe-a^x, uze ufumane ukuba uluhlu lwe-y luba yintoni xa wongeza b kulo.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.hint.1: Cinga ukuba b kufuneka ibe yintoni ukuze u-0 ube ngaphakathi koluhlu.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.r.a: Ukuba b=0, ngoko y=a^x, ehlala ipozithivu, ngoko ayidibani ne-eksisi ye-x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.r.b: Ukuba b ipozithivu, igrafu ilele ngaphezulu kuka-b, ngoko ayidibani ne-eksisi ye-x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.r.c: Ibandakanya nemeko apho b ipozithivu. Hlola imeko apho i-asymptote iphezu kwe-eksisi ye-x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.r.d: Wazi ukuba amaxabiso e-y=a^x+b onke ngamaxabiso amakhulu kune-b, ngoko b kufuneka ibe negethivu ukuze u-0 ubandakanywe.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.explain: Amaxabiso e-a^x onke ngamanani eneneni amakhulu kune-0, ngoko amaxabiso e-a^x+b onke ngamanani eneneni amakhulu kune-b. Ukuze u-0 ube kolu luhlu, b<0 iyafuneka. Oku kuthetha ukuba i-asymptote y=b iphantsi kwe-eksisi ye-x.

n-m-h2-explog-08.title: Ukuhlola isisombululo esibale amadijithi kusetyenziswa iilogarithm eziqhelekileyo
n-m-h2-explog-08.goal: Fumana umgca ongalunganga kwisisombululo esisebenzisa iilogarithm eziqhelekileyo ukufumana inani lamadijithi, uze uhlole indlela inani lamadijithi elitshintsha ngayo kumaxabiso omda.
n-m-h2-explog-08.material: U-Seoyeon usebenzise iilogarithm eziqhelekileyo ukufumana ukuba 3^50 inamadijithi amangaphi. (log 3=0.4771, kwaye 3^50 yi-3 inyuswe kumandla angama-50.)
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca wokuqala ongalunganga kwisisombululo sika-Seoyeon.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s1.hint.1: Thelekisa eso siphumo macala ngamacala nenxalenye epheleleyo yelogarithm, uze ubone ukuba isigqibo sesi-4 sika-Seoyeon sichanekile na.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s1.line.0: Ukufumana inani lamadijithi e-3^50, thatha ilogarithm eqhelekileyo yamacala omabini.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s1.explain: Umgca 4 ngowokuqala ophosisayo. 10^23 yi-1 elandelwa ngezero ezingama-23, enamadijithi angama-24. Ngoko N ene-10^23≤N<10^24 inamadijithi angama-24, kwaye kufuneka wongeze u-1 kwinxalenye epheleleyo 23 ukufumana inani lamadijithi. Umgca 5 sisiphumo esilandela kumgca 4.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.prompt: Bhala inani elichanekileyo lamadijithi e-3^50, uze ubhale ukuba loluphi kwisigwebo sika-Seoyeon olufuna ukulungiswa nokuba kufuneka lulungiswe njani.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala inani lamadijithi e-10^1, 10^2, 10^3 uze ufumane umahluko phakathi kwesichazi nenani lamadijithi.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.hint.1: Sebenzisa ipatheni oyifumeneyo kwi-N ene-log N=23.855.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uthe u-1 kufuneka wongezwe kwinxalenye epheleleyo?
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ngaba uthe N inamadijithi amangaphi ukuba iyi-10^23 okanye ngaphezulu kwaye incinci kune-10^24?
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.model.0: Kuba log 3^50=23.855, 10^23≤3^50<10^24. 10^23 inamadijithi angama-24, ngoko 3^50 inamadijithi angama-24. Kufuneka wongeze u-1 kwinxalenye epheleleyo 23.

n-m-h2-explog-10.title: Ukufumana iibini ezibonakalisa ngokongeza apho log(a+b)=log a+log b isebenza khona
n-m-h2-explog-10.goal: Hlola ngokwakha imizekelo ngokwakho ukuba inyaniso ngokubanzi "ilogarithm yesixa asisosixa selogarithm" inamacala awodwa na, uze uququzelele imeko njengefomyula.
n-m-h2-explog-10.material: log(a+b)=log a+log b yikhweshini engahlali isebenza. Kodwa phakathi kwamanani abonakalisa ngokongeza a no-b, ikho ibini apho isebenza khona? (log yilogarithm eqhelekileyo.)
n-m-h2-explog-10.thinking.0: Ukwenza imizekelo apho isebenza khona ngokwakho
n-m-h2-explog-10.thinking.1: Ukuguqula isixa seelogarithm sibe yilogarithm yemveliso
n-m-h2-explog-10.prereq.0: Ipropati yeelogarithm log a+log b=log ab
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.prompt: Ngenisa iibini ezintathu ezahlukeneyo zamanani abonakalisa ngokongeza a, b apho log(a+b)=log a+log b isebenza khona. (Ibini elinika a no-b zitshintshiwe libalwa njengebini elifanayo. Amadesimali ayavumelekile.)
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.hint.0: Dibanisa isixa seelogarithm ekunene zibe yilogarithm enye uze uyithelekise necala lasekhohlo.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala ukuba iingxoxo kufuneka zibe yintoni ukuba iilogarithm ezimbini ziyalingana, uze ukhethe a ufumane b.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.fail.c1: a no-b kufuneka zombini zibonakalise ngokongeza.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.ok.c2: a+b no-ab ziyalingana, ngoko log(a+b)=log a+log b iyasebenza.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.fail.c2: a+b no-ab ziyahluka, ngoko iilogarithm ezimbini aziqinelani.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.explain: Kuba log a+log b=log ab, ikhweshini isebenza xa log(a+b)=log ab, oko kukuthi, xa a+b=ab. (2, 2), (3, 1.5), kunye ne-(5, 1.25) zonke ziyasebenza. Sisebenzise into yokuba iilogarithm ezimbini ziyalingana kuphela ukuba iingxoxo zazo ziyalingana.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.prompt: Bhala njengefomyula ubudlelwane phakathi kuka-a no-b obusebenza kwiibini ozifumeneyo, uze ubhale isizathu sokuba obo budlelwane benza ikhweshini ezimbini zilingane.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.hint.0: Kwibini ngalinye ozifumeneyo, bala a+b no-ab ubabhale macala ngamacala.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.hint.1: Dibanisa log a+log b ibe yilogarithm enye ubhale ukuba ingxoxo yintoni.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ubhale log a+log b=log ab?
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uthe ukuba iilogarithm ziyalingana, iingxoxo ziyalingana?
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.model.0: Kuba log a+log b=log ab, ukuze log(a+b)=log ab sidinga a+b=ab. Oku kungenxa yokuba ukuba iilogarithm ezimbini ziyalingana, iingxoxo zazo ziyalingana.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.model.1: Isixa nemveliso ka-a no-b kufuneka ziyalingana (ab=a+b). Oku kungenxa yokuba isixa seelogarithm silingana nelogarithm yemveliso yeengxoxo, kwaye ukuba iilogarithm ziyalingana, iingxoxo zazo ziyalingana.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.model.2: Kwanele ukuba (a−1)(b−1)=1. Ukwandisa kunika ab−a−b+1=1, ngoko ab=a+b, kwaye log a+log b=log ab=log(a+b).
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.prompt: Khetha isibakala esichanekileyo malunga namanani abonakalisa ngokongeza a, b apho log(a+b)=log a+log b isebenza khona.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.hint.0: Ukuba a i-1 okanye ngaphantsi, thatha b ibe ibonakalisa ngokongeza uthelekise ukuba leliphi likhulu phakathi kuka-ab no-a+b.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.hint.1: Phakathi kweebini ezanelisa a+b=ab, thelekisa ubungakanani ka-a no-b omnye nomnye.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.o.a: Enye ka-a no-b inokuba incinci kune-1
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.r.a: Ukuba a≤1, ngoko ab≤b<a+b, ngoko a+b ayinakulingana no-ab.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.r.b: Wawusazi ukuba ukuba a≤1 okanye b≤1, imveliso iba ncinci kunesixa, ngoko ayinakulingana.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.r.c: Ukuba bobabini bancinci kune-1, imveliso incinci kakhulu kunesixa.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.o.d: Enye ka-a no-b kufuneka ibe ngu-2
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.r.d: Zikho iibini ezingenayo i-2, ezifana ne-(3, 1.5).
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.explain: Ukuba a≤1, ngoko ab≤b<a+b, ngoko a+b ayinakulingana no-ab. Kuyafana xa b≤1. Ngoko kwiibini ezisebenzayo, a no-b bobabini bakhulu kune-1. Kuba (a−1)(b−1)=1, xa enye isondela kwi-1, enye iba nkulu.

n-m-h2-limit-01.title: Kufuneka sazi ntoni ukuthi umsebenzi uyaqhubeka?
n-m-h2-limit-01.topic: Imida kunye nokuqhubeka kwemisebenzi: iimeko zokuqhubeka
n-m-h2-limit-01.goal: Hlela ukuba loluphi ulwazi olufunekayo nolwaneleyo ukugqiba ukuba umsebenzi uyaqhubeka kwi-x=a, uzigqibele ngokwakho ukuba umsebenzi uyaqhubeka, uze ulungelelanise loo mgangatho ngamagama akho.
n-m-h2-limit-01.material: Sifuna ukufumanisa ukuba umsebenzi f uyaqhubeka kwi-x=1 na. Umda wasekhohlo lixabiso apho f(x) isondela kulo xa x isondela kwi-1 ukusuka kwicala apho x incinci kune-1, kwaye umda wasekunene lixabiso apho isondela kulo ukusuka kwicala apho x inkulu kune-1. Cinga ukuba singagqiba na ukuthi "iyaqhubeka" xa sazi kuphela inxalenye yolwazi.
n-m-h2-limit-01.thinking.0: Ukwahlula ulwazi olusivumela ukuba sigqibe kulwazi olusilelayo
n-m-h2-limit-01.thinking.1: Ukuhlola unxulumano phakathi kwexabiso lomsebenzi, umda wasekhohlo, nomda wasekunene
n-m-h2-limit-01.prereq.1: Amava okwahlula amaxabiso emisebenzi kumaxabiso emida
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha ulwazi olunye, phakathi kwalo lulandelayo ngo-f, olukuvumela ukuqiniseka ukuba f iyaqhubeka kwi-x=1 xa wazi kuphela olo lwazi lunye.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kuqala bhala oko kufuneka ukuhlole ukuthi iyaqhubeka, uze umake ukuba ukhetho ngalunye lunelisa konke na.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.hint.1: Wahlula "ixabiso lichaziwe" kunye no-"elo xabiso lilingana nexabiso lomda" njengeenxalenye ezahlukileyo zolwazi.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.o.a: f(1)=3, kwaye f(x) isondela kwi-3 xa x isondela kwi-1 ukusuka kwicala elikhulu
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.r.a: Ujonge umda omnye wecala e-1 kuphela. Asikayazi ixabiso xa kusondelwa ukusuka kwelinye icala.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.o.b: f(1)=3, kwaye imida yasekhohlo neyasekunene zombini zikho kwaye ziyalingana
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.r.b: Uyazi ukuba umda ukhona, kodwa awukwazi ukuxela ukuba eli xabiso lomda lilingana no-f(1)=3.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.o.c: f(1)=3, kwaye imida yasekhohlo neyasekunene zombini zingama-3
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.o.d: Imida yasekhohlo neyasekunene zombini zingama-3, kwaye f(1) ichaziwe njengexabiso elithile
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.r.d: Ukwazi kuphela ukuba f(1) ichaziwe, awukwazi ukuxela ukuba eli xabiso li-3 na.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.explain: Ukuze iqhubeke, f(1) kufuneka ichazwe, umda ngokwe-x→1 kufuneka ukho, kwaye eli xabiso lomda kufuneka lilingane no-f(1). Ukhetho c lunelisa onke amathathu. Ukhetho a lunomda wecala e-1 kuphela, b alunxulumanisi umda no-f(1), kwaye d aliyazi ixabiso lika-f(1), ngoko asinakwazi ukuba lilingana nexabiso lomda.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.prompt: Khetha yonke imisebenzi emine elandelayo eqhubekayo kwi-x=1.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kumsebenzi ngamnye, fumana ngokulandelelana ixabiso lomsebenzi kwi-x=1, umda wasekhohlo, nomda wasekunene, uze uzilungelelanise kwitheyibhile.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.hint.1: Kwibinzana eliyiqhezu, lenze lula kwi-x≠1, uze ufumane ixabiso xa x isondela kwi-1.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.r.b: Njengoko x→1, (x²−1)/(x−1)=x+1 isondela kwi-2, kodwa f₂(1)=1, ngoko ixabiso lomda nexabiso lomsebenzi ziyahluka.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.r.c: Ukuba akukho xabiso lomsebenzi kwi-x=1, asinakuthi iyaqhubeka nokuba umda ukhona.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.explain: f₁ ilingana ne-x+1 kwi-x≠1, ngoko umda wayo ngu-2, kwaye f₁(1)=2 iyahambelana. Kwi-f₄, umda wasekhohlo ngu-2, umda wasekunene yi-3·1−1=2, kwaye f₄(1)=2, ngoko onke ayalingana. Kwi-f₂, ixabiso lomda 2 nexabiso lomsebenzi 1 ziyahluka, kwaye f₃ ayinayo i-f₃(1).
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.prompt: Kwi-s2, imisebenzi engaqhubekiyo yaphelisa ngezizathu ezahlukileyo. Ngamagama akho, lungelelanisa oko kufuneka ukuhlola ukuthi umsebenzi uyaqhubeka kwi-x=a.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala kwakhona ukuba f₂ no-f₃ nganye yaphelisa kuyiphi into.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ukuba izizathu zokwala zahlukile, bala ukuba zingaphi izinto ekufuneka uzihlole ukuzikhupha zonke.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba uxele zonke iimeko ezintathu ngaphandle kokushiya nanye?
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba imigangatho yakho ibandakanya izizathu zokwalwa kuka-f₂ no-f₃?
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.model.0: f iyaqhubeka kwi-x=a ukuba f(a) ichaziwe, umda ukhona kuba imida yasekhohlo neyasekunene iyalingana njengoko x→a, kwaye elo xabiso lomda lilingana no-f(a).
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.model.1: Kuqala, ixabiso lomsebenzi kufuneka likho. Okwesibini, umda kufuneka ukho, oko kuthetha ukuba imida evela macala omabini iyalingana. Okwesithathu, elo xabiso lomda kufuneka lilingane nexabiso lomsebenzi.

n-m-h2-limit-02.title: Ukuhlola ibango lokuba ingcambu ikhona ngeTheyiri yeXabiso eliPhakathi
n-m-h2-limit-02.topic: Imida kunye nokuqhubeka kwemisebenzi: iTheyiri yeXabiso eliPhakathi
n-m-h2-limit-02.goal: Xa usebenzisa iTheyiri yeXabiso eliPhakathi, ungajongi iimpawu kuphela: hlola ukuba iimeko zethiyori ziyanelisa, uze ubonise ngomzekelo ochasayo ukuba ibango alilunganga.
n-m-h2-limit-02.material: USeojin ufuna ukufumanisa ukuba ulingano 1/x=0 lunayo ingcambu yeneneni kwixesha (−1, 2), ngoko wamisela f(x)=1/x wasebenza ngolu hlobo.
n-m-h2-limit-02.thinking.1: Ukufumana umgca apho imeko yethiyori ingekho
n-m-h2-limit-02.prereq.0: Imisebenzi eqhubekayo nengxelo yeTheyiri yeXabiso eliPhakathi
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca wokuqala ongachanekanga kwisisombululo sikaSeojin.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.hint.0: Hlela umgca ngamnye ube "bubalo" okanye "ligwebo elisebenzisa ithiyori."
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kumgca osebenzisa ithiyori, thelekisa iimeko ezifunwa lithiyori noko kwahlolwa, omnye ngomnye.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.line.0: Vumela f(x)=1/x. Emva koko f(−1)=−1 kwaye f(2)=1/2.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.line.2: Ngomgaqo wexabiso eliphakathi, kukho c phakathi kwe-−1 ne-2 ene-f(c)=0.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.explain: Umgca 3 yimpazamo yokuqala. Umgaqo wexabiso eliphakathi unokusetyenziswa kuphela xa f iqhubekile kwisithuba esivaliweyo [−1, 2], kodwa f(x)=1/x ayichazwanga kwa-x=0, okungaphakathi kwesi sithuba. Ukubala kwemigca 1 no-2 kuchanekile, kwaye umgca 4 ulandela nje isigqibo esingalunganga somgca 3.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.prompt: Bonisa ukuba isigqibo sika-Seojin siphosisile. Bhala ukuba ngumsebenzi onjani ofuneka wanelise ukuze umgaqo wexabiso eliphakathi usetyenziswe, kutheni f(x)=1/x ingayaneliseki, nokuba iingcambu eziyinyani ze-1/x=0 ziyintoni ngokwenene.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala umgaqo ngefom "ukuba ..., ngoko ..." ubale ukuba zingaphi iimeko ezilandela "ukuba."
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuba umhlaba we-f(x)=1/x ushiye nayiphi na indawo phakathi kwe-−1 ne-2.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ukhombe ukuba x=0 iphakathi kwesithuba?
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.model.0: Umgaqo wexabiso eliphakathi unokusetyenziswa kuphela xa f iqhubekile kwi-[−1, 2]. Kodwa f(x)=1/x ayichazwanga kwa-x=0, ngoko ayiqhubekanga. Ngokwenene, akukho x eyanelisa 1/x=0, ngoko akukho ngcambu eyinyani.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.model.1: Ukusebenzisa umgaqo, umsebenzi kufuneka uqhubeke kwisithuba, kodwa 1/x iyaphuka kwa-x=0, ngoko ayinakusetyenziswa. Kuba inani elingasentla li-1, akukho x apho 1/x ingu-0, ngoko le khweshini ayinasisombululo.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.prompt: Gcina f(−1)<0<f(2) njengoko injalo. Khetha imeko ekufuneka yongezwe ukuze uqukumbele ngokuqinisekileyo ukuba f(x)=0 inengcambu kwisithuba (−1, 2).
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.hint.0: Cinga ukuba igrafu etsibayo okanye enokwaphuka ngaphakathi kwesithuba inokutsiba u-0 ngaphandle kokudlula kuwo.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.hint.1: Gqiba ukuba inketho nganye imalunga neziphelo okanye isithuba sonke.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.r.a: Nokuba f iqhubekile kuphela kwiziphelo ezimbini, ukwaphuka embindini wesithuba kunokukwenza uphose ingcambu.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.r.b: Ukuba amaxabiso ngamanani aphelele alinanto yakwenza nokuba ingcambu ikho na.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.o.c: f iqhubekile kwindawo nganye yesithuba esivaliweyo [−1, 2]
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.r.d: Oku kuthetha ukuba akukho ngcambu, ngoko ngokwenene iphikisana nesigqibo.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.explain: Umgaqo wexabiso eliphakathi ufuna ukuqhubeka kwisithuba sonke esivaliweyo. Ngale meko, u-0 kufuneka avele phakathi kwamaxabiso eziphelo anezimpawu eziphikisanayo.

n-m-h2-limit-04.title: Umda womsebenzi odityanisiweyo: ukuhlola isibakala sika-Mina
n-m-h2-limit-04.topic: Imida nokuqhubeka kwemisebenzi: umda womsebenzi odityanisiweyo
n-m-h2-limit-04.goal: Usebenzisa umzekelo, qinisekisa ukuba umda womsebenzi odityanisiweyo utshintsha ngokuxhomekeke kwicala apho umsebenzi wangaphakathi usondela ku-0 khona, uze uchaze ukuba isibakala siyinyani okanye siphosisile, unika izizathu.
n-m-h2-limit-04.material: Chaza umsebenzi f nge-f(t)=1 (t>0), f(0)=0, f(t)=−1 (t<0). Njengoko t→0, umda wasekhohlo −1 nomda wasekunene 1 uyahluka, ngoko umda we-f awukho. Masithi umsebenzi g usondela ku-0 njengoko x→0. U-Mina uthi, "Ngoko umda womsebenzi odityanisiweyo f(g(x)) njengoko x→0 awukho nawo." (Cinga kuphela x ene-g(x)≠0.)
n-m-h2-limit-04.thinking.1: Ukuchaza imeko yokusondela ukusuka kwicala elinye
n-m-h2-limit-04.thinking.2: Ukuhlela into ekufuneka uyijonge ekugqibeni ukuba umda ukho na
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke iinketho zilandelayo zika-g(x) apho umda we-f(g(x)) njengoko x→0 ukho.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.hint.0: Endaweni ka-x faka u-0.1, −0.1, 0.01, −0.01 uze ujonge uphawu luka-g(x).
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.hint.1: Nje ukuba uphawu luka-g(x) lumiselwe, hlola ukuba ixabiso le-f(g(x)) limiselwe njengexabiso elinye na.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.r.b: Ukuba x>0 ngoko g>0, kwaye ukuba x<0 ngoko g<0, ngoko f(g(x)) itshintshana phakathi kwe-1 ne-−1.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.r.d: Uphawu luka-g lutshintsha ngophawu luka-x, ngoko f(g(x)) itshintshana phakathi kwe-1 ne-−1.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.explain: g(x)=x² (x≠0) ihlala ibonakalisa ngokongeza, ngoko f(g(x))=1 kwaye umda yi-1. g(x)=−x⁴ (x≠0) ihlala ithabatha, ngoko f(g(x))=−1 kwaye umda yi-−1. x³ no-2x batshintsha uphawu, ngoko umda awukho.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s2.prompt: Ngaba ingxelo ka-Mina ihlala iyinyani? Gqiba ukuba iyinyani okanye hayi, uze uchaze isizathu ngokuyidibanisa nendlela g(x) isondela ngayo ku-0.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s2.hint.0: Beka u-g ovela kwi-s1 owawunomda ecaleni kwo-g ongenawo, uze uthelekise indlela uphawu luka-g(x) olwahluke ngayo.

n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s2.model.0: Ingxelo ka-Mina ayihlali iyinyani. Ukuba g(x)=x², ngoko g(x) isondela ku-0 kuphela ukusuka kwicala elibonakalisa ngokongeza, ngoko f(g(x)) ihlala ilingana no-1 kwaye umda ukho kwaye ulingana no-1.

n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.prompt: Ukwazi ukuba umda we-f(g(x)) njengoko x→0 ukho na, kufuneka uphonononge ntoni?

n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.o.b: Ukuba f(0) no-g(0) ziyalingana, nokuba zombini zichaziwe na

n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.r.c: Isantya asinanto yakwenza nokuba umda ukho na.

n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.prompt: Ulwazi luvezwa isiqwenga esinye ngexesha. Kwinyathelo ngalinye, khetha isigwebo ngokusekelwe kuphela koko uyaziyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku.
n-m-h2-limit-05.title: Ixabiso le-sin(π/x) njengoko x isondela ku-0
n-m-h2-limit-05.goal: Musa ukuqukumbela malunga nomda ngamaxabiso ambalwa kuphela afunyenwe kwitheyibhile. Hlaziya isigwebo sakho ixesha ngalinye xa ufumana amaxabiso amaninzi, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni umda ungekho.
n-m-h2-limit-05.material: Kwa-f(x)=sin(π/x) (x≠0), ufuna ukufumanisa ukuba f(x) isondela kwixabiso elithini njengoko x isondela ngokungafanelekanga ku-0. Yongeza amaxabiso kwitheyibhile elinye ngexesha uze wenze isigwebo. (Sebenzisa sin kπ=0, sin(π/2)=1, sin(3π/2)=−1.)
n-m-h2-limit-05.thinking.1: Ukuhlaziya isigwebo xa kuvela amaxabiso amatsha
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.hint.0: Ixesha ngalinye xa kuvela ixabiso elitsha, thelekisa ukuba lisondela kwixabiso elifanayo nelangaphambili na.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuba indlela owakhetha ngayo x imela zonke iindlela zokusondela ku-0 na.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.info: Kwa-x=1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/10, amaxabiso e-f(x) onke ngu-0. (x isondela ku-0 ngakumbi nangakumbi.)
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ucinga ntoni ngomda we-f(x) njengoko x→0?
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Kwa-x wefom 1/n, sin(nπ)=0, ngoko ixabiso li-0. Kodwa oku kusenokuba sisiphumo sokukhetha x ngendlela ekhethekileyo.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ndiqikelela ukuba li-0: kuba amaxabiso aqhubeka engu-0
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Esi sisigwebo sokuqala esiza engqondweni ngamaxabiso abonwayo ngoku kuphela.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Kusekude ukuqukumbela phambi kokubona amaxabiso amaninzi ka-x
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Akukho mda: kuba amaxabiso onke ayafana nje
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ukuba amaxabiso ahlala enjalo ayingqinisiso ukuba umda ukho.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Ngeli xesha, kwa-x=2/5, 2/9, 2/13, 2/101, amaxabiso e-f(x) onke ngu-1.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Nokuba x isondela ku-0, f(x) ngamanye amaxesha ingu-0 kwaye ngamanye ingu-1. Ukuba umda ukho, f(x) kufuneka isondele kwixabiso elinye xa x isondela ku-0.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Uyihoyile ingcaciso entsha. Nangona x isondele ku-0, amachaphaza anexabiso 1 aye avela.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ngu-1: kuba ixabiso elibonwe ngoku li-1
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ulandele kuphela ixabiso lamva nje. Ixabiso 0 elibonwe ngaphambili nalo lalisuka ku-x osondele ku-0, ngendlela efanayo.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Kunzima ukuthi lixabiso elinye: kuba bobabini u-0 no-1 baye bavela kwa-x osondele ku-0
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Uthathe ingqalelo into yokuba amaxabiso omabini ayavela.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ekugqibeleni, ungathini ngomda we-f(x) njengoko x→0?
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Ngokuxhomekeke kwindlela x ekhethwa ngayo kufuphi no-0, f(x) ithatha amaxabiso 0, 1, no-−1, ngoko ayinakuthiwa isondela kwixabiso elinye. Umda awukho.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Umda awukho: kuba u-0, 1, no-−1 baqhubeka bevela kwa-x osondele ku-0
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ngu-−1: kuba lelona xabiso lokugqibela elibonwe
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni amaxabiso aqhubeka engu-0, ngoko umda wabonakala ungu-0, kodwa xa ndajonga ezinye x ezisondela ku-0, isigwebo sam satshintsha. Umda kufuneka ugwetywe hayi ngo-"amaxabiso ambalwa ka-x" kodwa ngokuba f isondela kwixabiso elifanayo kuzo zonke x ezisondela ku-0.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s2.prompt: Bhala into ekufuneka uqaphele xa uqikelela umda ngamaxabiso ambalwa kwitheyibhile, nezizathu zokuthi lo msebenzi awunamda.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s2.hint.0: Thelekisa macala ngecala amaxabiso e-x apho itheyibhile ibonise u-0, 1, no-−1.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala into ekufuneka yenzeke emaxabisweni ukuba umda ukhona, nokuba u-x usondela njani ku-0.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba unike amaxabiso athile e-x abonisa ukuba ixabiso lahluka ngokuxhomekeke ekubeni u-x usondela njani ku-0?
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uchaze ukuba kutheni amaxabiso ambalwa kwitheyibhile engonelanga?
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s2.model.0: Xa ndikhethe u-x kuphela ngohlobo lwe-1/n, ndihlala ndifumana u-0, kodwa xa u-x esondela ku-0 ngezinye iindlela, ndifumana u-1 okanye u-−1. Ngokuxhomekeke ku-x osondela ku-0, f ithatha amaxabiso ahlukeneyo, ngoko akukho mda. Akufuneki ugqibe ngamaxabiso ambalwa kuphela.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s2.model.1: Ukugweba ngamaxabiso ambalwa kwitheyibhile kunokukuphazamisa. Ngokuxhomekeke ekubeni u-x ukhethwa njani usondele ku-0, f(x) ithatha amaxabiso ahlukeneyo 0, 1, kunye no-−1, ngoko ayisondeli kwixabiso elinye kwaye akukho mda.

n-m-h2-limit-06.title: Ukubhala inkcazelo "yegrafu eqhekekileyo" ka-Seoyun
n-m-h2-limit-06.topic: Imida nokuqhubeka kwemisebenzi: ukuqhubeka kwindawo echazwayo
n-m-h2-limit-06.goal: Hlela ukuba ingqiqo ethi "igrafu eqhekekileyo ithetha ukungaqhubeki" ichanekile nini nokuba iphosakele nini, uze uchaze kwakhona ngamazwi afanelekileyo kumntakwenu osesekondari, uyidibanise nendawo echazwayo.
n-m-h2-limit-06.material: Mntakwenu osesekondari uSeoyun wathi, "Igrafu ye-f(x)=1/x iqhekekile kwi-x=0, ngoko ngumsebenzi ongaqhubekiyo. Umsebenzi oqhubekayo yinto ongayizoba ungaphakamisi usiba." Ufuna ukuchazela uSeoyun apho oku kuphosakala khona.
n-m-h2-limit-06.thinking.1: Ukuqonda ubudlelwane phakathi kokuqhekeka kwegrafu nendawo echazwayo
n-m-h2-limit-06.thinking.2: Ukubhala kwakhona inkcazelo ukuze ihambelane nomphulaphuli
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s1.prompt: Khetha yonke imisebenzi elandelayo eqhubekayo kwiqondo ngalinye lendawo yayo echazwayo.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ubhale indawo echazwayo, uze usebenze ngale ndlela: kwichaphaza ngalinye kwindawo echazwayo, khangela ukuba ixabiso lomda lilingana nexabiso lomsebenzi.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s1.hint.1: Xela ukuba indawo apho igrafu ibonakala iqhekekile ichaphaza elingaphakathi kwindawo echazwayo okanye ngaphandle kwayo.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s1.r.d: Kwi-x=0 umda wasekhohlo ungu-0, umda wasekunene ungu-1, kwaye ixabiso lomsebenzi li-1, ngoko umsebenzi awuqhubeki kwi-x=0, ichaphaza elikwindawo echazwayo.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s1.explain: Kuwo onke amachaphaza e-x≠0, igama elikufuphi nelo chaphaza le-1/x ne-x/|x| ligama elilula le-x (1/x, okanye ezi khonstanti ezi-1 no-−1), ngoko ziyaqhubeka kwichaphaza ngalinye lendawo echazwayo. |x| iyaqhubeka kuwo onke amanani okwenyani. k ayiqhubeki kwi-x=0, esebenzela indawo echazwayo, kuba imida yayo yasekhohlo neyasekunene ayifani.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.prompt: Bhala inkcazelo ongathumela kuSeoyun ngezivakalisi ezi-3 ukuya kwezi-4. USeoyun usesekondari yaye unokuba uva amagama anje ngo-"umda" no-"indawo echazwayo" okokuqala. Kufuneka ibandakanye isizathu sokuba ukuqhekeka kwe-1/x kwahlukile ekubeni ngumsebenzi ongaqhubekiyo.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokubhala, ngamazwi anokuqondwa nguSeoyun, oko kwenzekayo xa ufaka u-x=0 kwi-1/x.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.hint.1: Thelekisa ukuba "igrafu iqhekekile" ne-"ixabiso liyatsiba kwa kanye kwichaphaza elinexabiso" kuthetha into enye na.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ubhale ngamazwi anokuqondwa ngumfundi wesekondari?
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ukhankanye ngokuchanekileyo unobangela wokuqhekeka (ngaphandle kwendawo echazwayo)?
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.model.0: Seoyun, i-1/x ayinaxabiso kwaphela kwi-x=0, ngoko igrafu ibonakala iqhekekile apho. Ukuqhubeka kubuza, kwichaphaza ngalinye elinexabiso, ukuba ixabiso liyaqhekeka na ngakufuphi nelo chaphaza. Kwindawo yonke apho i-1/x inexabiso ayiqhekeki, ngoko ngumsebenzi oqhubekayo.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.model.1: Awukwazi ukufaka u-0 kwi-1/x, ngoko akukho grafu kwaphela kuloo chaphaza. Umsebenzi oqhubekayo ngulowo ixabiso lomda walo lilingana nexabiso lomsebenzi walo kwichaphaza ngalinye elichazwe kuyo, ngoko i-1/x, engaqhekekiyo kumachaphaza anexabiso, naso ngumsebenzi oqhubekayo.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.model.2: Seoyun, awukwazi ukufaka u-0 kwi-1/x. Ngoko akukho chaphaza legrafu kwaphela kwi-x=0. Akukho kuqhekeka naphi apho igrafu izotywe khona, ngoko ngumsebenzi oqhubekayo.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.model.3: Seoyun, awukwazi ukwahlula ngo-0, akunjalo? Ngoko i-1/x ayizotywa nje kwi-0. Apho izotyiwe khona akukho kuqhekeka kwa kanye, ngoko siyibiza ngokuba ngumsebenzi oqhubekayo.

n-m-h2-limit-07.title: Ukwakha ngokwakho ukuqhubeka kwesixa semisebenzi emibini
n-m-h2-limit-07.topic: Imida nokuqhubeka kwemisebenzi: isixa semisebenzi eqhubekayo
n-m-h2-limit-07.goal: Khangela icala lepropati yokuba isixa semisebenzi eqhubekayo siyaqhubeka, uze wakhe ngokwakho isibini semisebenzi apho isixa saso siqhubeka kodwa ngamnye awuqhubeki, uze uchaze isizathu.
n-m-h2-limit-07.material: Ufundile ukuba ukuba imisebenzi emibini f no-g iqhubeka kwi-x=0, ngoko f+g nayo iqhubeka kwi-x=0. Ufuna ukufumanisa ukuba iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezijikisiweyo zale propati zonke ziyinyani na.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.prompt: Kwimisebenzi emibini f no-g, khetha yonke into elandelayo ehlala iyinyaniso.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.hint.0: Kwisivakalisi ngasinye, wahlula ukucinga kwisigqibo, uphawule ukuba linalo icala elifanayo nepropati oyifundileyo okanye elichaseneyo.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.hint.1: Unokuvavanya izivakalisi ezijikisiweyo ngemisebenzi emibini elula yamanyathelo.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.o.a: Ukuba f no-g ziyaqhubeka kwi-x=0, ngoko f+g iyaqhubeka kwi-x=0
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.o.b: Ukuba f+g iyaqhubeka kwi-x=0, ngoko zombini f no-g ziyaqhubeka kwi-x=0
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.r.b: Eli libango lecala elichaseneyo. Cinga ukuba f no-g zinokuvala ukungaqhubeki komnye na.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.o.c: Ukuba f no-g aziqhubeki kwi-x=0, ngoko f+g ayiqhubeki kwi-x=0
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.r.c: Cinga ukuba ukungaqhubeki okubini kunokunyamalala xa kudityaniswa na.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.o.d: Ukuba f no-g ziyaqhubeka kwi-x=0, ngoko f·g iyaqhubeka kwi-x=0
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.explain: Isixa nemveliso yemisebenzi eqhubekayo ziyaqhubeka, ngoko a no-d ziyinyaniso. Kwi-b nakwi-c, kukho iimeko apho zingabambi. Kwi-s2, zakhele wedwa imizekelo enjalo uze ukhangele.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.prompt: Ngeekhonstanti ezimbini p no-q, yakha imisebenzi f(x)=1 (x≥0), f(x)=p (x<0) no-g(x)=1 (x≥0), g(x)=q (x<0). Faka izibini ezimbini ezahlukeneyo (p, q) apho f no-g zombini zingaqhubeki kwi-x=0 kodwa f+g iqhubeka kwi-x=0.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala umda wasekhohlo, umda wasekunene, nexabiso lomsebenzi we-f+g kwi-x=0 ngokwe-p ne-q.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.hint.1: Fumana ubudlelwane phakathi kwe-p ne-q obwenza onke amaxabiso amathathu alingane, uze ukhethe isibini esingenayo p=1 okanye q=1.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Umda wasekhohlo we-f+g wahlukile kwixabiso lomsebenzi walo.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.explain: Kwi-x=0, umda wasekunene nexabiso lomsebenzi we-f+g zi-1+1=2, kwaye umda wasekhohlo yi-p+q. Ngoko f+g iyaqhubeka xa p+q=2. Ukuba p=1 okanye q=1, omnye wemisebenzi sele uqhubeka, ngoko ezo zishiyiwe.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.because.prompt: Chaza ngesivakalisi esinye okanye ezimbini ukuba kutheni f+g iqhubeka nangona f no-g ngamnye engaqhubeki.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.because.hint.0: Bhala umahluko phakathi komda wasekhohlo nexabiso lomsebenzi we-f kwi-x=0, nomahluko ofanayo we-g.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.because.hint.1: Khangela into eyenzekayo xa udibanisa imiahluko emibini.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ubhale ubukhulu bokungavisisani komsebenzi ngamnye njengegama?
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ubonise ukuba ukungavisisani kuba ngu-0 xa kudityaniswa?
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.because.model.0: Kwi-x=0, f itsiba ngo-p−1 ezantsi kunye ne-g ngo-q−1, kodwa xa zidityaniswa ziyazicima, ngoko umda wasekhohlo we-f+g ngu-2, kwaye umda wasekunene nexabiso lomsebenzi nalo li-2, ngoko iyaqhubeka.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.because.model.1: Ukudibanisa imida yasekhohlo kunika p+q=2, ngoko umda wasekhohlo, umda wasekunene, nexabiso lomsebenzi we-f+g zonke zilingana no-2. Ukungavisisani kwemisebenzi emibini kuyadibana kunyamalale.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s3.prompt: Usebenzisa isakhelo esifanayo nakwi-s2 (1 kwi-x≥0, p okanye q kwi-x<0), ufuna ukwakha umzekelo othi "imveliso f·g iyaqhubeka kwi-x=0 kodwa f no-g zombini aziqhubeki." Yeyiphi imeko efanelekileyo?
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ufumane umda wasekunene nexabiso lomsebenzi lemveliso f·g kwi-x=0.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala umda wasekhohlo ngokwe-p ne-q, uze wenze ulingano othi ulingana nexabiso langaphambili.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s3.r.a: Uthwale imeko yesixa. Kwimveliso, umda wasekhohlo yi-pq.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s3.r.c: Awukhange ukhangele ukuba umda wasekunene nexabiso lomsebenzi lemveliso zi-1·1=1.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s3.r.d: p=q kuyodwa akunikanga pq=1. Umzekelo, ukuba p=q=2, ngoko pq=4.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s3.explain: Kwi-x=0, umda wasekunene nexabiso lomsebenzi we-f·g zi-1·1=1, kwaye umda wasekhohlo yi-pq. Ngoko iyaqhubeka xa pq=1. Ukuba p≠1, ngoko q=1/p≠1, ngoko imisebenzi yomibini ayiqhubeki (umzekelo, p=2, q=1/2).

n-m-h2-limit-08.title: Ukukhangela isisombululo somda onee-|x−1|

n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s2.prompt: Lungisa isisombululo sikaHyunwoo ngokufumana umda wasekhohlo nomda wasekunene ngokwahlukeneyo.

n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.prompt: Khetha enye kwezi zilandelayo umda wayo ukhoyo xa x→1.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.hint.0: Kukhetho ngalunye, qala ukhangele ukuba igama elingaphakathi kwexabiso eliphelele litshintsha uphawu ngakufuphi ne-x=1 na.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.hint.1: Cinga ukuba ukuba uphawu aluguquki, ungalisusa nje ixabiso eliphelele na.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.r.a: Eli ligama elivela kwingxaki esebenzisiweyo. Imida yasekhohlo neyasekunene iyahluka.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.r.c: Ngakufuphi ne-x=1, x+1 ipositivu, ngoko |x²−1|=|x−1|(x+1), kwaye umda wasekhohlo ngu-−2 nowasekunene ngu-2, ohlukileyo.

n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.explain: Ngakufuphi ne-x=1, x+1>0, ngoko |x+1|=x+1, kwaye (x²−1)/|x+1|=x−1, ngoko umda ngu-0. Okubalulekileyo kukuba igama elingaphakathi kwexabiso eliphelele litshintsha uphawu ngakufuphi ne-1 na.

n-m-h2-limit-09.title: Ukungalingani nemida: ukuphonononga ibango luka-Ayun
