n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.explain: Ukuze ithiyori iqinisekise, h kufuneka iqhubeke. Ukuba indawo iyatsiba, h inokutsiba u-0. Umzekelo, ukuba ngosuku lokuqala indawo itsiba ukusuka ku-0 ukuya ku-D kwaye ngosuku lwesibini itsiba ukusuka ku-D ukuya ku-0 ngexesha elifanayo, iindawo ezimbini zingasoze zilingane.

n-m-h2-trig-06.title: Ukwenza unxantathu onamacala apheleleyo kunye ne-engile e-1 yama-60°
n-m-h2-trig-06.goal: Sebenzisa cos60°=1/2 kumthetho wekhosayini ukumisela unxulumano phakathi kwamacala onxantathu one-engile engama-60°, uze wakhe onxantathu abangafaniyo abanamacala onke apheleleyo.
n-m-h2-trig-06.material: Konxantathu ABC, a=BC, b=CA, c=AB kwaye ∠C=60°. Ufuna ukwakha unxantathu onamacala amathathu onke ngamanani endalo.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.prompt: Khetha unxulumano oluchanekileyo phakathi kuka-a, b, c xa ∠C=60°.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.hint.0: Kuqala bhala umthetho wekhosayini njengoko unjalo, uze ufake ixabiso le-cos60°.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.hint.1: Faka a=b=c=1 (unxantathu olinganayo) kulingano ngalunye uvavanye ukuba loluphi olulungileyo.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.r.a: Kwi-−2ab cosC yomthetho wekhosayini, uthathe cos60° njenge-1. Hlola kwakhona ixabiso le-cos60°.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.r.b: Uphawu lubhalwe ngokuphambeneyo. Cinga ukuba yeyiphi i-engile enika olu phawu.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.r.d: Ubhale unxulumano lonxantathu one-engile engqukuva. Hlola ukuba ∠C yi-engile engqukuva na.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.explain: Umthetho wekhosayini yi-c²=a²+b²−2ab cosC kwaye cos60°=1/2, ngoko c²=a²+b²−ab. Ukuba uphawu lwalu-+ab, ngoko ∠C=120°, kwaye ukuba c²=a²+b², ngoko ∠C=90°.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.prompt: Yenza onxantathu abangama-2 abangafaniyo abane-∠C=60° kwaye onke amacala amathathu ngamanani endalo (ama-40 ubuninzi), uze ufake a, b, c. (Khupha unxantathu olinganayo, a no-b akufuneki babe nomahluli oqhelekileyo ngaphandle kwe-1, kwaye onxantathu abahluka kuphela ngokutshintshanisa a no-b babalwa njengonxantathu omnye.)
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha a e-1 uze utshintshe b ibe yi-1, 2, 3, ... ngelixa ubala a²+b²−ab.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuba isiphumo sisikwere senani lendalo elithile na.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Onke amanani amathathu ngamanani endalo ama-40 ubuninzi.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Onke amanani amathathu kufuneka abe ngamanani endalo asuka kwi-1 ukuya kuma-40.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Ukuba a=b, unxantathu ulinganayo. Onxantathu abalinganayo bakhutshiwe.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.ok.c4: Umahluli oqhelekileyo kuphela ka-a no-b yi-1.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.fail.c4: a no-b banomahluli oqhelekileyo ongaphezulu kwe-1, ngoko lo ngunxantathu ofanayo owandiswe kowona mncinci.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.prompt: Bhala kwisivakalisi e-1 okanye ezi-2 indlela owufumene ngayo loo nxantathu.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.hint.0: Misela ixabiso e-1 lika-a, uze ucinge ukuba ixabiso olibale njani njengoko utshintsha b.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.hint.1: Thi eloo xabiso kufuneka libe linani lini ukuze libe yi-c².
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ubale ngelixa utshintsha a no-b?
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingaba uhlole ukuba ixabiso elibaliweyo lisisikwere esigqibeleleyo na?
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.model.0: Ndimisele a=3 ndabala a²+b²−ab ngelixa nditshintsha b. Xa b=8, yayiyi-49, inani lesikwere. Ngoko c=7.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.model.1: Ndifake a no-b ngokulandelelana kunxulumano c²=a²+b²−ab ndakhangela iimeko apho isiphumo sisisikwere esigqibeleleyo.

n-m-h2-trig-08.title: Ukuphakama kwenqaba kubonwa ukusuka kumanqaku amabini
n-m-h2-trig-08.goal: Qonda ukuba ukuba nee-engile nomgama akuthethi ukuba kukho ixabiso elinye kuphela: sebenza iinkqubo ezimbini ezinokwenzeka ngokubala, uze uphinde ubhale ingxaki ngemeko emisela enye kuphela.
n-m-h2-trig-08.material: Inqaba imi kumhlaba othe tyaba. Isiseko senqaba P kunye namanqaku A no-B zilele kumgca omnye, kwaye AB=20 m. I-engile yokukhwela ukuya encotsheni yenqaba ingama-30° ukusuka ku-A kwaye ngama-45° ukusuka ku-B. Ungakhathali ngokuphakama kwamehlo. USeoyun wathi, "Sinee-engile nomgama, ngoko ukuphakama kwenqaba kumiselwe ngokukodwa," kwaye uHajun wathi, "Kunokucingwa ngokwahlukileyo."
n-m-h2-trig-08.thinking.0: Gweba ukuba mangaphi amaphendulo anqunyelwa lulwazi olunikiweyo
n-m-h2-trig-08.prereq.1: Unxulumano phakathi kokuphakama nomgama konxantathu one-engile engqukuva
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.prompt: Khetha igwebo elichanekileyo malunga nokuba ingxelo kabani ichanekile.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.hint.0: Zoba zonke iinkqubo ezinokwenzeka xa u-A, B, no-P bekumgca omnye.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.hint.1: Kwinkqubo nganye, hlola ukuba ungazibonisa na imigama ukusuka ku-P ukuya ku-A nasu-P ukuya ku-B ngokwe-h yokuphakama.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.o.a: Seoyun: Zikho ii-engile ezimbini zokukhwela nomgama, ngoko ukuphakama kuqinisekile kumiselwe ngokukodwa
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.r.a: Nokuba kubonakala kukho ulwazi oluninzi, kufuneka uhlole ngokwahlukileyo ukuba imo imiselwe ngokukodwa na.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.o.b: Hajun: Asiyazi umgama oya esiseleni senqaba, ngoko ukuphakama akumiselwanga naluphi na ulwazi
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.r.b: Oku kugqithisa ukuthi akumiselwanga. Bala ukuba ii-engile zikuvumela ukunciphisa kube ngumgama omnye na.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.o.c: Hajun: Ukuphakama kuyahluka ngokuxhomekeke ekubeni amanqaku amabini akwicala elinye okanye emacaleni achasayo esiseko senqaba
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.r.c: Ubonise ukuba ingxelo enikiweyo ayimiseli inkqubo ngokukodwa.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.o.d: Seoyun: Ii-engile ezimbini zokukhwela ziyahluka, ngoko u-A no-B babekwimacala achasayo esiseko senqaba ngokuqinisekileyo
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.r.d: Wagqiba iindawo ngenxa yokuba ii-engile ziyahluka. Cinga ukuba, nokuba kwicala elinye, ichaphaza elisondele ngakumbi libona ingcambu ngee-engile ezikhulu ngakumbi na.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.explain: Ukuba kwicala elinye, i-engile yokukhwela ukusuka kwichaphaza elisondele ngakumbi B (45°) inkulu ngakumbi, kwaye nokuba kumacala achasayo, ii-engile zinokunikwa njengama-30° nama-45°. Iimo ezimbini ziyakwazeka kwaye ukuphakama kuyahluka nako (kubalwa kwinyathelo elilandelayo), ngoko ingxaki kufuneka ichaze inkqubo e-1. Oko akuthethi ukuba ubalo alunakwenzeka. Ngoko nje inkqubo imisiwe, ukuphakama kumiselwe.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.prompt: Vumela ukuphakama kube yi-h. Fumana ① ukuphakama h1 xa u-A no-B bekwicala elinye lesiseko P, kunye ② ukuphakama h2 xa u-P ephakathi kuka-A no-B (macala achasayo), uze ufake nganye kwiindawo ezimbini zedesimali. (nge-m)
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ukuphakama njenge-h uze ubonise i-PA ne-PB ngokwe-h usebenzisa onxantathu abanee-engile ezingqukuva.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.hint.1: Sebenzisa into yokuba umahluko wemigama emibini ngama-20 xa ikwicala elinye, kwaye isixa singama-20 xa ikumacala achasayo.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Kwicala elinye, PA−PB=20. Misela ulingano nge-PA=√3·h ne-PB=h.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.fail.c3: Kumacala achasayo, PA+PB=20. Misela ulingano nge-PA=√3·h ne-PB=h.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.explain: Ukuba i-engile ukusuka ku-A ingama-30°, PA=h÷tan30°=√3·h, kwaye ukuba i-engile ukusuka ku-B ingama-45°, PB=h. Kwicala elinye, PA−PB=20, ngoko h=20÷(√3−1)=10(√3+1)≈27.32. Kumacala achasayo, PA+PB=20, ngoko h=20÷(√3+1)=10(√3−1)≈7.32.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.prompt: Phinda ubhale le ngxaki ngokongeza isivakalisi esi-1 kuphela ukuze ukuphakama kumiselwe ngokukodwa.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.hint.0: Khumbula kwakhona ukuba zingaphi iinkqubo ezinokwenzeka.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala isivakalisi esi-1 esikhetha esinye sazo.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ufunde isivakalisi esongeziweyo ukuhlola ukuba simisela inkqubo ngokukodwa?
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba uxele unxulumano lwendawo luka-A, B, no-P?
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.model.0: Yongeza isivakalisi esi-1 esithi u-A no-B bakwicala elinye lesiseko P senqaba.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.model.1: Isiseko senqaba P siphakathi kuka-A no-B.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.model.2: Isiseko senqaba P sikwicandelo lomgca u-AB.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.model.3: Sixelelwe ukuba umgama ukusuka ku-A ukuya esiseleni senqaba P ngama-20√3 m.

n-m-h2-integ-06.title: Ukufumana yonke imigca ekhonkxa indawo efanayo neparabola
n-m-h2-integ-06.topic: Indawo phakathi kweparabola nomgca: impawu nokwahlula ngaphezulu kwangaphantsi
n-m-h2-integ-06.goal: Qonda ukuba kufuneka uthabathe intetho esezantsi kwentetho esetyhini ukuze ufumane indawo, nokuba imeko yethambeka elinegetivu kufuneka ilawulwe ngendlela efanayo, uze ufumane yonke imigca ehlangabezana nemeko.
n-m-h2-integ-06.material: Kukho iparabola y=x² nomgca y=mx odlula kwimvelaphi (m≠0, m linani eliphelele). Ezi grafu zibini zihlangana ku-x=0 nango-x=m. Vumela S(m) ibe yindawo yommandla ogutyungelweyo.
n-m-h2-integ-06.thinking.0: Ukuhlola ukuba yeyiphi ephezulu nexesha, usebenzisa igrafu
n-m-h2-integ-06.thinking.1: Ukuhlola icala le-integral echanekileyo (umda ophantsi, umda ophezulu) nempawu
n-m-h2-integ-06.prereq.1: Indawo phakathi kwemigca emibini egobileyo (intetho ephezulu − intetho esezantsi)
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.prompt: Khetha intetho echanekileyo ye-integral echanekileyo ye-S(−2) xa m=−2.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.hint.0: Xa m=−2, zoba ezi grafu zibini uze uqale uphawule iikhowudinethi ze-x zamachaphaza amabini okunqumla nokuba yeyiphi igrafu ephezulu phakathi kwawo.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.hint.1: Khumbula okwenzekayo kwixabiso le-integral echanekileyo xa umda ophantsi uhlala ungaphezulu komda ophezulu okanye xa into ekwenziwa i-integral inegetivu.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.o.a: ∫₀^{−2}(−2x−x²)dx: yenza i-integral ukusuka ku-0 ukuya ku-−2, uthabathe intetho esezantsi kwentetho esetyhini
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.r.a: Umda ophantsi (0) mkhulu kunomda ophezulu (−2), ngoko impawu yexabiso iyajika. Indawo ayinakuba negetivu.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.o.b: ∫_{−2}^{0}(−2x−x²)dx: yenza i-integral ukusuka ku-−2 ukuya ku-0, uthabathe intetho esezantsi kwentetho esetyhini
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.r.b: Le yifom echanekileyo, ukusuka esiphelweni sasekhohlo ukuya esiphelweni sasekunene ubhala intetho ephezulu − intetho esezantsi.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.o.c: ∫_{−2}^{0}(x²+2x)dx: yenza i-integral ukusuka ku-−2 ukuya ku-0, uthabathe intetho yomgca kwintetho yeparabola
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.r.c: Kobu bubanzi umgca uphezu kweparabola. Ukuba uthabatha intetho ephezulu kwintetho esezantsi, ixabiso linegetivu.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.o.d: ∫₀²(−2x−x²)dx: yenza i-integral ukusuka ku-0 ukuya ku-2, uthabathe intetho yeparabola kwintetho yomgca
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.r.d: Xa m=−2, ezi grafu zibini zihlangana ku-x=0 nango-x=−2. Ububanzi abukhohlo lwe-x-eksisi.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.explain: Xa m=−2, ezi grafu zibini zihlangana ku-x=−2 nango-x=0, yaye kwi-−2<x<0 umgca y=−2x uphezu kweparabola y=x². Ngoko S(−2)=∫_{−2}^{0}(−2x−x²)dx=4/3.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s2.prompt: Faka amanani amabini aphelele ahlukeneyo m ukuze S(m)=9/2. (−30≤m≤30, m≠0)
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s2.hint.0: Xa m ipositivu, qala ufumane S(m) njengentetho ye-m.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s2.hint.1: Xa m inegetivu, zoba igrafu uze uthelekise ukuba ufumana intetho efanayo na.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Inani eliphelele elingelilo i-zero ngaphakathi kobubanzi.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s2.fail.c1: m kufuneka libe linani eliphelele elingelilo i-zero ukusuka ku-−30 ukuya ku-30.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s2.fail.c2: S(m) ayiyo i-9/2. Qala ufumane S(m) njengentetho ye-m kwi-m>0.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s2.explain: Ukuba m>0, S(m)=∫₀ᵐ(mx−x²)dx=m³/6. Ukuba m<0, ucinga ngolungelelwano malunga ne-y-eksisi ngo-−m=|m|, S(m)=|m|³/6. Ngoko |m|³=27, oko kukuthi, m=3 okanye m=−3.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.prompt: Chaza isizathu sokuba umfundi ofumene ixabiso elinye kwi-m>0 angacinga ukuba kukho omnye umgca onendawo efanayo.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.hint.0: Zoba ezi grafu zika-m=3 nika-m=−3 kwiplani yekhowudinethi enye uze ubone ukuba zinxulumene njani.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.hint.1: Khumbula ukuba i-eksisi yolungelelwano yeparabola y=x² yintoni.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba uthe kwenzeka ntoni kwindawo xa igrafu ijikwa malunga ne-y-eksisi?
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uthe indawo ipositivu nokuba impawu yethambeka yahlukile?
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.model.0: Ukuba ubonisa umfanekiso ogutyungelwe yi-y=x² nomgca y=3x kwelinye icala le-y-eksisi, ufumana umfanekiso ogutyungelwe yi-y=x² ne-y=−3x. Imo nobungakanani buyafana, ngoko indawo iyafana, yaye m=−3 nayo yimpendulo.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.model.1: Nokuba ithambeka linegetivu, indawo ipositivu. Indawo ichazwa ngexabiso eliqinisekileyo le-m, njenge-|m|³/6, ngoko m=3 no-m=−3 zinika indawo efanayo.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.model.2: Iparabola ilungelelene malunga ne-y-eksisi, ngoko ukutshintsha kuphela impawu yethambeka lomgca kujika nje imo ukusuka ekhohlo ukuya ekunene yaye kushiya ubungakanani bungatshintshanga. Ngoko ithambeka elinegetivu −3 liyakwazeka nalo.

n-m-h2-trig-01.title: Ukuhlola isisombululo esifumene ukuba igrafu ihanjiswe kangakanani
n-m-h2-trig-01.goal: Kwisisombululo esifumana ukuba igrafu yefom y=a sin(bx−c) ihanjiswe kangakanani ukusuka kwigrafu y=a sin bx, fumana ulungise umgca ongalunganga, uze uhlole ixabiso elilungisiweyo ngqo.
n-m-h2-trig-01.material: U-Jiyun wasombulula indlela igrafu ye-y=2sin(3x−π/2) ihanjiswe ngayo kwigrafu ye-y=2sin3x, njengoko kungezantsi. (π yi-pi kwaye iingile ziyiradiyan. 2sin3x ithetha amaxesha ama-2 isayini ye-3x.)
n-m-h2-trig-01.thinking.0: Ukulandela isisombululo umgca nomgca ukufumana umgca ongalunganga
n-m-h2-trig-01.prereq.0: Ixesha loluhlu kunye nexabiso eliphezulu nelona liphantsi lika-y=a sin bx
n-m-h2-trig-01.prereq.1: Ukuhambisa igrafu kwicala le-x kuthetha ukufaka x−m endaweni ka-x
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca wokuqala ongachanekanga kwisisombululo sika-Jiyun.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola umgca nomgca ukuba umgca ngamnye ulandela ngokwenene kumgca ongaphambili kwangoko.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s1.hint.1: Phinda wandise ikhweshini eyahlulwe ibe zizinto ngomthetho wokusasazwa uyithelekise nekhweshini phambi kokwahlula.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s1.line.3: Ngoko le grafu yigrafu ye-y=2sin3x ehanjiswe nge-π/2 kwicala le-x.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s1.explain: Umgca wesi-3 uphosakele. Ukwandisa 3(x−π/2) kunika 3x−3π/2, owahlukileyo kwi-3x−π/2. Kuba 3x−π/2=3(x−π/6), ukushukuma yi-π/6. Umgca wesi-4 sisigqibo esilandela isiphumo esiphosakeleyo somgca wesi-3, kwaye imigca emi-1 nemi-2 ichanekile.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.prompt: Lungisa umgca ophosakeleyo ubhale icala nesixa esichanekileyo sokushukuma, kunye nendlela enye oqinisekise ngayo ukuba ixabiso lichanekile.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.hint.0: Qalisa ku-3x−π/2, cinga ukuba yinani elingakanani elifuneka ngaphambi kweebrekhethi ukwenza i-x−(ukushukuma).
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.hint.1: Andisa igama elibhalwe ngokushukuma oko ukufumeneyo ukhangele ukuba liba yi-3x−π/2.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.placeholder: Umzekelo: ukuba uhlahla i-3x−π/2 njenge ..., ufumana ...
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ungasitsho isizathu sokuba kufuneka lihlahlwe ngo-3?
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.model.0: Kwi-3x−π/2, qala ukhuphe u-3 ufumane i-3(x−π/6). Ngoko y=2sin3x yashukunyiselwa ngasekunene nge-π/6. Ukukhangela: ukwandisa 3(x−π/6) kunika 3x−π/2, okufanayo negama lokuqala.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.model.1: Kufuneka ukhuphe ikoyifishenti 3 ye-x ufumane ifom x−(ukushukuma). Kuba π/2÷3=π/6, kukuhambisa nge-π/6 kwicala elipositivu le-x. Ukufaka x=π/6 kunika 3x−π/2=0, ngoko sin0=0, oko kuhambelana nokuba y=2sin3x ingu-0 kwi-x=0.

n-m-h2-trig-02.title: Sesiphi isithuba esifutshane apho sin²x iphindaphindayo?
n-m-h2-trig-02.goal: Vavanya ibango elithi "ixesha lokuphindaphinda le-sin x li-2π, ngoko sin²x nayo inexesha lokuphindaphinda eli-2π" ngokukhangela ulingano lwesithuba sokuphindaphinda, uze uthi ixesha elincinci elipositivu lokuphindaphinda unesizathu.
n-m-h2-trig-02.material: USeoyeon wathi, "Ixesha lokuphindaphinda le-sin x li-2π, ngoko ixesha le-y=sin²x nalo li-2π," uMinho wathi, "Oko akusosona sithuba sifutshane." Apha, ixesha lokuphindaphinda lithetha p encinci epositivu apho f(x+p)=f(x) ibamba kuyo yonke x. (sin²x sisikwere se-sin x.)
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke izivakalisi ezichanekileyo ngokumalunga ne-f(x)=sin²x.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kwisivakalisi ngasinye, faka amaxabiso athile afana no-0 okanye π/2 endaweni ye-x uthelekise ukuba macala omabini ayalingana na.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.hint.1: Qala ubhale ukuba sin(x+π) inxulumana njani ne-sin x, emva koko ubone into eyenzekayo xa usika isikwere.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.o.a: Ixesha lokuphindaphinda le-sin x li-2π, ngoko isithuba esifutshane apho sin²x iphindaphindayo kufuneka nalo libe li-2π
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.r.a: Oku kuthatha ixesha lokuphindaphinda lomsebenzi wokuqala njengesona sithuba sifutshane somsebenzi omtsha. Khangela ukuba ukusika isikwere kususa uphawu.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.o.b: Kuyo yonke x, sin²(x+π)=sin²x, ngoko emva kokushukuma nge-π igrafu iyaphindaphinda ngemilo efanayo
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.r.b: Esi sigqibo senziwe emva kokubhala ukuba sin(x+π) inxulumana njani ne-sin x nokujonga isiphumo esisikwere.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.o.c: Kuyo yonke x, sin²(x+π/2)=sin²x, ngoko emva kokushukuma nge-π/2 igrafu iyaphindaphinda ngemilo efanayo
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.r.c: Awukhange ukhangele ngokufaka amaxabiso athile e-x. Umzekelo, bala macala omabini kwi-x=0.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.o.d: Kuyo yonke x, sin²(x+2π)=sin²x, ngoko emva kokushukuma nge-2π igrafu iyaphindaphinda ngemilo efanayo
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.r.d: Awuphoswanga kukuqaphela ukuba i-2π nayo sisithuba sokuphindaphinda. Kodwa ukuba sesona sifutshane kufuneka kuphandwe ngokwahlukeneyo.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.explain: sin(x+π)=−sin x, ngoko sin²(x+π)=sin²x. Ngoko π nayo sisithuba sokuphindaphinda, kwanokuphindwe kabini ngu-π, oko kukuthi 2π. Kodwa kwi-x=0, sin²0=0, kwaye sin²(π/2)=1, ngoko π/2 asisosithuba sokuphindaphinda. 2π sisithuba sokuphindaphinda kodwa asisosona sifutshane.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.prompt: Bhala ixesha elincinci elipositivu lokuphindaphinda le-y=sin²x, uze uchaze ngezizathu oko kuswelekayo kwintetho kaSeoyeon. (Izizathu: ubuncinane enye yokubhala kwakhona igama okanye amaxabiso egrafu)
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.hint.0: Bala amaxabiso e-sin²x kwi-x=0 nakwi-x=π/2, uze ufumane isithuba apho amaxabiso alingana khona.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.hint.1: Khumbula ukuba ungayibhala kwakhona i-sin²x njengegama eliqulathe i-cos2x na.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.placeholder: Umzekelo: ixesha elincinci elipositivu lokuphindaphinda le-y=sin²x li ... kuba ...
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ubhale kwakhona igama njenge-sin²x=(1−cos2x)/2 okanye ufake amaxabiso e-x ngqo?
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uthe i-2π sisithuba sokuphindaphinda kodwa asisosona sifutshane?
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.model.0: sin²x=(1−cos2x)/2 kwaye ixesha lokuphindaphinda le-cos2x li-π, ngoko ixesha lokuphindaphinda le-sin²x li-π. I-2π kaSeoyeon nayo inika amaxabiso afanayo emva kokushukuma kangako, kodwa asisosona sithuba sincinci.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.model.1: sin(x+π)=−sin x, ngoko ukusika isikwere kunika sin²(x+π)=sin²x. Ngoko ixesha elincinci elingaphantsi okanye elilingana ne-π, kwaye isithuba phakathi kwe-x=π/2 no-3π/2, apho sin²x ingu-1, li-π, ngoko π lelona lincinci. 2π sisithuba sokuphindaphinda, kodwa asisosona sincinci.

n-m-h2-trig-03.title: Ukuba tan(α+β)=1, α+β yintoni?
n-m-h2-trig-03.goal: Landela indlela isigqibo sokuba ixabiso elinye le-tan libonakala limisela i-engile sitshintsha ngayo xa kufika ulwazi ngoluhlu lwe-engile, uze uchaze isizathu.
n-m-h2-trig-03.material: Kwii-engile α no-β, tanα=1/2 kwaye tanβ=1/3. Ulwazi luvezwa isiqwenga ngesiqwenga, ngoko gweba usebenzisa kuphela oko kuziwayo ngoku. (tan(α+β) yi-(tanα+tanβ)÷(1−tanα·tanβ).)
n-m-h2-trig-03.thinking.2: Ukusebenzisa amaxabiso etrigonometri kunye noluhlu lwe-engile
n-m-h2-trig-03.prereq.1: Ubudlelwane phakathi kwee-engile ezinexabiso le-tan elifanayo (ixesha π)
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.prompt: Ulwazi luvezwa isiqwenga ngesiqwenga. Kwinyathelo ngalinye, khetha isigqibo usebenzisa kuphela ulwazi lwangoku.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.hint.0: Ngalo lonke ixesha kuvela ulwazi olutsha, qala ubhale uluhlu apho α+β ingalala khona.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.hint.1: Bala ukuba zingaphi ii-engile ezinexabiso le-tan elingu-1 koluhlu olo.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Inani elingasentla li-1/2+1/3=5/6 kwaye elingaphantsi li-1−1/6=5/6, ngoko tan(α+β)=1.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Oku kuthatha isixa se-tan njenge-tan yesixa. Phinda ujonge ukuba inani elingaphantsi lefomyula yokudibanisa libhalwe njani.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Khangela kwimilo yefomyula yokudibanisa ukuba imveliso isetyenziswa phi.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ufake amaxabiso ngqo kwifomyula wabala inani elingasentla 5/6 nelingaphantsi 1−1/6=5/6.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.1.info: α no-β zombini ziii-engile ezibukhali (ezikhulu kuno-0° nezincinane kuno-90°).
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Isixa seeengile ezibukhali ezimbini sikhulu kuno-0° sincinane kuno-180°. Koluhlu olu, i-45° yiyo kuphela i-engile enexabiso le-tan elingu-1.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Usebenzise ukuba isixa siphakathi kwe-0° ne-180° nokuba ngaphakathi kwaso kukho i-engile enye kanye enexabiso le-tan elingu-1.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ucinge ukuba α+β inokuba nkulu kuno-180°. Fumana uluhlu lwesixa seeengile ezibukhali ezimbini.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Kuyinyani ukuba zikho ii-engile ezininzi ezinexabiso le-tan elifanayo, kodwa awusebenzisanga uluhlu olunikiweyo.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Imeko itshintshile. tanα=1/2 kwaye tanβ=1/3 zisahleli zinjalo, α yi-engile kwikhwadranti yesithathu (enkulu kuno-180° incinane kuno-270°), kwaye β ibukhali.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.2.after: α+β inkulu kuno-180° incinane kuno-360°. Koluhlu olu, i-225° yiyo kuphela i-engile ene-tan 1. Nakwixabiso le-tan elifanayo, impendulo itshintsha xa uluhlu lwe-engile lutshintsha.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ujonge kuphela ixabiso le-tan elingu-1 wasebenzisa kwakhona i-engile yangaphambili.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ubonakala ucinga ukuba, kuba uluhlu lutshintshile, ayinakumiselwa. Bala ukuba zingaphi ii-engile ezinexabiso le-tan 1 koluhlu olutsha.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.reflect: Ixabiso tan(α+β)=1 lalifana, kodwa ngokwemeko yolwazi oluphathelele uluhlu lwe-engile laba yi-45° kwimeko enye nakwi-225° kwenye. I-engile ayimiselwa lixabiso lomsebenzi wetrigonometri kuphela; uluhlu lwe-engile luyafuneka.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.prompt: Chaza ukuba kutheni ukwazi tan(α+β)=1 kungamiseli α+β ngokukodwa, nokuba ulwazi oluphathelele uluhlu lwe-engile lwenza ntoni.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.hint.0: Fumana ubhale i-engile engeyo-45° enexabiso le-tan elingu-1.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.hint.1: Thelekisa inani lee-engile ezinokuthi zibe ngezikhethiweyo ngaphandle koluhlu nanoluhlu.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.placeholder: Umzekelo: ii-engile ezinexabiso le-tan elifanayo ... Ukuba kukho uluhlu, ...
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba unike umzekelo wee-engile ezinexabiso le-tan elifanayo (45° kunye ne-225°)?
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uthe uluhlu lunciphisa njani abagqatswa lube ngumnye?
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.model.0: Ii-engile ezinexabiso le-tan elingu-1 aziyi-45° kuphela kodwa ziyaphindaphinda rhoqo nge-180°, njenge-225°, ngoko i-engile ayimiselwa ngokukodwa. Ukuba kukho uluhlu, olufana nebukhali okanye ikhwadranti yesithathu, ugqatso olunye kuphela lusala ngaphakathi kwalo.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.model.1: tan inika ixabiso elifanayo ngezithuba ze-180°, ngoko kuxabiso 1 kuphela awunakwazi ukuthi yi-45° okanye yi-225°. Kufuneka wazi ukuba i-engile ikuluphi uluhlu ukuze ukhethe enye kwezi zimbini.

n-m-h2-trig-04.title: Ukufumana ubude bamacala amathathu enza unxantathu obubanzi
n-m-h2-trig-04.goal: Usebenzisa umthetho wekhosayini, bhala imeko yokuba i-engile echasene necala elide ibe ngebubanzi, ngoxa ukhangela nemeko yokuba unxantathu ubekho ngokwenene, uze wakhe oonxantathu abahlukeneyo ababubanzi.
n-m-h2-trig-04.material: Ufuna ukwenza unxantathu obubanzi onobude bamacala onke amathathu bungamanani endalo. Masibe c yobude becala elide ngakumbi no-a no-b ngamacala amabini aseleyo, uze usebenzise umthetho wekhosayini ukuphanda uphawu lwe-cosC=(a²+b²−c²)÷(2ab), ikhosayini ye-engile C echasene no-c.
n-m-h2-trig-04.thinking.0: Ukusebenzisa uphawu lomthetho wekhosayini ukwahlula uhlobo lwe-engile
n-m-h2-trig-04.prereq.1: Imeko yokuba unxantathu wenziwe ngobude bamacala amathathu
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.prompt: UMinsu wathi, "Ukuba a=3, b=4, c=9, ngoko c²=81 inkulu kuno-a²+b²=25, ngoko cosC<0, kwaye kukho unxantathu obubanzi onamacala angu-3, 4, 9." Ugweba njani eli bango?
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.hint.0: Cinga ukuba ungenza unxantathu ngeentonga ezintathu ezinobude obungu-3, 4, kunye no-9 na.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.hint.1: Bala ngokwenene ixabiso le-cosC uze ulithelekise noluhlu lwamaxabiso anokuthathwa yikhosayini.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.o.a: Kulungile. 9²>3²+4², ngoko i-engile echasene necala elide ibubanzi
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.r.a: Ujonge kuphela uphawu lwexabiso lekhosayini awukhange ukhangele ukuba unxantathu unokwenziwa ngokwenene na.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.o.b: Akulunganga. 3+4<9, ngoko unxantathu awunakwenziwa ngamacala anobu bude
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.r.b: Ngaphambi kokufumana ixabiso lekhosayini, uqale wakhangela ukuba amacala amathathu enza unxantathu na.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.o.c: Akulunganga. Ukuba 9²>3²+4², i-engile echasene necala elide yi-engile engqukuva
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.r.c: Uxubile imeko ye-engile engqukuva neye-engile ebubanzi. Kwi-3, 4, 5, thelekisa i-5² ne-3²+4².
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.o.d: Kulungile. 3, 4, 9 bubude obahlukeneyo, ngoko unokuba unxantathu obubanzi
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.r.d: Ubude ukuba bahlukile akunanxibelelwano nokuba unxantathu ukhona na.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.explain: cosC=(9+16−81)÷24 ilingana ne-−56÷24<−1, ngoko ayinakuba lixabiso lekhosayini. Oku kungenxa yokuba 3+4<9, ngoko akukho nxantathu wenziwa ngamacala amathathu. Ukuze i-engile ibe ngebubanzi, isikwere secala elide kufuneka sibe sikhulu kuneshumi lezikwere zamacala amabini aseleyo, kwaye ngelo xesha elo cala elide kufuneka libe lincinane kunesixa samanye amabini.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.prompt: Fumana oonxantathu abangama-3 abahlukeneyo ababubanzi abanobude bamacala bungamanani endalo angaphantsi okanye alingana no-20 uze ufake ubude bamacala amathathu. (Oonxantathu abahluke kuphela ngolandelelwano bathathwa njengonxantathu omnye.)
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ukhethe icala elide c, emva koko ukhethe a no-b koluhlu apho a+b inkulu kuno-c.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.hint.1: Kumanani amathathu owakhethileyo, bala c² no-a²+b² uzithelekise, uze uthelekise noa+b no-c.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Amanani amathathu ngamanani endalo asuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-20.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Amanani amathathu kufuneka abe ngamanani endalo asuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-20.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Icala elide lifutshane kunesixa samanye amabini, ngoko unxantathu wenziwa.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Icala elide lilingana okanye likhulu kunesixa samanye amabini, ngoko akukho nxantathu wenziwayo.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.ok.c3: Isikwere secala elide sikhulu kunesixa sezikwere zamanye amabini, ngoko ngunxantathu obubanzi.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Isikwere secala elide asikhulu kunesixa sezikwere zamanye amabini, ngoko asingonxantathu obubanzi.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.explain: (3, 4, 6) ine-6²=36>3²+4²=25 kunye no-3+4>6. (4, 5, 8) ine-64>41 kunye no-9>8, kwaye (5, 6, 10) ine-100>61 kunye no-11>10. (3, 4, 9) yanelisa imeko yezikwere kodwa 3+4<9, ngoko asingonxantathu.

n-m-h2-trig-05.title: Ufuna ukwazi ntoni ukufumana irediyasi yesangqa esijikelezileyo?
n-m-h2-trig-05.goal: Wahlula ukuba unxantathu umiselwe ngokukodwa na kwisokuba ixabiso ofuna ukulifumana limiselwe ngokukodwa, khetha ulwazi olumisela irediyasi yesangqa esijikelezileyo, uze uchaze isizathu.
n-m-h2-trig-05.material: Kunxantathu ABC, a=BC, b=CA, c=AB, kwaye A, B, C ziii-engile ezincopheni. Ufuna ukwazi irediyasi R yesangqa esijikelezileyo. Ulwazi ngalunye lunikwa njengamanani athile, kwaye kucingwa ukuba unxantathu onjalo ukho ngokwenene.
n-m-h2-trig-05.thinking.0: Ukukhetha ulwazi oluyimfuneko kwixabiso ofuna ukulifumana
n-m-h2-trig-05.thinking.2: Ukubona ukuba ixabiso linokufana nakoonxantathu ababini
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke iimeko ezilandelayo apho olo lwazi lodwa lumisela ixabiso le-R ngokukodwa.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.hint.0: Kumthetho wesine a/sinA=b/sinB=c/sinC=2R, bhala ukuba ufumana ligama lini ukuba kukho isibini esinye ubuncinane secala ne-engile yalo echasene nalo.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.hint.1: Kulwazi ngalunye, khangela ukuba kukho isibini secala ne-engile elihambelana nalo, kwaye ukuba akukho, ukuba esinye sinokwenziwa ngomthetho wekhosayini.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.o.a: Ubungakanani bee-engile ezintathu A, B, C
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.r.a: Cinga ngenyani yokuba ii-engile ezintathu zodwa zinika oonxantathu abafanayo abangenasiphelo abakhulu ngokwahlukeneyo.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.o.b: Ubude becala elinye a nobungakanani be-engile yalo echasene nalo A
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.r.b: Esi sigqibo sibamba ukuba isibini esinye somthetho wesine (icala ne-engile yalo echasene nalo) sanele ukufumana i-R.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.o.c: Ubude bamacala amabini a, b nobungakanani be-engile A
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.r.c: Nolwazi olunokunika oonxantathu ababini, ukhangele ngokwahlukeneyo ukuba i-R imiselwe na. Jonga ukuba olu lwazi luqulathe isibini secala ne-engile yalo echasene nalo na.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.o.d: Ubude becala elinye a nobungakanani be-engile enye ekufuphi B
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.r.d: Cinga ngenyani yokuba i-engile eseleyo C inokutshintshwa ngokukhululekileyo, ngoko i-R nayo iyatshintsha.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.o.e: Ubude bamacala amabini a, b nobungakanani be-engile ephakathi C
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.r.e: Usebenzise inyani yokuba ukufumana icala lesithathu ngomthetho wekhosayini kwenza isibini secala ne-engile yalo echasene nalo.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.explain: Kwi-b, i-R iphuma ngqo kwi-a/sinA=2R. c ifana no-b, kuba a no-A sisibini esihambelanayo. Nokuba oonxantathu ababini banokwenziwa, a/sinA ifana, ngoko i-R lixabiso elinye. Kwi-e, fumana c ngomthetho wekhosayini emva koko usebenzise c/sinC=2R. Kwi-a, ukwazi ii-engile ezintathu kuphela kunika oonxantathu abafanayo abaninzi abakhulu ngokwahlukeneyo, ngoko i-R ayimiselwa, kwaye kwi-d, i-R iyatshintsha xa C itshintsha.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s2.prompt: Ukhetho "a, b ne-engile A" lulwazi olunokunika oonxantathu ababini, kodwa i-R imiselwe ngokukodwa. Chaza ukuba kutheni.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala umthetho wesine uze ubale ukuba zeziphi iileta ezibandakanyekayo ekufumaneni i-R.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s2.hint.1: Ucinga oonxantathu ababini, thelekisa ukuba a no-A bayafana okanye bahlukile.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ubhale ibinzana elisombulula a/sinA=2R ukufumana R?
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba uthe b ayisetyenziswa ukufumana R?
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingaba uthe a no-A ziyafana nokuba kukho onxantathu ababini?
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s2.model.0: Ukusuka kumthetho wesine a/sinA=2R, R=a/(2sinA). Oku kusebenzisa a no-A kuphela hayi b, ngoko nokuba onxantathu ababini benziwa, a no-A ziyafana, ngoko R ifana.

n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.prompt: Nokuba awuyazi ifomula yokudibanisa echanekileyo, sisiphi isikhokelo esikuxelela kwangoko ukuba isiphumo sikaHarin siphosakele?

n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.r.a: Oku kucinga ukuba isayini iyehla kuphela kwii-engile ezibukhali. Thelekisa amaxabiso e-sine ama-30° nama-75°.

n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.o.d: Isayini yama-45° nesayini yama-30° azinakongezwa komnye komnye
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.r.d: Oku kucinga ukuba ukuzongeza ngokwako akuvumelekanga. Akukho sizathu sokuba zingabi nakongezwa. Kufuneka ugwebe ngesiphumo.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.explain: (√2+1)/2 imalunga nama-1.207, enkulu kune-1. Ixabiso lesayini liphakathi kwe-−1 ne-1 kubandakanywa, ngoko ubalo kufuneka lube luphosakele kwindawo ethile. Indawo ku-t=3 inika ulingano olunye kuphela, olufana no-3v₀+x₀=1, ngoko v₀ no-x₀ aziichazwa ngokukodwa yaye izibini ezininzi ziyakwazeka. Kufuneka wazi zombini isantya sokuqala nendawo yokuqala.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s3.model.1: Asiyazi imigangatho emi-2 eqhelekileyo ye-integral, kodwa indawo ku-t=3 inika ulingano olunye kuphela. Ngoko kukho indibaniselwano ezingenasiphelo zesantya sokuqala nendawo yokuqala. Ngemigangatho emibini eqhelekileyo, ufuna iziqwenga ezimbini zolwazi.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s3.model.2: Ukwenza i-integral kabini kushiya isantya sokuqala nendawo yokuqala nganye njengomgangatho oqhelekileyo. Ixabiso elinye lendawo lulingano olunye nje oluqhagamshela ezi zimbini, ngoko iintshukumo ezininzi zinokufikelela kwindawo enye.

n-m-h2-integ-01.title: Ingaba ixabiso le-integral echanekileyo nendawo engaphantsi kwegrafu zizinto ezifanayo?
n-m-h2-integ-01.goal: Qonda ukuba i-integral echanekileyo "yindawo enophawu," ibala inxalenye engaphantsi kwe-eksisi ye-x njengethabathayo, yenza imeko apho i-integral echanekileyo ingu-0 kodwa indawo ayingo-0, uze uchaze isizathu nendlela yokufumana indawo.
n-m-h2-integ-01.material: Kukho igrafu ye-f(x)=x²−2x, i-eksisi ye-x, nesithuba 0≤x≤3. U-Hajun uthe, "∫₀³ f(x)dx=0, ngoko indawo phakathi kwegrafu ne-eksisi ye-x ingu-0 nayo," kwaye uSeoa uthe, "Andicingi ukuba indawo ingu-0." (∫₀³ yi-integral echanekileyo ukusuka ku-0 ukuya ku-3.)
n-m-h2-integ-01.thinking.1: Ukwahlula igrafu ibe ziinxalenye ezingaphezulu nengaphantsi kwe-eksisi ye-x
n-m-h2-integ-01.prereq.1: Indawo yegrafu yomsebenzi ngokuhambelana ne-eksisi ye-x
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha isigwebo esichanekileyo malunga nendawo phakathi kwegrafu ne-eksisi ye-x kuso eso sithuba.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.hint.0: Zoba igrafu ye-f(x)=x²−2x uphawule apho ingaphezulu kwe-eksisi ye-x nalapho ingaphantsi ngaphakathi kwesithuba.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.hint.1: Fumana amakhowudinethi e-x amachaphaza apho igrafu idibana khona ne-eksisi ye-x, wahlule isithuba kula machaphaza, bala i-integral echanekileyo kwinxalenye nganye ngokwahlukeneyo, uze uthelekise iimpawu.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.o.a: Indawo ingu-0: kuba ixabiso le-integral echanekileyo yindawo phakathi kwegrafu ne-eksisi ye-x
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.r.a: Uthathe ixabiso le-integral echanekileyo nendawo njengento enye. Inxalenye engaphantsi kwe-eksisi ye-x ibalwa njengethabathayo kwi-integral echanekileyo.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.o.b: Indawo ingu-0: kuba igrafu idibana ne-eksisi ye-x kwichaphaza ngaphakathi kwesithuba
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.r.b: Ichaphaza apho igrafu idibana khona ne-eksisi ye-x lichaphaza nje kwaye alwenzi indawo ibe ngu-0. Iimo kumacala omabini echaphaza zinendawo.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.o.c: Indawo ayingo-0: kuba inxalenye ephezulu nengaphantsi zinamaxabiso anezimpawu ezahlukileyo kwaye ziyacinywana
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.r.c: Ucinge ngendlela amaxabiso abonakalisa ngokongeza nathabathayo anokucinywana ngayo ngaphakathi kwe-integral echanekileyo.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.o.d: Akunakuxelwa: kuba ixabiso le-integral echanekileyo lodwa alixeleli nto ngemo yegrafu
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.r.d: Apha f(x) inikiwe, ngoko sinokuhlola imo yegrafu ngqo.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.explain: f(x)=x²−2x=x(x−2) ingaphantsi kwe-eksisi ye-x kwa-0≤x≤2, ngoko ∫₀² f=−4/3, kwaye iphezulu kwa-2≤x≤3, ngoko ∫₂³ f=4/3. Zidibana zibe ngu-0, kodwa indawo yi-4/3+4/3=8/3. I-integral echanekileyo "yindawo enophawu," ibala inxalenye engaphantsi kwe-eksisi ye-x njengethabathayo.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.prompt: Kwa-f(x)=x(x−a), ngenisa iibini ezimbini ezahlukeneyo zamanani aphelele abonakalisa ngokongeza (a, b) ukuze i-integral echanekileyo ∫₀ᵇ f(x)dx=0. (1≤a≤20, 1≤b≤20)
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.hint.0: Andisa ∫₀ᵇ x(x−a)dx uyibhale njengekhweshini ka-a no-b.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.hint.1: Sebenza ukuba ubudlelwane obuthini phakathi kuka-a no-b benza loo khweshini ibe ngu-0.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.ok.c1: a no-b ngamanani aphelele abonakalisa ngokongeza ngaphakathi koluhlu.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.fail.c1: a no-b kufuneka babe ngamanani aphelele asuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-20.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Ixabiso le-∫₀ᵇ x(x−a)dx alingo-0. Andisa ubale b³/3−ab²/2.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.explain: ∫₀ᵇ x(x−a)dx=b³/3−ab²/2=b²(2b−3a)/6, ngoko ingu-0 xa 2b=3a. Emva koko b=1.5a inkulu kuno-a, ngoko isithuba [0,b] siquka inxalenye engaphantsi kwe-eksisi ye-x (0<x<a) nenxalenye engaphezulu kwayo (a<x<b). Ngoko nangona i-integral echanekileyo ingu-0, indawo ayingo-0.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.prompt: Khetha enye yeebini ozenzileyo uchaze ukuba kutheni i-integral echanekileyo ingu-0 kodwa indawo ayingo-0, nendlela yokufumana indawo kuloo sithuba.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.hint.0: Usebenzisa esinye sezibini ozenze ngaphambili, bala ii-integral ezichanekileyo zecandelo elingaphantsi kwe-eksisi ye-x neliphezulu kwayo ngokwahlukeneyo uze ujonge iimpawu.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.hint.1: Khumbula ukuba indawo, njengobude, ayinakuba negethivu, uze ucinge ngendlela ekufuneka lisetyenziswe ngayo icandelo eliphantsi.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.placeholder: umz., I-integral echanekileyo ... kuba icandelo ... , kwaye indawo ...
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba uthe icandelo elingaphantsi kwe-eksisi ye-x libalwa njani ngaphakathi kwe-integral echanekileyo?
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uthe kuba indawo ayinakuba negethivu, wahlule isithuba apho uphawu luguquka khona?
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.model.0: I-integral echanekileyo yecandelo elingaphantsi kwe-eksisi ye-x inegethivu kwaye eyecandelo eliphezulu ipositivu, ngoko xa zidityaniswa ziyazicima zinike u-0. Kwindawo, icandelo eliphantsi nalo kufuneka libalwe njengepositivu, ngoko yahlula isithuba kwichaphaza apho igrafu idibana khona ne-eksisi ye-x, ufumane ixabiso ngalinye, wongeze amaxabiso awo epheleleyo.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.model.1: I-integral echanekileyo yindawo enophawu, ngoko ixabiso eliphezulu nelingezantsi (elinegethivu) lidibana lenze u-0. Indawo yokwenyani ibala zombini njengezipositivu, ngoko zifumane ngokwahlukeneyo ngokwahlula kwi-[0,a] nakwi-[a,b], uze uzidibanise.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.model.2: Ukuba wahlula isithuba sibe ngamacandelo amabini kwichaphaza apho igrafu idibana khona ne-eksisi ye-x, i-integral echanekileyo enye ipositivu kwaye enye inegethivu. Nokuba isixa sazo singu-0, indawo yi-|icandelo elinegethivu|+|icandelo elipositivu|, ngaphezulu kuno-0.

n-m-h2-integ-04.title: Ukufumana imeko yobuncinane belokishi bomsebenzi omiselwe yi-integral echanekileyo
n-m-h2-integ-04.topic: Ukwahlula namaxabiso aphakamileyo emisebenzi emiselwe yii-integral ezichanekileyo
n-m-h2-integ-04.goal: Sebenzisa inyani yokuba ukunyuka nokwehla namaxabiso aphakamileyo omsebenzi F(x)=∫₀ˣ f(t)dt omiselwe yi-integral echanekileyo amiselwa luphawu lwe-f(x), ukwakha imizekelo apho ixabiso lobuncinane belokishi lipositivu uze ufumane imeko.
n-m-h2-integ-04.material: f(t)=(t−a)(t−b) (a no-b ngamanani aphelele a-0<a<b) kwaye F(x)=∫₀ˣ f(t)dt. (∫₀ˣ yi-integral echanekileyo ukusuka ku-0 ukuya ku-x.)
n-m-h2-integ-04.thinking.1: Ukwahlula indawo yexabiso eliphakamileyo kubungakanani baso
n-m-h2-integ-04.prereq.1: Ukunyuka, ukwehla, namaxabiso aphakamileyo emisebenzi yekyubhiki
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.prompt: Kwi-x>0, kuzo zeziphi ii-x apho u-F(x) anokuba nexabiso eliphakamileyo?
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.hint.0: Khumbula ukuba ufumana msebenzi muni xa wahlula umsebenzi omiselwe yi-integral echanekileyo.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ukuba uphanda uphawu lwe-F' kuluhlu ngalunye lwe-x, ungabona apho u-F enyuka khona nalapho ehla khona.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.o.a: I-x apho f(x) inexabiso eliphakamileyo: u-F unexabiso eliphakamileyo kwindawo efanayo ne-f
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.r.a: Ukunyuka nokwehla kuka-F kumiselwa luphawu lwe-f, hayi ngexabiso le-f. Iindawo zamaxabiso aphakamileyo e-f azinalo unxibelelwano namaxabiso aphakamileyo ka-F.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.o.b: I-x apho f(x)=0 kwaye uphawu lwe-f(x) luguquka macala omabini
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.r.b: Usebenzise inyani yokuba kuba F'(x)=f(x), amaxabiso aphakamileyo enzeka apho uphawu lwe-F' luguquka khona.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.o.c: I-x apho F(x)=0: ixabiso eliphakamileyo lenzeka apho igrafu inqumla i-eksisi ye-x
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.r.c: Iindawo apho u-F engu-0 neendawo apho kwenzeka amaxabiso aphakamileyo ziimiba ezahlukeneyo.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.o.d: x=0: ixabiso lika-F liqala ukutshintsha kwindawo apho i-integral iqala khona
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.r.d: F(0)=0 lixabiso nje, kwaye x=0 ayiyo indawo apho ukunyuka nokwehla kutshintsha khona.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.explain: Kuba F'(x)=f(x)=(x−a)(x−b), u-F unyuka kwi-x<a, uyehla kwi-a<x<b, aze anyuke kwi-x>b. Ngoko u-F uneyona nto iphezulu yelokishi kwi-x=a neyona nto iphantsi yelokishi kwi-x=b.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.prompt: Phakathi kwezibini zamanani aphelele (a, b) ezine-0<a<b≤20, faka izibini ezintathu ezahlukeneyo apho ixabiso lobuncinane belokishi lika-F(x) lipositivu.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.hint.0: Qala umisele i-x apho u-F enobuncinane belokishi, uze uchaze ixabiso lika-F kuloo x ngokwe-a ne-b.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.hint.1: Andisa ubale ∫₀ᵇ(t−a)(t−b)dt uze usebenze imeko yokuba uphawu lube lipositivu.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.fail.c1: a no-b kufuneka babe ngamanani aphelele ane-0<a<b≤20.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Ixabiso lobuncinane belokishi alipositivu. Chaza ixabiso lika-F kwi-x apho kwenzeka khona ubuncinane belokishi ngokwe-a ne-b.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.explain: Ubuncinane belokishi buyenzeka kwi-x=b, kwaye F(b)=∫₀ᵇ(t²−(a+b)t+ab)dt=b³/3−(a+b)b²/2+ab²=b²(3a−b)/6. Kuba b²>0, ixabiso lobuncinane belokishi lipositivu xa 3a−b>0, oko kukuthi b<3a.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.prompt: Bhala ukuba kukho nobuphi na ubudlelwane phakathi kwe-b ne-a kwizibini ozifumeneyo, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni obo budlelwane bufuneka ngokubala ixabiso lobuncinane belokishi.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ugqibe ukuba ubuncinane belokishi bukwi-a okanye kwi-b, emva koko andisa ubale i-integral echanekileyo kuya kuloo x.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.hint.1: Kwigama olibalileyo, wahlula izinto ezibalayo ezihlala zipositivu kwezo zinokutshintsha uphawu.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.placeholder: umz., b ... kuno-... ka-a. Ixabiso lobuncinane belokishi ..., ngoko ...
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba uqale wamisela i-x apho kwenzeka khona ubuncinane belokishi emva koko wabala ixabiso lalo?
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uthe sesiphi isiqhulo esimisela uphawu lwexabiso lobuncinane belokishi?
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.model.0: b kufuneka ibe ngaphantsi kokuphindwe ka-a ngo-3. Ubuncinane belokishi buyenzeka kwi-x=b, kwaye F(b)=b²(3a−b)/6, kwaye kuba b² ihlala ipositivu, 3a−b kufuneka ibe pozitivu. Ngoko b<3a.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.model.1: Xa b<3a, ixabiso lobuncinane belokishi lipositivu. Ukubala F(b)=∫₀ᵇ(t−a)(t−b)dt kunika b²(3a−b)/6, kwaye uphawu lwalo lumiselwa yi-3a−b.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.model.2: Kwanele ukuba 3a>b. Fumana ixabiso F(b)=b^2(3a-b)/6 kwi-x=b, apho kwenzeka ubuncinane belokishi, uze ufumane imeko yokuba lipositivu: 3a-b>0.

n-m-h2-integ-03.title: Ukuba kubuyele apho kwaqala khona, ngaba akushukumanga?

n-m-h2-integ-03.material: Ulwazi malunga nechaphaza P elishukuma kumgca wamanani luvezwa isiqwenga ngesiqwenga. Utshintsho lwendawo yi-integral yesantya, kwaye umgama ohambiweyo sisixa sazo zonke iinde ezigqitywe ngokwenene.

n-m-h2-integ-03.thinking.2: Ukwahlula isithuba apho uphawu lwesantya luguquka khona
n-m-h2-integ-03.prereq.0: Ubudlelwane phakathi kwesantya nendawo (utshintsho lwendawo = i-integral echanekileyo yesantya)

n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuba intshukumo yechaphaza yahluka njani apho uphawu lwesantya luguquka khona.

n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ngolu lwazi lodwa, ngaba singathi umgama ohanjwe ngu-P ungu-0?
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Utshintsho lwendawo lixabiso elinecala (linophawu), ngoko lunokuba ngu-0 nokuba ichaphaza liyaphuma libuye.

n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Singathi ewe: ukuba i-integral echanekileyo ingu-0, isantya kufuneka sihlale singu-0
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Nokuba i-integral echanekileyo ingu-0, zinokubakho izithuba apho isantya sipositivu zixutywe nezithuba apho sinegethivu.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ngexesha elingakanani u-P utshintsha icala lentshukumo yakhe?
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Ngoxa isantya sinegethivu sishukuma kwicala elinye, kwaye ngoxa sipositivu sishukuma kwicala elichaseneyo. Icala litshintsha ku-t=4, apho uphawu luguquka khona.

n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Alitshintshi icala: umzuzu apho isantya singu-0 asingutshintsho lwecala

n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ngumgama onjani u-P awuhambileyo ngokwenene ukusuka ku-t=0 ukuya ku-6?

n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Xa ubongeza, iintshukumo ezimbini kumacala achasayo ziyazicima. Oku kuyutshintsho lwendawo.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Isithuba sokubuya sikwayinxalenye yobude obugqityiweyo ngokwenene.

n-m-h2-seq-01.title: Ukuhlola isisombululo sikaHayoon somlinganiselo oqhelekileyo
n-m-h2-seq-01.topic: Isixa solandelelwano lokuphindaphinda nokufumana umlinganiselo oqhelekileyo
n-m-h2-seq-01.goal: Kwisisombululo esisebenzisa ifomula yesixa sokuphindaphinda, fumana igwebo elilahla isisombululo, uze ulilungise ngokubhala ulandelelwano lokwenene ngexabiso elilahliweyo nokuhlola imeko.
n-m-h2-seq-01.material: Esi sisisombululo sikaHayoon sokufumana umlinganiselo oqhelekileyo wolandelelwano lokuphindaphinda {aₙ} onelungu lokuqala elingu-2 nesixa ukusuka kwilungu lokuqala ukuya kwelesithathu esingu-6. (aₙ yi-"a sub n," r ngumlinganiselo oqhelekileyo, kwaye S₃ sisixa samalungu okuqala ama-3.)
n-m-h2-seq-01.thinking.0: Ukuhlola ukuba umgca ngamnye wabhalwa ngokucingwa ntoni
n-m-h2-seq-01.thinking.1: Ukuhlola ngokufaka ixabiso elilahliweyo ngqo kwimeko
n-m-h2-seq-01.prereq.0: Ilungu jikelele lolandelelwano lokuphindaphinda nefomula yesixa samalungu okuqala n
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca omnye kwisisombululo sikaHayoon oqulathe igwebo eliphosakeleyo. (Ukuba imigca emininzi iphosakele, ukukhetha nawuphi na kwanele.)
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kumgca ngamnye, hlola ukuba ibinzana linokusetyenziswa kuyo yonke r okanye liba ngelingenantsingiselo kwezinye r.
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kwixabiso ngalinye le-r eliphuma kwisisombululo, bhala ulandelelwano olunomlinganiselo oqhelekileyo lowo uze uvavanye ukuba isixa samalungu alo okuqala ama-3 singu-6 na.
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s1.line.0: Vumela umlinganiselo oqhelekileyo ube yi-r. Ngefomula yesixa sokuphindaphinda, S₃ = 2(r³−1)/(r−1) = 6.
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s1.line.1: Ekubeni (r³−1)/(r−1) = r²+r+1, sifumana r²+r+1 = 3, oko kukuthi r²+r−2 = 0.

n-m-h2-seq-04.material: Kulandelelwano lokuphindaphinda {aₙ} lamanani okwenyani, a₂=3 kwaye a₆=12. UMinjun wathi, "a₄²=a₂×a₆=36, ngoko a₄=6 okanye −6," kwaye uSeoyeon wathi, "a₄ yi-6 kuphela." (aₙ ifundwa "a sub n," kwaye umlinganiselo oqhelekileyo ngumlinganiselo wamalungu amabini asondeleneyo.)

n-m-h2-seq-04.s.s1.r.a: Wamkele amaxabiso omabini ngokujonga ubudlelwane obuthe kwisikwere kuphela. Awuhlolanga ukuba ayenzeka na kulandelelwano lwenene.

n-m-h2-seq-04.s.s1.o.c: a₄ = 6 kuphela: kuba ulandelelwano lokuphindaphinda alunakuba nalo ilungu elinegethivu
n-m-h2-seq-04.s.s1.r.c: Ukuba umlinganiselo oqhelekileyo unegethivu, kuvela amalungu anegethivu. Kule meko isizathu sokuba uphawu lumiselwe sikwenye indawo.
n-m-h2-seq-04.s.s1.o.d: a₄ = 6 kuphela: kuba a₄=a₂×r² kwaye r²≥0, ngoko a₄ inophawu olufanayo nolwe-a₂

Umlinganiselo oqhelekileyo r=±√2 omabini ayenzeka, kodwa a₄ lixabiso elifanayo. Ukujonga a₄²=36 kuphela kwakuya kunika −6 nayo, kodwa ayinakwenzeka kulandelelwano lwenene.

n-m-h2-seq-07.title: Kutheni ukuthabatha i-3 kuvelisa ulandelelwano lokuphindaphinda ngokulinganayo?
n-m-h2-seq-07.goal: Qonda isizathu sokuba, ekusombululeni ukuphindaphinda kwakhona, ukuthabatha ixabiso elingatshintshiyo kuguqula ibe ngulandelelwano lokuphindaphinda ngokulinganayo, uze uchaze kwakhona kumhlobo wesikolo samabanga aphakathi ukuze isizathu sibonakale.
n-m-h2-seq-07.material:
Ilebhu ikhulisa iibhaktheriya. Ekuqaleni zi-5, kwaye iyure nganye inani liphinda kabini zize zisuswe ezi-3. Kwinani aₙ lexesha n (kunye ne-a₁=5 kwiyure yokuqala), aₙ₊₁ = 2aₙ − 3. Apha ngezantsi yinqaku lesisombululo somfundi ophezulu.
Notsi: Ukusuka kwi-x = 2x − 3, x = 3. Ngoko aₙ₊₁ − 3 = 2(aₙ − 3). Vumela bₙ = aₙ − 3. Emva koko b₁ = 2 kwaye bₙ = 2ⁿ. Ngoko ke aₙ = 2ⁿ + 3.

n-m-h2-seq-07.s.s1.hint.1: Thelekisa eso siphumo nesiphumo ofumana xa ufaka elinye ixabiso (umzekelo, 5).
n-m-h2-seq-07.s.s1.r.a: a₁ inikwe njenge-5. Jonga kwakhona ukuba u-3 wasuka phi.

n-m-h2-seq-10.material:
Abafundi ababini ngamnye ufumene ilungu eliqhelekileyo lolandelelwano {aₙ} nge-a₁=2 kunye ne-aₙ₊₁ = aₙ + (3n − 1).
U-Harin: aₙ = 2 + Σ(k=1 ukuya ku-n−1)(3k−1) = (3n²−5n+6)/2
U-Doyun: aₙ = 2 + Σ(k=1 ukuya ku-n)(3k−1) = (3n²+n+4)/2
